title.en: The Contraction Mapping Theorem: Master Key for Nonlinear Equations

zh: 定理的证明分四步（书 Box 3.1）：① 迭代序列相邻两项的距离被 $\gamma^{k}$ 压缩，任意两项距离 ≤ $\gamma^{n}$/(1−γ)·‖x₁−x₀‖（又一次几何级数！），序列是 Cauchy 的故收敛；② 极限点是不动点；③ 反证若有两个不动点，‖x′−x*‖ ≤ γ‖x′−x*‖ 迫使其为零；④ 误差估计直接给出指数收敛速度。注意证明里反复出现的那把旧钥匙：γ < 1 的几何级数。
en: The proof has four moves (book Box 3.1): ① consecutive iterates shrink by $\gamma^{k}$; pairwise distances are ≤ $\gamma^{n}$/(1−γ)·‖x₁−x₀‖ (the geometric series again!), so the sequence is Cauchy and converges; ② the limit is a fixed point; ③ if two fixed points existed, ‖x′−x*‖ ≤ γ‖x′−x*‖ forces zero distance; ④ the error bound gives exponential rate. Notice the old key reappearing throughout: the geometric series with γ < 1.

title.zh: 压缩映射定理：非线性方程的万能钥匙
title.en: The Contraction Mapping Theorem: Master Key for Nonlinear Equations

zh: 最后一步把钥匙插进 BOE 的锁孔：定理 3.2——f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v) 是压缩映射（∞-范数下，系数恰好 γ）。证明的技巧是「交换最大」：对 v₁ 取的最优 π₁* 代入 v₂ 会吃亏，于是 f(v₁) − f(v₂) ≤ γ$P_{\pi_1 *}$(v₁ − v₂)；对称地再得一侧，夹住之后逐元素放大到 $\| v _1 - v _2 \| _{\infty}$。于是压缩映射定理全套适用于 BOE：解存在、唯一、可迭代、指数收敛。
en: Finally the key meets the lock: Theorem 3.2 — f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v) is a contraction mapping (in the ∞-norm, with factor exactly γ). The proof trick is "swapping the max": the π₁* optimal for v₁ underperforms on v₂, giving f(v₁) − f(v₂) ≤ γ$P_{\pi_1 *}$(v₁ − v₂); symmetrically for the other side; sandwich and lift to the ∞-norm. The whole contraction mapping theorem now applies to the BOE: solution exists, unique, iterable, exponentially fast.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 压缩映射定理一对进 BOE，三大问题同时了结（定理 3.3）：存在——BOE 的解 v* 存在（不动点）；唯一——v* 唯一；算法——从任意 v₀ 出发迭代 $v_{k+1}$ = f($v_{k}$) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$) 指数收敛到 v*。这个迭代算法有个响亮的名字：值迭代（value iteration）——第 4 章的主角，这里先领个票。
en: Once the contraction mapping theorem meets the BOE, three questions close at once (Theorem 3.3): existence — the BOE solution v* exists (a fixed point); uniqueness — v* is unique; algorithm — iterating $v_{k+1}$ = f($v_{k}$) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$) from any v₀ converges exponentially to v*. This iteration has a famous name: value iteration — the protagonist of Chapter 4, taking a ticket here.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 解出 v* 之后，π* 白送：π* = $\arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v*)，逐状态看就是贪心策略——在每个状态选 q*(s,a) = $\Sigma_{r}$p(r|s,a)r + $\gamma \Sigma_{s '}$p(s′|s,a)v*(s′) 最大的动作（定理 3.5）。代回去可得 v* = $r_{\pi *}$ + γ$P_{\pi *}$v*：v* 恰好是 π* 的状态值，BOE 确实是「对应最优策略的特殊 Bellman 方程」。定理 3.4 补上最后一环：对任何策略 π 都有 v* = $v_{\pi *} \ge v_{\pi}$——解出来的就是最优的，货真价实。
en: After v*, the policy π* comes free: π* = $\arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v*), which state by state is the greedy policy — at each state pick the action maximising q*(s,a) = $\Sigma_{r}$p(r|s,a)r + $\gamma \Sigma_{s '}$p(s′|s,a)v*(s′) (Theorem 3.5). Substituting back gives v* = $r_{\pi *}$ + γ$P_{\pi *}$v*: v* is exactly π*'s state value, so the BOE is indeed "the special Bellman equation of the optimal policy". Theorem 3.4 closes the loop: for every policy π, v* = $v_{\pi *} \ge v_{\pi}$ — the solution is genuinely optimal.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: v* 与 q* 的互相表出 · Expressing v* and q* through each other

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 这对表出式与 L2 的 (2.13)(2.14) 严格同构，只是「π 加权平均」换成了「max「——从」平均给定的选择「升级为」挑选最好的选择「。知道 q*，连贪心都一步到位：在 s 处把 q*(s,a) 摆开取最大，策略选择被 max 一次性解决，全程不需要 v*、也不需要模型加权的中间步骤。这预告了后续两条路线的分岔：第 5 章蒙特卡洛、第 7 章 Q-learning 走 q* 路线（样本直接估动作值，无需模型）；本章与第 4 章的值迭代走 v* 路线（每轮一次模型加权求 q、一次 max 收账）。两条路线在」贪心提取 π*」处会师。
en: This pair of expressions is strictly isomorphic to L2’s (2.13)(2.14), with the "π-weighted average" swapped for a max — upgrading from "averaging given choices" to "choosing the best". With q* in hand, even the greedy step collapses to one move: lay out q*(s,a) at s and take the maximum; the policy selection is settled by a single max, with no v* and no model-weighted intermediate needed. This foretells the fork of later chapters: Monte Carlo (Chapter 5) and Q-learning (Chapter 7) take the q* route (samples estimate action values directly, no model required), while this chapter’s and Chapter 4’s value iteration takes the v* route (each round: one model-weighted pass to the q’s, one max to collect). The two routes reunite at "greedy extraction of π*".

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 数值演算（两状态迷你世界，γ = 0.5，max 手算一步）。s2 只有「原地」一个动作，每步 +1；s1 有两个动作：走（奖励 0，转移到 s2）与留（奖励 0.4，留在 s1）。先解 s2 的 BOE：v(s2) = 1 + 0.5v(s2) ⟹ v*(s2) = 2 = 1/(1−γ)。再代 s1：v(s1) = max(0 + 0.5v(s2), 0.4 + 0.5v(s1))。两分支各试一次：「留」若为最优，v(s1) = 0.4 + 0.5v(s1) 解得 0.8，但此时「走」分支值 0.5×2 = 1 > 0.8，矛盾；「走」若为最优，v(s1) = 1，回查「留」分支 0.4 + 0.5×1 = 0.9 < 1 ✓。v*(s1) = 1，最优动作是「走」——即时奖励更大的「留」是陷阱，远处每步 +1 的 s2 才是金山。再跑三轮值迭代，亲眼看 max 干活（v₀ = 0）：第 1 轮 v(s1) = max(0, 0.4) = 0.4（贪心错选「留」）；第 2 轮 = max(0.5×1, 0.4+0.2) = 0.6（仍「留」）；第 3 轮 = max(0.5×1.5, 0.4+0.3) = 0.75，argmax 翻转为「走」，此后单调奔向 1；v(s2) 则按 2(1−$0.5^{k}$) = 1, 1.5, 1.75, … 几何级数补齐（以上用 node 逐轮实算核对）。小世界一句话演完大道理：max 让「短视的贪心」随着价值信息的传播自我修正。
en: A numeric run (a two-state miniature, γ = 0.5, one max by hand). s2 has a single action "stay" paying +1 per step; s1 has two actions: go (reward 0, move to s2) and stay (reward 0.4, remain at s1). Solve s2’s BOE first: v(s2) = 1 + 0.5v(s2) ⟹ v*(s2) = 2 = 1/(1−γ). Substitute into s1: v(s1) = max(0 + 0.5v(s2), 0.4 + 0.5v(s1)). Try each branch: were "stay" optimal, v(s1) = 0.4 + 0.5v(s1) would give 0.8 — but the "go" branch is then worth 0.5×2 = 1 > 0.8, a contradiction; with "go" optimal, v(s1) = 1, and re-checking "stay": 0.4 + 0.5×1 = 0.9 < 1 ✓. v*(s1) = 1 with "go" optimal — the fatter immediate reward of "stay" is a trap; the +1-per-step s2 is the gold mine. Now run three rounds of value iteration and watch the max work (v₀ = 0): round 1, v(s1) = max(0, 0.4) = 0.4 (the greedy pick wrongly chooses "stay"); round 2, max(0.5×1, 0.4+0.2) = 0.6 (still "stay"); round 3, max(0.5×1.5, 0.4+0.3) = 0.75 and the argmax flips to "go", after which it climbs monotonically toward 1, while v(s2) fills in geometrically as 2(1−$0.5^{k}$) = 1, 1.5, 1.75, … (re-verified round by round in node). One miniature stages the big moral: the max lets a short-sighted greed correct itself as value information propagates.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 最优策略不唯一：v* 唯一，但取到 v* 的策略可以多条（书 Figure 3.3：s1 处 0.5/0.5 随机与另一条确定性策略都是最优）。直觉：两条路一样好，掷不掷硬币都到罗马。
en: Optimal policies are not unique: v* is unique, yet several policies may attain it (book Figure 3.3: a 0.5/0.5 stochastic policy and a deterministic one are both optimal). Intuition: when two roads are equally good, flipping a coin or not still lands in Rome.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 必有确定性最优策略：最优策略可以是随机的也可以是确定的，但定理 3.5 保证总存在一条确定性的贪心最优策略——这就是为什么我们敢在图里全画箭头。
en: A deterministic optimal policy always exists: optimal policies may be stochastic or deterministic, but Theorem 3.5 guarantees at least one deterministic greedy optimal policy — which is why drawing arrows everywhere is always honest.

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 四个问题全部销账：存在 ✓（不动点）、算法 ✓（值迭代）、唯一性 ✓（v* 唯一，π* 不一定）、随机性 ✓（可随机，必有确定）。
en: All four questions settled: existence ✓ (fixed point), algorithm ✓ (value iteration), uniqueness ✓ (v* unique, π* not necessarily), stochasticity ✓ (may be stochastic, deterministic always exists).

title.zh: 解 BOE：v* 与 π* 都到手
title.en: Solving the BOE: Getting Both v* and π*

zh: 方向搞反的经典误会：「得先有 π* 才能算 v*」。恰恰相反：BOE 里根本没有 π 这个未知数——$\max_{\pi}$ 只是个记号，消元之后方程 v = $\max_{a}$(即时均值 + $\gamma \Sigma_{s '}$p·v) 里只剩 v。所以顺序永远是先解 v*，再贪心提取 π*（定理 3.5）；π* 是 v* 的附属品，不是前提。同族误会还有：「值迭代每轮在评估某个具体策略」——并没有，中间量 $v_{k}$ 不满足任何策略的 Bellman 方程（第 4 章开篇的警告专门回击这一点）。
en: The classic direction error: "you need π* before you can compute v*". Exactly backwards: the BOE contains no unknown π — $\max_{\pi}$ is mere notation, and after elimination the equation v = $\max_{a}$(immediate mean + $\gamma \Sigma_{s '}$p·v) holds v alone. The order is always solve v* first, then extract π* greedily (Theorem 3.5); π* is a by-product of v*, never a prerequisite. A cousin misconception: "each round of value iteration evaluates some concrete policy" — it does not; the intermediate $v_{k}$ satisfies no policy’s Bellman equation (the warning at the head of Chapter 4 strikes precisely this).

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: BOE 最大的实用价值：它是一台策略实验机。逐状态的表达式里有三个旋钮——即时奖励 r、折扣率 γ、模型 p——拧动旋钮重解 BOE，就能看到最优策略如何变形。书里的基线是 5×5 世界（$r_{\text{boundary}} = r_{\text{forbidden}}$ = −1、$r_{\text{target}}$ = 1、$r_{\text{other}}$ = 0）：γ = 0.9 时最优策略敢于穿越禁区——从 (4,1) 出发宁可吃两个 −1 也要走近路，因为 γ 大，远处的 +1 很值钱，算总账穿越更划算。这就是「远视」。
en: The BOE's greatest practical value: it is a policy experiment machine. Its elementwise form has three knobs — the immediate reward r, the discount rate γ, and the model p — and twisting them while re-solving the BOE shows how optimal policies morph. The book's baseline is the 5×5 world ($r_{\text{boundary}} = r_{\text{forbidden}}$ = −1, $r_{\text{target}}$ = 1, $r_{\text{other}}$ = 0): at γ = 0.9 the optimal policy dares to cross forbidden cells — from (4,1) it prefers eating two −1s on the shortcut, because a large γ makes the distant +1 precious and the total favours crossing. That is far-sightedness.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: 数值演算（书 Ch.1 的 3×3 世界，γ = 0.9）：最优策略真的会穿禁区。在 s3 处摆出两个候选动作（node 按转移表 T3、奖励表 R3SYM 实算）：向下 a3 直插禁区 s6（即时 −1），再一步进目标：q*(s3,a3) = −1 + 0.9×10 = 8；向左 a4 绕行 s2 一路下去：q*(s3,a4) = 0 + 0.9×8.1 = 7.29。max 取前者——v*(s3) = 8，最优策略心甘情愿吃那记 −1 换两步近路。同一张解表还能读出 v*(s9) = 10 = 1/(1−γ)（原地领奖）、v*(s1) = 7.29 = 0.9×8.1。把 γ 调到 0.5 重解：q*(s3,a3) = −1 + 0.5×2 = 0 < q*(s3,a4) = 0.25，最优策略立刻改绕行——「远视敢闯、近视保守」在同一格上量化呈现。
en: A numeric run (the book’s Ch.1 3×3 world, γ = 0.9): the optimal policy really does cross forbidden cells. Lay out the two candidate actions at s3 (computed in node from the transition table T3 and reward table R3SYM): down a3 dives into the forbidden s6 (immediate −1), then one step into the target: q*(s3,a3) = −1 + 0.9×10 = 8; left a4 detours down via s2: q*(s3,a4) = 0 + 0.9×8.1 = 7.29. The max takes the former — v*(s3) = 8, the optimal policy gladly eats the −1 for the two-step shortcut. The same solution table reads off v*(s9) = 10 = 1/(1−γ) (collecting in place) and v*(s1) = 7.29 = 0.9×8.1. Re-solve with γ = 0.5: q*(s3,a3) = −1 + 0.5×2 = 0 < q*(s3,a4) = 0.25 — the optimal policy switches to the detour at once. "Far-sighted dares, near-sighted detours", quantified on a single cell.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: γ = 0.5：不敢冒险了。禁区惩罚被折现放大（眼前 −1 太痛），最优策略改为绕开全部禁区、走远路——短视的策略保守行事。
en: γ = 0.5: risk appetite gone. The forbidden penalty now stings in the present, so the optimal policy detours around every forbidden cell — a short-sighted policy behaves conservatively.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: γ = 0：彻底近视。未来全被抹零，每格只挑即时奖励最大的动作——结果是智能体在原地打转，根本到不了目标。目标导向行为需要 γ > 0，这是「折扣率不只是数学补丁」的最直接证据。
en: γ = 0: utterly short-sighted. The future is zeroed out; each state grabs the best immediate reward — the agent spins in place and never reaches the target. Goal-directed behaviour needs γ > 0: the most direct evidence that the discount rate is more than a mathematical patch.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: $r_{\text{forbidden}}$: −1 → −10：惩罚加码。即使 γ = 0.9，禁区也变得碰不得，最优策略改为绕行。奖励设计是行为设计——想让机器人怕什么，就加大那部分的负奖励。
en: $r_{\text{forbidden}}$: −1 → −10: harsher punishment. Even at γ = 0.9 forbidden cells become untouchable and the optimal policy detours. Reward design is behaviour design — to make the robot fear something, enlarge that negative reward.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: 价值的空间分布：所有例子里，离目标越近价值越高，越远越低——每远一步就多打一次 γ 折。价值图天然是一张「等高线地图」，目标就是峰顶。
en: Spatial pattern of values: in every example, states nearer the target hold higher values — each extra step discounts once more. The value map is naturally a contour map with the target at the peak.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: 仿射不变性（定理 3.6）：把所有奖励 r 换成 αr + β（α > 0），最优策略纹丝不动，最优值只做同样的仿射变换 v′ = αv* + β/(1−γ)·1。这回收了 L1 Q&A 的伏笔：「全部奖励设成负数也没关系」——起作用的是奖励的相对大小。实用推论：想让某件事「相对更贵」，调 α（放大差距）有用，统一加 β 没用。
en: Affine invariance (Theorem 3.6): replacing every reward r by αr + β (α > 0) leaves the optimal policy untouched, while optimal values transform affinely, v′ = αv* + β/(1−γ)·1. This cashes in L1's Q&A voucher: "all-negative rewards are fine" — relative sizes are all that matter. Practical corollary: to make one thing relatively pricier, scale α (spread the gaps); a uniform shift β does nothing.

title.zh: γ 和奖励如何摆布最优策略
title.en: How γ and Rewards Bend Optimal Policies

zh: 行随机阵满足 ，常数平移 同步加到所有动作上， 排序丝毫不变

title.zh: 绕路之谜：为什么 r_other = 0 也不会绕远？
title.en: The Detour Puzzle: Why r_other = 0 Still Yields Short Paths

zh: 一个自然的担忧：走路不扣钱（$r_{\text{other}}$ = 0），智能体会不会故意兜风再进目标？不会——γ 天生惩罚绕路。2×2 小例：两条策略只差 s2 一格。直走：s2 → s4，回报 1 + γ + γ² + … = 1/(1−γ) = 10；绕路：s2 → s1 → s3 → s4，回报 0 + γ·0 + γ²·1 + … = γ²/(1−γ) = 8.1。同样的奖励流，晚到两步就打两次折。折扣率本身就是「时间成本」。
en: A natural worry: walking is free ($r_{\text{other}}$ = 0), so might the agent take a joyride before entering the target? No — γ punishes detours by birth. The 2×2 example: two policies differing only at s2. Direct: s2 → s4, return 1 + γ + γ² + … = 1/(1−γ) = 10. Detour: s2 → s1 → s3 → s4, return 0 + γ·0 + γ²·1 + … = γ²/(1−γ) = 8.1. Same reward stream, two steps later means discounted twice. The discount rate is itself a cost of time.

title.zh: 绕路之谜：为什么 r_other = 0 也不会绕远？
title.en: The Detour Puzzle: Why r_other = 0 Still Yields Short Paths

zh: 新手误解粉碎机：「要让智能体尽快到目标，得给每步加个负奖励（比如 −1）吧？」——不需要，而且加了也白加：给所有奖励统一加一个数是仿射变换，最优策略不变。γ 已经在惩罚时间了。真正要改快慢行为时，动 γ 或者动相对奖励差，而不是全民加税。
en: Beginner-misconception crusher: "To make the agent hurry, add a negative reward (say −1) to every step?" — unnecessary, and useless anyway: shifting all rewards by a constant is an affine transformation, which preserves the optimal policy. γ already charges for time. To change hurry-behaviour, tune γ or the relative reward gaps, not a universal tax.

title.zh: 绕路之谜：为什么 r_other = 0 也不会绕远？
title.en: The Detour Puzzle: Why r_other = 0 Still Yields Short Paths

zh: 网格里的绕路之谜至此了结，但“绕路”在本章还有第二现场：学习者本人。智能体绕远路有 γ 收利息，学习者绕弯路没人收费——只会悄悄多花几周。下面三条是本章最高频的弯路，出发前对照一遍。
en: That settles the gridworld detour puzzle, but “detour” has a second scene in this chapter: the learner. The agent pays γ-interest for detours; nobody bills the learner for wandering — it just quietly costs weeks. The three most frequented detours, for a pre-departure check:

title.zh: 绕路之谜：为什么 r_other = 0 也不会绕远？
title.en: The Detour Puzzle: Why r_other = 0 Still Yields Short Paths

zh: 弯路一：“先枚举所有策略，再挑最好的。”听着严谨，实为不做事：3×3 世界的确定性策略已有 5⁹ ≈ 195 万条，作业 4×4 是 5¹⁶ ≈ 1526 亿条。BOE 的全部意义就是把“寻优”改写成“解一个方程”，让 max 在方程内部替你完成比较。弯路二：“把 v* 当 $v_{\pi}$ 的特例来算。”设想用 L2 的评估机器：喂一个策略、得一张价值表，多试几个总能撞上 v*——方向反了。评估的输入是 π，而 π* 恰恰是你未知的东西；BOE 把数据流倒转：$\max_{\pi}$ 消元之后方程里没有 π，先解 v*，π* 贪心白送。弯路三：“最优策略就是贪心策略”，丢了限定词。贪心必须相对某张价值表才有意义：对 v* 贪心 ⟹ 最优（定理 3.5）；对某策略的 $v_{\pi}$ 贪心 ⟹ 通常是改进而非最优（L4 策略迭代的改进步干的正是这个）；对值迭代中间的 $v_{k}$ 贪心 ⟹ 只是过程快照，收敛前不保证最优。贪心是相对量，最优是绝对量，两者隔着一张价值表的距离。
en: Detour 1: “Enumerate all policies first, then pick the best.” Sounds rigorous, accomplishes nothing: the 3×3 world already has 5⁹ ≈ 1.95 million deterministic policies, the 4×4 assignment 5¹⁶ ≈ 1.5×10¹¹. The whole point of the BOE is to rewrite “searching” as “solving one equation”, letting the max do the comparing inside it. Detour 2: “Compute v* as a special case of $v_{\pi}$.” The plan: use L2’s evaluation machine — feed in a policy, receive a value table, try enough of them and one must be v*. Direction reversed: evaluation takes π as input, and π* is exactly the thing you do not know; the BOE flips the data flow — after the $\max_{\pi}$ elimination no π remains in the equation, so solve v* first and π* comes free by greed. Detour 3: “The optimal policy is the greedy policy” — losing the qualifier. Greedy means something only relative to a value table: greedy w.r.t. v* ⟹ optimal (Theorem 3.5); greedy w.r.t. some policy’s $v_{\pi}$ ⟹ usually an improvement, not yet optimal (exactly the improvement step of L4’s policy iteration); greedy w.r.t. an intermediate $v_{k}$ of value iteration ⟹ a snapshot in progress, not guaranteed optimal before convergence. Greedy is relative, optimal is absolute — the gap between them is one value table wide.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 本章把「最优」从愿望变成了可计算的对象。概念上：最优策略由逐格的状态值比较定义，其值即最优状态值。工具上：BOE 把最优性写进方程，它的右端是压缩映射，压缩映射定理一步到位地给出存在性、唯一性、迭代算法与收敛速度。解出 v* 后贪心提取 π*，定理 3.4 保证这就是最优。γ 与奖励两个旋钮决定最优策略的形状——远视/近视、敢闯/保守，全是参数的表达。
en: This chapter turned "optimal" from a wish into a computable object. Conceptually: the optimal policy is defined by cell-wise state-value comparison, and its values are the optimal state values. Tool-wise: the BOE writes optimality into an equation whose right side is a contraction, and the contraction mapping theorem instantly yields existence, uniqueness, an iterative algorithm, and its rate. Solve for v*, extract π* greedily, and Theorem 3.4 certifies optimality. The two knobs γ and reward shape the optimal policy — far-sighted or short-sighted, bold or conservative are all parameter expressions.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 定义最优：状态值逐格 ≥ 一切策略者为最优。先有定义才谈得上寻找；它立刻生出四问（存在？唯一？随机？可算？），回答需要一个方程。
en: Define optimality: the policy cell-wise ≥ all others is optimal. Only with a definition does seeking begin; it instantly births four questions (existence? uniqueness? stochastic? computable?) whose answer requires an equation.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 把最优写进方程（BOE）：v(s) = $\max_{\pi (s)}$ $\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)q(s,a)。例 3.2 消元：最优局部策略必“全押最大 q”，π 被请出方程，只剩 v = f(v)。
en: Write optimality into an equation (BOE): v(s) = $\max_{\pi (s)}$ $\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)q(s,a). Example 3.2 eliminates π — the optimal local policy goes all-in on the greatest q — leaving v = f(v).

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 非线性，请压缩映射：max 不可拆，L2 的线性代数谢幕；f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v) 恰是 ∞-范数下系数 γ 的压缩映射——定理 3.3 一次交付存在、唯一、值迭代与指数收敛。
en: Nonlinear — call in contraction: the max will not distribute, so L2’s linear algebra exits; f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v) is exactly a contraction of factor γ in the ∞-norm — Theorem 3.3 delivers existence, uniqueness, value iteration, and exponential rate in one stroke.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 求解收网：v* 贪心提取 π*（定理 3.5，必有确定性最优）；定理 3.4 认证 v* = $v_{\pi *} \ge v_{\pi}$ 对一切 π。四问全部销账。
en: Solve and seal: extract π* greedily from v* (Theorem 3.5, a deterministic optimum always exists); Theorem 3.4 certifies v* = $v_{\pi *} \ge v_{\pi}$ for every π. All four questions cleared.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 路线分岔：走 v* 要模型加权（L4 值迭代 / 策略迭代）；直接估 q* 可甩掉模型（L5 蒙特卡洛、L7 TD / Q-learning）。两条路终点相同——贪心提取 π*。
en: The routes fork: the v* route needs model weighting (L4’s value / policy iteration); estimating q* directly sheds the model (L5 Monte Carlo, L7 TD / Q-learning). Both routes end at the same place — greedy extraction of π*.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: L2 / L3 对照卡。方程：线性 $v_{\pi} = r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{\pi}$（π 给定后 $r_{\pi}$、$P_{\pi}$ 是常数）vs 非线性 v = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v)（max 不可拆，且用哪个 $P_{\pi}$ 本身取决于 max）。解：有闭式解 (I − γ$P_{\pi}$)⁻¹$r_{\pi}$ vs 无闭式解，只能压缩映射迭代。对象：$v_{\pi}$ 是“某条策略的成绩单”，策略有多少张、成绩单就有多少张 vs v* 唯一，是全体策略的天花板，又恰是最优策略的成绩单（v* = $v_{\pi *}$）。工具：线性代数 vs 不动点定理。不变的是引擎：两者都靠 γ < 1 收敛，迭代式只差一个 max。
en: The L2/L3 contrast card. Equation: linear $v_{\pi} = r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{\pi}$ (with π given, $r_{\pi} and P_{\pi}$ are constants) vs nonlinear v = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v) (the max does not distribute, and which $P_{\pi}$ applies itself depends on the max). Solution: a closed form exists, (I − γ$P_{\pi}$)⁻¹$r_{\pi}$, vs no closed form — contraction iteration only. Object: $v_{\pi}$ is one policy’s report card, one per policy, vs the unique v*, the ceiling over all policies and simultaneously the optimal policy’s own card (v* = $v_{\pi *}$). Tools: linear algebra vs fixed-point theory. What stays is the engine: both converge on γ < 1, and the two iterations differ by a single max.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 行李清单上其实只有一张票：压缩映射定理。L4 的三个算法全是它的兑现——值迭代 = 定理 3.3 的迭代式加上截断与停止准则（把 ε 换算成真实误差上界，用的正是压缩系数 γ）；策略迭代 = 反复调用 L2 的评估 + 本章的贪心改进；截断策略迭代夹在中间，评估只跑 j 步就敢改进，底气仍是“误差每轮被 γ 压走一份”。再往后，第 5、7 章的采样算法不再握有精确的 f，但“评估与改进两个互相纠错的循环交替运行”这个骨架原样保留——广义策略迭代是它的名字。带着 v*、π* 和这张票进 L4。
en: The packing list really holds one ticket: the contraction mapping theorem. All three algorithms of L4 redeem it — value iteration is Theorem 3.3’s update plus truncation and stopping rules (converting ε into a true error bound leans exactly on the contraction factor γ); policy iteration repeatedly calls L2’s evaluation followed by this chapter’s greedy improvement; truncated policy iteration sits between, daring to improve after only j evaluation steps, still on the strength of “every round compresses the error by one γ-share”. Farther on, the sampling algorithms of Chapters 5 and 7 no longer hold an exact f, yet the skeleton — evaluation and improvement, two mutually correcting loops in alternation — survives verbatim under the name generalised policy iteration. Pack v*, π*, and this ticket for L4.

title.zh: 本章总结：最优性从定义变成算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: Optimality Turns from Definition into Algorithm

zh: 下一课预告：定理 3.3 的迭代式 $v_{k+1} = \max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$) 就是值迭代。第 4 章给它完整实现与收敛分析，并介绍它的孪生兄弟——策略迭代（先精确评估、再贪心改进，上一课那个「换最大 q」的放大版）。
en: Next lecture teaser: Theorem 3.3's iteration $v_{k+1} = \max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$) IS value iteration. Chapter 4 implements it fully with convergence analysis and introduces its twin, policy iteration (evaluate exactly, then improve greedily — the scaled-up version of L3's "swap in the greatest q" move).

title.zh: 连贯长推理：从「换一步」到「最优性定理」
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: From Swapping One Step to the Optimality Theorem

zh: 本章推理链：改进一步（q 比较）→ 定义最优 → 把最优写进方程（max）→ 双未知数逐个击破 → 非线性方程请压缩映射 → f 压缩 ⟹ 解存在唯一可迭代 → 贪心提取 π* → 最优性定理收网。逐步走。
en: This chapter's spine: improve one step (q comparison) → define optimality → write it into the equation (max) → crack the two unknowns one by one → contraction mappings for the nonlinear equation → f contracts, so the solution exists, is unique and iterable → extract π* greedily → the optimality theorem seals it. Walk it step by step.

title.zh: 代码精讲：值迭代，15 行解出最优
title.en: Code Walkthrough: Value Iteration, Optimal in ~15 Lines

zh: 定理 3.3 的迭代式翻译成代码短得惊人。下面是在 4×4 作业同款世界上的完整值迭代 + 贪心提取——跑完直接得到最优策略和最优价值。它和 L2 策略评估代码只差一个 max：评估是「给定 π 求平均」，迭代是「每格先挑最好的动作再更新」。
en: Theorem 3.3's iteration translates into shockingly short code. Below is complete value iteration + greedy extraction on the assignment's 4×4 world — run it and you hold the optimal policy and values. It differs from L2's policy-evaluation code by a single max: evaluation averages a given π, iteration first picks each cell's best action, then updates.

title.zh: 代码精讲：值迭代，15 行解出最优
title.en: Code Walkthrough: Value Iteration, Optimal in ~15 Lines

zh: 与 L2 的对照记忆法：策略评估 $v_{k+1} = r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$ 是「沿着给定策略走」，值迭代 $v_{k+1} = \max_{a}(r + \gamma v)$ 是「每步都踩最优」。两者都是压缩映射、都指数收敛；前者解线性方程，后者解非线性方程。这个对照就是第 4 章「广义策略迭代」框架的雏形。
en: A mnemonic against L2: policy evaluation $v_{k+1} = r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$ "walks a given policy", value iteration $v_{k+1} = \max_{a}(r + \gamma v)$ "steps on the best every time". Both are contraction mappings converging exponentially; the former solves a linear system, the latter a nonlinear one. This contrast is the embryo of Chapter 4's generalised policy iteration.

title.zh: 问答：最优性十连问（精选）
title.en: Q&A: Ten Questions on Optimality (Selected)

zh: 书上的十个问答把本章钉得死死的，这里精选六张卡片 + 一张「旋钮速查」。
en: The book's ten Q&As nail this chapter shut; six selected cards plus one knob cheat-sheet follow.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 从全零价值表开始。先看 2×2 网格，从 s₁ 往下会到 s₃。预测做完一次价值更新后，表中这个动作的评分，再点「一轮」核对。
en: Start with zero state values. In the 2×2 grid, down takes s₁ to s₃. Predict the score for down after one value update, then advance one sweep.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: L3 的定理 3.3 说「$v_{k+1}$ = f($v_{k}$) 能解 BOE」，本章把这句话落成可执行的算法。值迭代的每一轮分两步：策略更新（policy update）$\pi_{k+1} = \arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$)——对着当前的 v 挑最好的策略（逐状态看就是贪心）；价值更新（value update）$v_{k+1} = r_{\pi_{k+1}}$ + γ$P_{\pi_{k+1}}$$v_{k}$——沿着刚挑的策略走一步。逐元素合并后，每轮就是那个熟悉的节奏：
en: L3's Theorem 3.3 promised that "$v_{k+1}$ = f($v_{k}$) solves the BOE"; this chapter turns the promise into an executable algorithm. Each iteration of value iteration has two steps: a policy update $\pi_{k+1} = \arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{k}$) — pick the best policy for the current v (greedy, state by state); and a value update $v_{k+1} = r_{\pi_{k+1}}$ + γ$P_{\pi_{k+1}}$$v_{k}$ — take one step along the freshly picked policy. Merged elementwise, each round is the familiar rhythm:

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 值迭代的单轮节奏 · One iteration of value iteration

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 书上一处极容易被忽略的提醒：迭代过程中的 $v_{k}$ 不是状态值！它一般不满足任何策略的 Bellman 方程（既不是 $v_{\pi_{k}}$ 也不是 $v_{\pi_{k+1}}$），只是算法的中间产物；同理 $q_{k}$ 也不是动作价值。它们只是恰好收敛到最优值而已。考试和作业里都要把这个说法写对。
en: A reminder from the book that is easy to skim past: the intermediate $v_{k}$ is not a state value! In general it satisfies no policy’s Bellman equation (neither $v_{\pi_{k}} nor v_{\pi_{k+1}}$) — it is merely an intermediate quantity of the algorithm; likewise $q_{k}$ is not an action value. They merely happen to converge to the optimal values. Phrase this correctly in exams and reports.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 收敛性从哪来？兑现 L3 的那张票。把一轮迭代看作映射 f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v)（Bellman 最优算子）。L3 定理 3.2 已经证明：∞-范数下 f 是系数恰为 γ 的压缩映射；定理 3.1（Banach 不动点定理）随即兑现承诺——压缩映射有唯一不动点，且从任意初值出发迭代都收敛到它，这个不动点正是 BOE 的解 v*。压缩还白送一条速率信息：每轮误差至多为上一轮的 γ 倍，收敛是几何式（指数式）的。γ 越接近 1，这个最坏情形上界下降得越慢。
en: Where does convergence come from? Cashing L3’s ticket. View one iteration as the map f(v) = $\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$v), the Bellman optimality operator. L3’s Theorem 3.2 already proved f is a contraction with factor exactly γ in the ∞-norm; Theorem 3.1 (the Banach fixed-point theorem) then honours the promise — a contraction has a unique fixed point, iteration from any initial value converges to it, and that fixed point is exactly the BOE’s solution v*. Contraction throws in a rate for free: the error contracts by a factor of at most γ per round, geometric (exponential) convergence. The closer γ is to 1, the slower the squeeze — the speed is dictated entirely by γ.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: （误差每轮至多为上一轮的 γ 倍：γ = 0.9 时约 22 轮缩小 10 倍）

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 书上用 2×2 世界把 Algorithm 4.1 手工跑了两轮：k=0 时 v₀ = 0，q 表全是即时奖励，贪心挑出 π₁（s1 处 a₅ 和 a₃ 并列最大、随便选一个——这正是「最优策略不必唯一」的现场演示）；k=1 时 π₂ 已经是最优策略。下面自己跑一遍，对照书里的 Table 4.2/4.3。
en: The book hand-runs Algorithm 4.1 for two rounds on a 2×2 world: at k=0 with v₀ = 0 the q-table is all immediate rewards, and the greedy π₁ (a₅ and a₃ tie at s1 — pick either, a live demonstration that "optimal policies need not be unique"); at k=1 π₂ is already optimal. Run it yourself below and check against the book's Tables 4.2/4.3.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

en: A numeric run (the book’s Ch.1 3×3 world, γ = 0.9, v₀ = 0). Round 1 degenerates the q-table to pure immediate rewards: v₁ = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 1] — only states touching the target in one step are nonzero; round 2 propagates values one cell outward: v₂ = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0.9, 1.9, 0.9, 1.9, 1.9]. Iterating to the end, v* = [7.29, 8.1, 8, 8.1, 9, 10, 9, 10, 10] — note the 10 at s9 is 1/(1−γ), with "collect in place" the optimal action. Three patterns you can verify by hand: the round-to-round gap $\| v_{k+1} - v_{k} \| _{\infty}$ is exactly $0.9^{k}$ (1, 0.9, 0.81, …); the true error $\| v_{k} - v* \| _{\infty}$ = 9 × $0.9^{k - 1}$, matching the contraction prediction round by round; and $v_{k}(s9)$ = 10(1 − $0.9^{k}$) — the missing chunk to convergence fills in as a geometric series.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 策略比价值先到站。在同一个 3×3 世界里跟踪贪心策略：π₃ 已经等于最优策略（s1 处 a2/a3 并列，选哪个都最优），此后每轮稳定不动；而此时 v₃(s9) = 2.71，离极限 10 还远。价值要几十轮才收敛，策略往往提前很久就「定型」——近最优的价值足以排出正确的动作名次。工程含义：不必等 v 完全收敛，「贪心策略连续几轮不再变化」是更实用的停止信号，也是下一节策略迭代停止条件的设计思路。
en: The policy arrives before the value. Track the greedy policy in the same 3×3 world: π₃ already equals an optimal policy (a2/a3 tie at s1 — either choice is optimal) and never changes again, while v₃(s9) = 2.71 is still far from its limit 10. Values take dozens of rounds to converge; policies often settle much earlier — a near-optimal value already ranks the actions correctly. Practical moral: no need to wait for v to converge; "the greedy policy has stopped changing for a few rounds" is a better stopping signal, and it is exactly the design idea behind policy iteration’s stopping condition in the next section.

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 截断停止：ε 与真实误差的换算。实践不可能迭代到无穷，通常当 $\| v_{k+1} - v_{k} \| _{\infty}$ < ε 就停。但相邻两轮的差不是当前误差——ε 必须换算成 $\| v_{k} - v* \| _{\infty}$ 的上界。推导只用压缩性一步：把 $v_{k}$ − v* 写成 f($v_{k - 1}$) − f(v*)，先压缩再接一次三角不等式，把 $v_{k - 1}$ − v* 换成可观测的 $v_{k} - v_{k - 1}$，解出不等式——
en: Truncated stopping: converting ε into a true error bound. Practice cannot iterate forever; we usually stop when $\| v_{k+1} - v_{k} \| _{\infty}$ < ε. But the gap between consecutive rounds is not the current error — ε must be converted into a bound on $\| v_{k} - v* \| _{\infty}$. The derivation takes one contraction step: write $v_{k}$ − v* = f($v_{k - 1}$) − f(v*), contract once, then chain one triangle inequality to trade the unobservable $v_{k - 1}$ − v* for the observable $v_{k} - v_{k - 1}$, and solve —
