title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

title.zh: 值迭代：L3 那张「票」今天兑现
title.en: Value Iteration: Cashing the Ticket from L3

zh: 两个高频误区。① 把取过 argmax 的 v 当 q 用：$v_{k+1}(s) = \max_{a}$ $q_{k}(s,a)$ 是「取过 max 的结果」，已不是任何动作的价值；改进步需要的是 q 表本身——把 max 后的那列当成动作值再做加权平均，结果是张冠李戴的错误数。② 把 ε 当真实误差上报：‖Δv‖ < ε 只保证 ‖$v_{k}$ − v*‖ ≤ γε/(1−γ)——γ = 0.9 时两者差 9 倍。写报告时给换算后的界，别给 ε 本身。
en: Two frequent misconceptions. ① Using the argmaxed v as if it were q: $v_{k+1}(s) = \max_{a}$ $q_{k}(s,a)$ is the result after taking the max and is no longer the value of any action; the improvement step needs the q-table itself — treating the max column as action values and averaging over them produces a wrong number with the right-looking shape. ② Reporting ε as the true error: ‖Δv‖ < ε only guarantees ‖$v_{k}$ − v*‖ ≤ γε/(1−γ) — a factor-9 gap at γ = 0.9. Quote the converted bound in reports, not ε itself.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 策略迭代换一个角度组织同样的零件。每轮两步：策略评估（PE）——解 Bellman 方程 $v_{\pi_{k}} = r_{\pi_{k}}$ + γ$P_{\pi_{k}}$$v_{\pi_{k}}$，把当前策略的分数算清楚（闭式解或 L2 的迭代解都行）；策略改进（PI）——$\pi_{k+1} = \arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{\pi_{k}}$)，也就是 L3 开场那个「换上 q 最大的动作」的全网格放大版。
en: Policy iteration organises the same parts from a different angle. Each round has two steps: policy evaluation (PE) — solve the Bellman equation $v_{\pi_{k}} = r_{\pi_{k}}$ + γ$P_{\pi_{k}}$$v_{\pi_{k}}$ to grade the current policy properly (closed-form or L2's iterative solution); and policy improvement (PI) — $\pi_{k+1} = \arg\max_{\pi} ( r_{\pi}$ + γ$P_{\pi}$$v_{\pi_{k}}$), the grid-wide scale-up of L3's "swap in the greatest q" move.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 三连问由书逐条回答。① 评估怎么做？闭式解管理论、迭代解管实践（内嵌一个 L2 式的循环——「迭代里套迭代」）。② 为什么改进后一定更好？引理 4.1：$v_{\pi_{k+1}} \ge v_{\pi_{k}}$ 逐格成立。③ 为什么收敛到最优？定理 4.1 的证明极漂亮——把策略迭代和值迭代从同一起点并排跑，归纳可证 $v_{k} \le v_{\pi_{k}}$ ≤ v*：策略迭代每一步都压着值迭代打，而值迭代已知收敛到 v*，所以 $v_{\pi_{k}}$ 单调递增、上界 v*，由单调收敛定理直奔 v*。策略迭代收敛更快，正是「评估得更彻底」换来的。
en: Three questions, answered in the book one by one. ① How to evaluate? Closed-form for theory, iterative for practice (an L2-style loop nested inside — an iteration inside an iteration). ② Why does improvement help? Lemma 4.1: $v_{\pi_{k+1}} \ge v_{\pi_{k}}$ holds elementwise. ③ Why converge to optimal? The proof of Theorem 4.1 is a beauty — race policy iteration against value iteration from the same start and inductively show $v_{k} \le v_{\pi_{k}}$ ≤ v*: policy iteration dominates value iteration at every step, and since value iteration converges to v*, the monotone nondecreasing sequence $v_{\pi_{k}}$, bounded above by v*, marches to v* by the monotone convergence theorem. Policy iteration converges faster precisely because it evaluates more thoroughly.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 引理 4.1 的论证骨架（$v_{\pi '} \ge v_{\pi}$ 逐格成立）。设 π′ 是对着 $v_{\pi}$ 的贪心改进，分三步。第一步种下「种子」不等式：$q_{\pi}$(s, π′(s)) = $\max_{a}$ $q_{\pi}(s,a) \ge \Sigma_{a}$ π(a|s) $q_{\pi}(s,a) = v_{\pi}(s)$——贪心动作的 q 不小于按 π 加权的平均。第二步沿 π′ 展开有限 n 步：$v_{\pi '}(s)$ ≥ E[$r_{0}$ + γ$r_{1}$ + … + $\gamma^{n - 1}$$r_{n - 1} + \gamma^{n}$$v_{\pi} ( s_{n}$)]，每换一步用一次种子。第三步令 n → ∞：$\gamma^{n}$ 项消失，右端恰好回到 $v_{\pi}(s)$ 的定义。结论：改进要么严格发生，要么 $v_{\pi '} = v_{\pi}$——后者意味着贪心策略已满足 Bellman 最优方程，π 已是最优。
en: The skeleton of Lemma 4.1 ($v_{\pi '} \ge v_{\pi}$ elementwise). Let π′ be the greedy improvement with respect to $v_{\pi}$; three moves. First, plant the seed inequality: $q_{\pi}$(s, π′(s)) = $\max_{a}$ $q_{\pi}(s,a) \ge \Sigma_{a}$ π(a|s) $q_{\pi}(s,a) = v_{\pi}(s)$ — the greedy action’s q is at least the π-weighted average. Second, expand $v_{\pi '}$ along π′ for a finite horizon n: $v_{\pi '}(s)$ ≥ E[$r_{0}$ + γ$r_{1}$ + … + $\gamma^{n - 1}$$r_{n - 1} + \gamma^{n}$$v_{\pi} ( s_{n}$)], invoking the seed once per step. Third, let n → ∞: the $\gamma^{n}$ term dies and the right-hand side is exactly the definition of $v_{\pi}(s)$. Conclusion: improvement is either strict, or $v_{\pi '} = v_{\pi}$ — and in the latter case the greedy policy already satisfies the Bellman optimality equation, so π is optimal.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: （严格改进，或已最优——二者必居其一）

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 为什么策略迭代能「有限步」终止？数一数策略的总数：|S| 个状态、每个从 |A| 个动作里挑一个，确定性策略至多 $|A|^{|S|}$ 个。引理 4.1 保证每轮严格改进或已最优——严格改进意味着同一个策略不可能第二次出现（再出现就与「更严格」矛盾），序列又被 v* 封顶。于是至多 $|A|^{|S|}$ 轮内到达最优策略，精确终止。这与值迭代形成鲜明对照：VI 渐近收敛、理论上永远差一点；PI 在离散世界里有限步直达。当然 $|A|^{|S|}$ 是天文数字，实际轮数远小于它——单调爬坡总能很快攀到好的策略。
en: Why does policy iteration terminate in finitely many steps? Count the policies: |S| states each choosing from |A| actions gives at most $|A|^{|S|}$ deterministic policies. Lemma 4.1 guarantees each round strictly improves or is already optimal — strict improvement means no policy can ever reappear (a reappearance contradicts strictness), and the sequence is capped by v*. So within at most $|A|^{|S|}$ rounds the optimal policy is reached and the algorithm stops exactly. Contrast with value iteration: VI converges asymptotically and is never quite there in theory; PI lands exactly, in finitely many rounds, on discrete worlds. Of course $|A|^{|S|}$ is astronomical — the actual count is far smaller, as monotone hill-climbing reaches good policies quickly.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 每轮代价：VI 一轮 = 一次全状态×动作的 q 扫描（|S|·|A| 次 Bellman 核）；PI 一轮 = 内层解 Bellman 方程（若干次全扫描）+ 一次贪心。单轮 PI 更贵。
en: Per-round cost: one VI round = a single full state×action q-sweep (|S|·|A| Bellman cores); one PI round = solving the Bellman equation (several full sweeps) plus one greedy pass. PI rounds are pricier.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 轮数：PI 评估「彻底」，外层轮数极少；VI 每轮只走一步，外层轮数多。总扫描数常常 PI 更省——上面的赛跑实验台可以直接验证这一点。
en: Number of rounds: PI’s thorough evaluation keeps the outer count tiny; VI takes one step per round and needs many more. In total sweeps PI usually spends less — verify it yourself with the race button in the lab above.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 中间量与可解释性：VI 只需一个 v 向量，中间量「名不正」；PI 的中间量是货真价实的 $v_{\pi_{k}}$，随时可以拿来解释、校验，也让「策略不变即停」成为合法的停止条件。
en: Intermediates and interpretability: VI needs only one v vector, with intermediates of dubious status; PI’s intermediates are bona fide $v_{\pi_{k}}$, ready to be inspected and validated — which also makes "stop when the policy stops changing" a legitimate stopping rule.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 实践折中：两个极端都不必死守——把评估步截断到 j 步（§4.3）常常总计算量最小。
en: Practical compromise: neither extreme is sacred — truncating the evaluation to j steps (§4.3) often minimises total compute.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 工程细节：原地更新与扫描顺序。上面所有算法在同一轮内用的都是「旧值」（同步、Jacobi 式）。改成原地更新（in-place，Gauss–Seidel 式）——同一轮里后扫到的状态直接读刚算出的新值——信息传播更快，收敛通常加速，而 γ-压缩给出的收敛保证不被破坏（这是教科书标准的异步值迭代结论）。扫描顺序同样影响速度：从目标附近向外扫，新值恰好沿价值传播的方向走，比固定顺序少几个「空转」轮。这两个技巧不改算法的数学，只改它跑起来的速度——第 7 章 TD「来一个样本更一个值」，正是这种思想推到极致。
en: Engineering detail: in-place updates and sweep order. Everything above reads the "old" values within a round (synchronous, Jacobi-style). Switching to in-place updates (Gauss–Seidel style) — later states in the same sweep read freshly computed values — propagates information faster and usually accelerates convergence, without breaking the γ-contraction guarantee (a standard textbook result on asynchronous value iteration). Sweep order matters too: sweeping outward from the target lets new values travel along the direction of value propagation, saving a few idle rounds versus a fixed order. Neither trick changes the mathematics, only the speed — Chapter 7’s TD, "update on every single sample", is this idea taken to the extreme.

title.zh: 策略迭代：评估与改进的华尔兹
title.en: Policy Iteration: The Waltz of Evaluation and Improvement

zh: 书上还观察到一个悦目的现象（Figure 4.4，5×5、$r_{\text{forbidden}}$ = −10、随机初始策略）：离目标近的格子先找到最优动作，远处格子随后「沾光」——价值从目标向外涟漪式扩散。直觉：近处的格子先找到通往目标的轨迹，远处格子才能借道。这正是价值图是「等高线地图」的动态版本。
en: The book also notes a pleasing phenomenon (Figure 4.4: 5×5, $r_{\text{forbidden}}$ = −10, random initial policy): cells near the target settle on optimal actions first, and distant cells catch the wave later — values ripple outward from the target. Intuition: nearby cells must find their tracks to the target first before distant cells can ride through them. It is the dynamic version of "values are a contour map".

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 把两个算法的步骤并排写出来，它们突然变得像一对孪生兄弟：策略迭代是 PE → PI → PE → PI → …，值迭代是 PU → VU → PU → VU → …。差别只在「价值步做多满」：策略迭代的 PE 把 Bellman 方程解到底（无穷多内层迭代）；值迭代的 VU 只走一步。表 4.6 逐行对照证明：若从同一起点出发，前几步两者完全一致，第四步开始分道——值迭代少走了内层路，所以单轮便宜但轮数多。
en: Write both algorithms side by side and they suddenly look like twins: policy iteration is PE → PI → PE → PI → …, value iteration is PU → VU → PU → VU → …. The only difference is how thoroughly the value step is done: policy iteration's PE solves to the end (infinitely many inner iterations), while value iteration's VU takes one step. The book's Table 4.6 verifies row by row: from the same start the first few steps coincide; they part at step four — value iteration skips the inner road, cheaper per round but more rounds.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 统一视角 · The unified view

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 策略迭代及充分评估的截断版保证每轮所有状态的真实策略价值单调不降

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 第 1 步同源（$k=1$）：从同一起点 $v_0$ 出发并先贪心提取 $\pi_0$，则 VI 的 $v_1 = r_{\pi_0}+\gamma P_{\pi_0}v_0$ 与 PI 内层评估第 1 步 $v_{\pi_0}^{(1)}$ 数值完全相等。
en: Step 1 coincides ($k=1$): starting from the same $v_0$ and greedy $\pi_0$, VI’s $v_1 = r_{\pi_0}+\gamma P_{\pi_0}v_0$ matches PI’s first inner iterate $v_{\pi_0}^{(1)}$ identically.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 第 2 步分道（$k=2$）：VI 立刻重新贪心换出 $\pi_1$ 并算 $v_2 = r_{\pi_1}+\gamma P_{\pi_1}v_1$；PI 则把策略锁在 $\pi_0$ 上续算内层第二步 $v_{\pi_0}^{(2)} = r_{\pi_0}+\gamma P_{\pi_0}v_{\pi_0}^{(1)}$。
en: Step 2 diverges ($k=2$): VI immediately re-greedifies to $\pi_1$ for $v_2$; PI stays locked on $\pi_0$ and runs a second evaluation iterate $v_{\pi_0}^{(2)} = r_{\pi_0}+\gamma P_{\pi_0}v_{\pi_0}^{(1)}$.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 第 3–4 步分流（$k=3,4$）：VI 每步重选策略但单轮仅走一步价值更新；PI 跑完整个无穷内层求得 $v_{\pi_0}$ 后才跨步改策略，截断策略迭代恰在中间取有限步数 $j \in (1,\infty)$。
en: Steps 3–4 diverge ($k=3,4$): VI updates policy every sweep; PI solves $v_{\pi_0}$ to convergence before stepping to $\pi_1$, while truncated PI interpolates via finite $j \in (1,\infty)$.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 截断策略迭代（truncated policy iteration）把两个极端接成连续谱：评估步只跑 j 步就停下来做改进。j 小，单轮便宜、轮数多；j 大，单轮贵、轮数少。总账怎么算？下面的实验台在同一世界上扫一遍不同的 j，比一比到达最优策略各自花掉的内层扫描总数。
en: Truncated policy iteration joins the extremes into a spectrum: run the evaluation step for only j steps before improving. Small j: cheap rounds, more of them; large j: pricey rounds, fewer. How does the bill add up? The lab below sweeps several j values on the same world and compares the total inner sweeps each needs to reach the optimal policy.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 为什么「评估不彻底」也敢改进？因为贪心改进对评估误差相当鲁棒：argmax 只关心动作之间的名次，只要估计误差小于价值差距，名次不变、挑出的动作不变。这是广义策略迭代的深层优点：评估和改进都不必完美，两个互相纠错的循环交替运行，就能把彼此推向最优。第 5 章的 MC、第 7 章的 TD 全靠这一点活下来：它们的「评估」从来都不精确（样本有限），改进照样往前走。截断策略迭代是这个原理在「确定性误差」下的预演。
en: Why dare to improve on an unfinished evaluation? Because greedy improvement is robust to evaluation error: argmax cares only about the ranking of actions, and as long as the estimation error is smaller than the value gaps, the ranking — and hence the chosen action — is unchanged. This is the deep virtue of generalised policy iteration: neither evaluation nor improvement must be perfect; two mutually correcting loops, alternated, push each other toward optimality. Chapter 5’s MC and Chapter 7’s TD live entirely on this: their "evaluation" is never exact (finite samples), yet improvement marches on. Truncated policy iteration rehearses the principle with deterministic error.

title.zh: 截断策略迭代：两个极端之间的连续谱
title.en: Truncated Policy Iteration: A Spectrum Between Two Extremes

zh: 误区：截断后的策略迭代不再是（原教旨的）策略迭代。评估步没跑到底就改进，失去的是引理 4.1 的前提——你贪心针对的那个 v 不再是任何策略的真状态值，「每轮严格改进」的形式保证随之失效（理论上存在来回震荡的可能，实践中小 j 下罕见）。另一个常见混淆：j 是内层评估的迭代步数，不是外层轮数——把 j 当轮数调，等于悄悄把算法换成了另一个，还以为在调参。
en: Misconception: truncated policy iteration is no longer (plain) policy iteration. Improving before the evaluation finishes forfeits the premise of Lemma 4.1 — the v you are greedy against is no longer any policy’s true state value, so the formal guarantee of strict per-round improvement lapses (oscillation becomes possible in theory, though rare in practice for modest j). Another common mix-up: j is the number of inner evaluation iterations, not the outer round count — treating j as rounds silently swaps in a different algorithm while you think you are tuning a knob.

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 值迭代、策略迭代、截断策略迭代——三种算法共享同一个心跳：每轮两步，一步更新价值、一步更新策略。这个「价值与政策交替更新」的思想叫广义策略迭代（generalized policy iteration），它是整本强化学习的骨架：第 5 章的蒙特卡洛、第 7 章的 TD，本质上都是「评估步换成样本更新：MC 用完整回报，TD 用当前估计自举」后的策略迭代变体。
en: Value iteration, policy iteration, truncated policy iteration — three algorithms sharing one heartbeat: each round has two steps, one updating the value, one updating the policy. This alternation is called generalised policy iteration, the skeleton of all reinforcement learning: Monte Carlo in Chapter 5 and TD in Chapter 7 are essentially policy iteration with the evaluation step replaced by sample updates: MC uses returns, TD bootstraps from current estimates.

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 值迭代：价值步只走一步（PU+VU）。单轮最便宜、轮数最多；中间量不是状态值；渐近收敛，误差每轮至多为上一轮的 γ 倍，停止靠 ε 换算界。
en: Value iteration: the value step takes one step only (PU+VU). Cheapest per round, most rounds; intermediates are not state values; asymptotic convergence with error bounded by γ times its previous value, stopped via the ε conversion bound.

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 策略迭代：评估解到底（PE+PI）。单轮最贵、轮数最少；中间量是货真价实的 $v_{\pi_{k}}$；有限步精确终止（上界 $|A|^{|S|}$），停止靠「策略不再变化」。
en: Policy iteration: evaluation solves to the end (PE+PI). Priciest per round, fewest rounds; intermediates are bona fide $v_{\pi_{k}}$; exact termination in finitely many steps (bounded by $|A|^{|S|}$), stopped by "the policy stopped changing".

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 截断策略迭代：评估只跑 j 步。j = 1 即 VI、j → ∞ 即 PI；中间某个 j 常常总扫描数最少——工程上的默认起点。
en: Truncated policy iteration: evaluation runs only j steps. j = 1 is VI, j → ∞ is PI; a middle j often minimises total sweeps — the engineering default.

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 共同心跳：每轮「一步价值 + 一步策略」交替进行——广义策略迭代（GPI）是三者的公共名字，也是全书算法的族谱。
en: Shared heartbeat: every round pairs one value step with one policy step, alternating — generalised policy iteration is their common name and the family tree of the whole book.

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 给 GPI 一个力学图像：评估步把价值拉向当前策略，改进步把策略拉向当前价值——两股方向相反的力轮流作用，每次交换都让两个量更接近彼此的「一致点」，而唯一稳定的一致点就是 (v*, π*)。这个图像在第 5、7 章会反复出现：MC 把「拉价值」的力换成样本平均，TD 换成一步自举——力换了，力学结构不变。判断任何新算法时先问：它的评估力和改进力各是什么？两个力是否在交替？
en: A mechanical image for GPI: evaluation pulls the value toward the current policy, improvement pulls the policy toward the current value — two opposing forces applied in turns, each exchange bringing the two quantities closer to mutual consistency, and the only stable consistency point is (v*, π*). The image recurs in Chapters 5 and 7: MC replaces the value-pulling force with sample averages, TD with one-step bootstrapping — the forces change, the mechanics do not. When judging any new algorithm, ask first: what are its evaluation force and improvement force, and do they alternate?

title.zh: 本章总结：一个框架，三种算法
title.en: Chapter Summary: One Framework, Three Algorithms

zh: 有模型时代的谢幕：本章三种算法都要求手里有 p(s′|s,a) 和 p(r|s,a)。第 5 章起进入无模型（model-free）时代——模型没有，就用采样凑。你会看到：把策略迭代的「评估步」换成「用经验平均回报估计价值」，就得到了蒙特卡洛学习。
en: Farewell to the model-based era: all three algorithms require p(s′|s,a) and p(r|s,a) in hand. From Chapter 5 we enter the model-free era — no model, so sample instead. You will see that replacing policy iteration's evaluation step with "estimate values by averaging experienced returns" yields Monte Carlo learning.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：两步一循环，走遍最优路
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: Two Steps per Loop, One Road to Optimality

zh: 本章推理链：BOE 的迭代式需要实现 → 拆成策略更新+价值更新（= 值迭代）→ 反过来先评估再改进（= 策略迭代）→ 引理保证越改越好 → 与值迭代赛跑证明收敛到 v* → 截断评估步得到统一谱系 → 广义策略迭代俯瞰全书。
en: This chapter's spine: implement the BOE iteration → split into policy update + value update (value iteration) → alternatively evaluate first, then improve (policy iteration) → a lemma guarantees monotone improvement → race against value iteration to prove convergence to v* → truncate the evaluation step to get one unified spectrum → generalised policy iteration overlooks the whole book.

title.zh: 代码精讲：值迭代与策略迭代并排实现
title.en: Code Walkthrough: Value and Policy Iteration Side by Side

zh: 把两个算法写并排，相似处和差异处一目了然。策略迭代里内嵌的评估循环直接复用 L2 的 policy_evaluation——好的函数设计会让你在第 5、7 章继续白嫖这个结构。
en: Write both algorithms side by side and the similarities and the one difference pop out. The evaluation loop inside policy iteration reuses L2's policy_evaluation as-is — good function design lets you keep freeriding on this structure in Chapters 5 and 7.

title.zh: 问答：动态规划六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Dynamic Programming

zh: 本章问答的核心全是「中间值算不算状态值」这个细思恐极的问题，以及收敛保证。
en: This chapter's Q&As circle the spine-chilling question "are intermediate values state values?", plus convergence guarantees.

title.zh: 问答：动态规划六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Dynamic Programming

zh: 翻卡前先自查三个最易翻车的点：① 值迭代的中间量 $v_{k}$ 是不是状态值（不是——它不满足任何策略的 Bellman 方程）；② 停止时 ‖Δv‖ < ε 对应的真实误差是多少（γε/(1−γ)，γ = 0.9 时是 9ε）；③ 策略迭代凭什么有限步终止（策略总数有限 + 每轮严格改进或已最优）。答不上哪条，就回对应小节再看一遍。
en: Before flipping cards, self-check the three most crash-prone points: ① is VI’s intermediate $v_{k}$ a state value (no — it satisfies no policy’s Bellman equation); ② what true error does ‖Δv‖ < ε at stopping correspond to (γε/(1−γ), a factor 9 at γ = 0.9); ③ why does policy iteration terminate in finitely many steps (finitely many policies + strict improvement or already optimal). If any answer escapes you, revisit the matching section.

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 从这一课起，模型没了。之前所有算法都靠 p(s′|s,a)、p(r|s,a) 精确计算；现在只剩经验样本。凭什么样本也能算出价值？因为状态值、动作值本质上都是期望，而期望本质上是一个均值估计问题。书上用掷硬币示范：已知分布 p(X=1) = p(X=−1) = 0.5，均值 = 0（模型驱动）；分布未知就狂抛硬币记录样本 x₁,…,xₙ，取平均 x̄（数据驱动）——样本越多越准，大数定律保证 x̄ → E[X]。
en: From this lecture on, the model is gone. Every earlier algorithm leaned on p(s′|s,a) and p(r|s,a) for exact computation; now we hold only experience samples. Why should samples suffice? Because state and action values are both expectations, and an expectation is at heart a mean estimation problem. The book's coin game: with the known distribution p(X=1) = p(X=−1) = 0.5, the mean is 0 (model-driven); with an unknown distribution, flip like mad, record x₁,…,xₙ, average (data-driven) — more samples, better estimate; the law of large numbers guarantees x̄ → E[X].

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 先保持正面概率为 0.5，点两次 +20。比较第 20 次和第 40 次的样本均值与真值 0 的距离。哪怕第二次更远，也与大数定律相容：定理谈的是长期极限。
en: Leave heads at 0.5 and add two batches of 20. Compare the distance from zero after each batch. The second mean can be farther away: the law of large numbers concerns the long-run limit.

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 大数定律 · Law of large numbers (Box 5.1)

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 为什么没有模型也能算价值？因为 DP 和 MC 计算的是同一个期望，只是算法不同。DP 路线要把期望拆开：q(s,a) = $\Sigma_{s '}$ p(s′|s,a)[r + γv(s′)]，逐项乘概率再求和——所以手里必须有 p(s′|s,a)。MC 路线把同一个期望交给样本频率：从 (s,a) 出发采 n 条轨迹，q(s,a) ≈ (1/n) Σᵢ gᵢ。大数定律保证两条路线殊途同归。换一个说法：价值的必要原料是期望，不是模型——模型只是计算期望的一种查询方式，采样是另一种。理解了这一层，「无模型学习」就不再神秘：它不是放弃计算，而是换了台计算期望的机器。
en: Why can values be computed without a model? Because DP and MC evaluate the same expectation by different algorithms. The DP route unpacks the expectation: q(s,a) = $\Sigma_{s '}$ p(s′|s,a)[r + γv(s′)], multiplying and summing term by term — hence p(s′|s,a) must be in hand. The MC route hands the same expectation to sample frequencies: run n episodes from (s,a) and take q(s,a) ≈ (1/n) Σᵢ gᵢ. The law of large numbers guarantees the two routes meet. Put differently: the necessary ingredient of value is the expectation, not the model — the model is merely one way of querying an expectation, sampling another. With this layer clear, "model-free learning" loses its mystery: it does not give up computation, it swaps the machine that computes expectations.

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 同一期望，两条算法 · One expectation, two algorithms

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 样本必须是独立同分布（i.i.d.）。书上的极端反例：如果每次采样都「抄」第一次的结果，采一亿条也没用——均值永远等于第一个样本。相关性是大样本估计的隐形杀手。
en: Samples must be i.i.d. — independent and identically distributed. The book's extreme counterexample: if every sample copies the first, a hundred million samples are worthless — the average equals sample #1 forever. Correlation is the silent killer of large-sample estimation.

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 方差的账单。回报 $G_{t}$ 是整条轨迹上所有奖励的加权和——每一步的转移随机性、策略随机性都叠进同一份样本里。有效视野越长（γ 越接近 1，等效步数约 1/(1−γ)），叠加的随机源越多，单个回报的方差越大；估计的方差再按 1/n 缩小（Box 5.1），意味着要准就得采很多。对照 DP：一步量 r + γv(s′) 只含一次转移的随机性，方差小得多，但代价是要模型。「高方差 vs 需要模型」是 MC 与 DP 的本质分野——也正是 L7 的 TD（自举换方差）要来折中的那笔账。
en: The variance bill. A return $G_{t}$ is a weighted sum of all rewards along a trajectory — every step’s transition noise and policy noise stacks into the same sample. The longer the effective horizon (γ near 1 means roughly 1/(1−γ) effective steps), the more random sources pile up and the larger each return’s variance; the estimate’s variance then shrinks only as 1/n (Box 5.1), so accuracy demands many samples. Contrast DP: the one-step quantity r + γv(s′) contains the randomness of a single transition — far smaller variance, at the price of the model. "High variance versus needing the model" is the essential divide between MC and DP — precisely the account L7’s TD comes to settle by trading bootstrapping for variance.

title.zh: 均值估计：无模型时代的入场券
title.en: Mean Estimation: The Ticket to the Model-Free Era

zh: 误区粉碎机。① 「MC 总要用到模型吧？」——不用。MC 与世界的全部接口是 env.step：喂进状态和动作、拿回下一状态和奖励，两张概率表从头到尾没出场。② 「回报 G 和 r + γv(s′) 是一回事吧？」——不是。前者是整条轨迹上奖励的总和，是 MC 的估计目标；后者是单步的自举目标（L7 TD 的原材料）。两者的期望在真值处相等，样本行为却天差地别：G 无偏而高方差，r + γv(s′) 方差小但继承 v 的误差（有偏）。混用等于同时踩错两章。
en: Misconception crusher. ① "MC surely needs the model somewhere?" — it does not. MC’s entire interface with the world is env.step: feed state and action, receive next state and reward; the two probability tables never appear. ② "The return G and r + γv(s′) are the same thing, right?" — no. The former sums rewards over the whole trajectory and is MC’s estimation target; the latter is a one-step bootstrapping target (the raw material of L7’s TD). Their expectations coincide at the true values, yet their sampling behaviour differs wildly: G is unbiased with high variance; r + γv(s′) has small variance but inherits v’s error (biased). Confusing them trips both chapters at once.

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: 策略迭代的两步里，只有评估步用到了模型（式 5.1 需要概率）。q 的定义 $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ = E[$G_{t}$|$S_{t}$=s, $A_{t}$=a] 提示了另一条路：从 (s,a) 出发按 π 采几条轨迹，用回报的平均值当 q 的估计（式 5.2）。把模型评估换成样本评估，就得到第一个无模型算法——MC Basic：每轮对每个 (s,a) 采足够多回合 → 平均回报当 q → 贪心改进。
en: Of policy iteration's two steps, only the evaluation step touches the model (Eq. 5.1 needs probabilities). The definition $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ = E[$G_{t}$|$S_{t}$=s, $A_{t}$=a] hints at another route: start episodes at (s,a), follow π, and average their returns as the estimate of q (Eq. 5.2). Swap the model-based evaluation for the sample-based one and the first model-free algorithm appears — MC Basic: each round, sample enough episodes for every (s,a) → average returns as q → improve greedily.

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: 为什么直接估 q 而不是 v？改进步需要的正是 q(s,a)；若只估 v，回头还得靠模型算 q——白换。无模型算法直接以 q 为工作对象。
en: Why estimate q directly rather than v? The improvement step needs exactly q(s,a); with only v you would need the model again to recover q — the swap would be pointless. Model-free algorithms work in q currency.

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: 样本少也能凑合跑：n 条轨迹平均不准，但算法往往仍能改进——这和 L4 截断策略迭代「评估不精确照样工作」一脉相承（广义策略迭代再次显灵）。
en: It still works on few samples: averaging n episodes is inaccurate, yet improvement often proceeds anyway — the same spirit as L4's truncated policy iteration "imprecise evaluation still works" (generalised policy iteration again).

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: MC Basic 的短板是样本效率：每轮要对每个 (s,a) 采一整批回合，太奢侈。它的使命是揭示核心思想；效率问题由后两个算法接力解决。
en: MC Basic's weakness is sample efficiency: sampling a batch of episodes for every (s,a) every round is extravagant. Its mission is the core idea; efficiency is handed to the next two algorithms.

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: 与策略迭代的逐步对应。把 MC Basic 与 L4 的算法迭代逐行对齐：评估步「解 Bellman 方程」换成「平均回合回报」，改进步「贪心」原样保留。理论上每轮采样数 → ∞ 时，估计值依大数定律收敛到真 q，算法与策略迭代等价、同样收敛到最优策略。样本数因此成为新的「精度旋钮」：样本少，估计带噪声，贪心可能被噪声带偏——但正如 L4 截断策略迭代所示，广义策略迭代容得下不精确的评估，多数轮次仍然在改进。MC Basic 的收敛条件就这么朴素：每个 (s,a) 的样本足够多。
en: Line-by-line correspondence with policy iteration. Align MC Basic with L4’s algorithm: the evaluation step "solve the Bellman equation" becomes "average episode returns", while the greedy improvement stays untouched. In theory, as the number of episodes per round → ∞, the estimates converge to the true q by the law of large numbers, and the algorithm is equivalent to policy iteration — likewise converging to optimal policies. The sample count thus becomes the new "precision knob": few samples mean noisy estimates and greed possibly misled by noise — yet, as L4’s truncated policy iteration showed, generalised policy iteration tolerates imprecise evaluation, and most rounds still improve. MC Basic’s convergence condition is that plain: enough samples for every (s,a).

title.zh: MC Basic：把策略迭代的评估步换掉
title.en: MC Basic: Swap Out the Evaluation Step

zh: MC 的适用边界：任务必须「回合化」。回报 G 要从轨迹末端倒着算，MC 因此要求轨迹有终点——episodic 任务天然合适；永不终止的 continuing 任务没有「末端」，MC 无从下嘴（工程上只能截成有限长回合，又引入截断偏差）。另一个隐含要求：每轮从每个 (s,a) 出发的样本都要「足够多」——下一节正式命名的 exploring starts 条件。记住这两条边界，就明白为什么第 7 章的 TD（走一步就能更新、不挑任务类型）会成为无模型方法的主力。
en: MC’s boundary of applicability: tasks must be episodic. The return G is computed backwards from the end of a trajectory, so MC requires trajectories that terminate — a natural fit for episodic tasks; never-ending continuing tasks offer no "end" for MC to grab (engineering workarounds truncate to finite episodes, importing truncation bias). A second implicit demand: "enough" episodes from every (s,a) each round — the condition formally named exploring starts in the next section. Keep these two boundaries in mind and it becomes clear why Chapter 7’s TD (updating every single step, indifferent to task type) becomes the flagship of model-free methods.

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: MC Basic 每轮扔掉旧轨迹重新采——浪费。一条长轨迹里藏着大量信息：每访问到一个 (s,a)，它后面的尾部就是一条「从 (s,a) 出发」的迷你轨迹，其折扣回报就是一份 q 估计。按利用策略分三种：initial-visit（只用整条轨迹估计初始对）、first-visit（每个 (s,a) 只取第一次访问后的尾部）、every-visit（每次访问都取，最大化压榨）。
en: MC Basic throws old trajectories away each round — wasteful. A long trajectory is dense with information: whenever a (s,a) is visited, its tail is a mini-trajectory "starting from (s,a)" whose discounted return is one more q sample. Three usage strategies: initial-visit (only the whole episode estimates the starting pair), first-visit (only the first visit to each pair counts), every-visit (every visit counts — maximal squeezing).

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: 实现上有个优雅的技巧：从轨迹末端倒着扫，g ← γg + $r_{t+1}$ 一边走一边天然算出「从每个访问点到末端」的折扣回报——一次反向扫描，全部样本到手。再用两个表记账：Returns(s,a) 累加回报、Num(s,a) 计数，q = Returns/Num 随时可更新。于是改进不必等「所有回合采完」，可以逐回合（episode-by-episode）进行——又落回广义策略迭代的怀抱：估计不准照样改进。
en: One elegant implementation trick: sweep the episode backwards, with g ← γg + $r_{t+1}$ naturally producing the discounted return from every visited point to the end — one reverse pass harvests every sample. Two tables keep the books: Returns(s,a) accumulates returns, Num(s,a) counts visits, and q = Returns/Num is updatable at any time. Improvement no longer waits for "all episodes collected" — it happens episode by episode, falling right back into generalised policy iteration: improve even on imprecise estimates.

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: first-visit 与 every-visit：殊途同归。同一状态-动作对被访问多次时，first-visit 只取第一次访问的尾部回报，every-visit 每次访问都取。两者是一致（consistent）的：访问次数 → ∞ 时都收敛到同一个真值 E[G|s,a]——每个「尾部」都是从该 (s,a) 出发的一条合法迷你轨迹。差别在统计品质：every-visit 的样本共享后缀、彼此强相关，同一个「真样本」被重复记账，有限样本下估计有偏；first-visit 的样本相关性较弱。工程上通常选 every-visit：实现一行都不多写、样本全部榨干，偏差随迭代被冲淡——本讲「代码精讲」一节用的正是它。
en: First-visit and every-visit: two roads, one destination. When the same state-action pair is visited several times, first-visit takes only the first visit’s tail return; every-visit takes all of them. The two are consistent: as visits → ∞ both converge to the same truth E[G|s,a] — every "tail" is a legitimate mini-trajectory starting at that (s,a). They differ in statistical quality: every-visit’s samples share suffixes and are strongly correlated, one "true sample" is booked repeatedly, and the finite-sample estimate is biased; first-visit’s samples are less correlated. Engineering usually picks every-visit: not one extra line of code, every drop of sample squeezed, and the bias washes out over iterations — exactly what the code walkthrough on this site uses.

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: 讲义对照（L5 Slides 20–24）· 一条 $T$ 步轨迹能榨出几份样本？① Initial-visit（MC Basic）：整条轨迹只给起点 $(s_0,a_0)$ 记 $1$ 份回报，其余 $(T-1)$ 步全丢弃；② First-visit：每个在轨迹里出现过的 $(s,a)$ 只按首次访问记 $1$ 份，最多 $|S||A|$ 份且样本相关性弱；③ Every-visit：每次经过均取尾部记账，一条轨迹榨满 $T$ 份样本，数据效率最高且搭配反向扫描无需额外存表。
en: Slide Alignment (L5 Slides 20–24) · How Many Samples Does One $T$-Step Episode Yield? ① Initial-visit: scores only the initial pair $(s_0,a_0)$ (1 sample per episode, discarding $T-1$ steps); ② First-visit: keeps at most 1 tail per distinct $(s,a)$ visited ($\le |S||A|$ samples with weaker correlation); ③ Every-visit: harvests all $T$ tails along the episode, maximizing sample efficiency cleanly in one backward pass.

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: 增量式：别存回报，边走边除。Returns/Num 两张表是「批量记账」——存下所有回报再相除。其实一步就能换成流式更新：新回报来了，q ← q + (1/N)(g − q) 加一笔就走，内存 O(1)、历史不用重算。这里的 1/N 不是随手选的：第 N 个样本到来时，它恰好等价于 N 个回报的算术平均——这正是 $\alpha_{t}$ = 1/t 的出生地。把 1/N 换成别的步长，估计就从「精确平均」变成「带遗忘的学习」——全书所有更新式从这个替换出发，L6 整章都在讲它的收敛条件。
en: Incremental form: keep no returns, divide as you go. The Returns/Num tables are "batch bookkeeping" — store every return, then divide. It converts in one step to a streaming update: when a new return arrives, q ← q + (1/N)(g − q) adds one increment and moves on, with O(1) memory and no recomputed history. The 1/N here is not a casual choice: when the N-th sample arrives, the rule is exactly equivalent to the arithmetic mean of all N returns — this is the birthplace of $\alpha_{t}$ = 1/t. Swap 1/N for another step size and the estimator turns from "exact averaging" into "learning with forgetting" — every update rule in the book starts from this swap, and L6 is devoted to its convergence conditions.

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: ⟺ N 个回报的算术平均（ = 1/t 的出生地）

title.zh: MC Exploring Starts：把样本榨干
title.en: MC Exploring Starts: Squeezing the Samples Dry

zh: 新的代价：exploring starts 条件。所有动作价值都要被「从它出发」的样本喂过，才估得准——MC Basic/Exploring Starts 都要求从每个 (s,a) 出发都有足够多的回合。现实系统（机器人、真用户）里强行从任意状态-动作对启动往往做不到。能不能去掉这个条件？能——下一节的 soft 策略。
en: The new price: the exploring-starts condition. Every action value needs samples "starting from it" to be estimated well — both MC Basic and Exploring Starts require sufficiently many episodes from every (s,a). Real systems (robots, real users) cannot simply be launched from arbitrary state-action pairs. Can this condition be removed? Yes — soft policies, next section.

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: Soft 策略：在任何状态选任何动作的概率都为正。只要策略是 soft 的，一条足够长的轨迹就能把每个 (s,a) 都逛到——exploring starts 条件被悄悄绕开。最常用的 soft 策略是 ε-greedy：以较大概率选贪心动作，同时给其他动作留一点概率：
en: A soft policy gives positive probability to every action at every state. With a soft policy, one sufficiently long trajectory can visit every (s,a) — the exploring-starts condition quietly dissolves. The most common soft policy is ε-greedy: favour the greedy action, but leave crumbs for the others:

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: ε-greedy 策略 · The ε-greedy policy

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: 把 MC Exploring Starts 的改进步从「贪心」换成「ε-贪心」（在 ε-greedy 策略集合 $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ 内取最优），就得到 MC ε-Greedy。收敛性答案微妙：给定充足样本，它收敛到 $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ 内最优的 ε-greedy 策略——是 yes 也是 no：在 ε-greedy 家族里最优，但不等于全局最优策略。
en: Swapping MC Exploring Starts' improvement step from greedy to ε-greedy (optimal within the set $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ of ε-greedy policies) yields MC ε-Greedy. The convergence answer is nuanced: with enough samples it converges to the best ε-greedy policy within $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ — both yes and no: optimal in the ε-greedy family, not necessarily the globally optimal policy.

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: 收敛的正式条件：每个 (s,a) 都要被无限次访问。MC 类算法收敛到最优，需要两件事同时成立：估计要准——每个对的访问次数 → ∞，大数定律才发力；探索要够——每个对都被访到，否则没被访问的动作一直顶着初始估值，贪心永远看不见它。ε-greedy 天然满足访问下界：任何动作在任何状态被选的概率 ≥ ε/|A| > 0，一条 t 步的长轨迹走下来，每个对的访问次数至少线性增长。exploring starts 用「起点任意」保证覆盖，ε-greedy 用「行动任意」保证覆盖——两种探索哲学，后者才落得了地。
en: The formal condition for convergence: every (s,a) must be visited infinitely often. MC-type algorithms converge to optimal policies only when two things hold together: accurate estimates — visits per pair → ∞, so the law of large numbers fires; sufficient exploration — every pair gets visited, or unvisited actions keep their initial estimates and greed never sees them. ε-greedy secures the visitation lower bound for free: every action at every state is chosen with probability ≥ ε/|A| > 0, so over a t-step trajectory each pair’s visit count grows at least linearly. Exploring starts secures coverage by "any starting point"; ε-greedy by "any action at any time" — two philosophies of exploration, and only the latter lands in practice.

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: （探索的预算律：ε 每减半，覆盖时间翻倍）

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: 讲义细察（L5 Slides 43–48）· 大 $\varepsilon$ 会让「最优策略本身」改道保守：$\varepsilon$-greedy 的代价不只是到达目标前偶发偏离——一旦 $\varepsilon$ 较大（如 $\varepsilon = 0.5$），贴着禁区走的捷径有 $\frac{\varepsilon}{|A|}$ 概率被探索噪声推进禁区吃 $-1$ 或 $-10$ 罚分，于是 $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ 策略族内的「最优 $\varepsilon$-greedy 策略」会主动放弃内部近路，转而选择贴边绕行的保守路径。要想最终恢复最短最优路径，后期必须衰减 $\varepsilon$。
en: Slide Insight (L5 Slides 43–48) · Large $\varepsilon$ Flips What Is Optimal Inside $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$: Exploration changes more than trajectory jitter. With a large $\varepsilon$ (e.g. $\varepsilon = 0.5$), a shortcut skirting forbidden cells incurs a $\frac{\varepsilon}{|A|}$ chance per bad direction of stepping into $-1$ or $-10$, causing the optimal policy within $\Pi_{\varepsilon}$ itself to abandon the interior shortcut for a safer perimeter detour. Decaying $\varepsilon$ later is essential to recover the true optimal route.

title.zh: MC ε-Greedy：不靠 exploring starts 也能探索
title.en: MC ε-Greedy: Exploring without Exploring Starts

zh: 探索与利用（exploration vs. exploitation）——强化学习的基本权衡在此正式登场。ε 大：探索强，所有 (s,a) 被充分访问、估值准，但牺牲最优性（策略更「随机」）；ε 小：利用强、贴近贪心，但冷门动作可能估值失真、错过最优。书上的实验：ε = 1 时百万步内每个动作被访问近万次，覆盖极佳；ε = 0.5 时访问次数骤降一个量级。工程经验：先大 ε 勘探、后逐步衰减 ε 保最优。
en: Exploration vs. exploitation — RL's fundamental trade-off formally enters. Large ε: strong exploration, every (s,a) well visited and well estimated, but optimality sacrificed (the policy grows random); small ε: strong exploitation close to greedy, but cold actions may be mis-estimated and the best one missed. The book's experiment: at ε = 1 each action is visited ~10⁴ times within a million steps (excellent coverage); at ε = 0.5 visit counts drop an order of magnitude. Engineering lore: explore with large ε first, then decay it to secure optimality.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 本书第一批无模型算法登场。核心思想一以贯之：均值估计——状态值/动作值都是期望，期望用样本平均来估。三个算法是同一思想的三级放大：MC Basic（把策略迭代的评估步换成 MC 估计，揭示核心思想）→ MC Exploring Starts（every-visit + 反向计算 + 逐回合改进，提高样本效率）→ MC ε-Greedy（soft 策略去掉 exploring starts 条件）。
en: The book's first model-free algorithms take the stage. One core idea throughout: mean estimation — state and action values are expectations, and expectations are estimated by sample averages. Three algorithms amplify the idea in stages: MC Basic (swap policy iteration's evaluation step for MC estimation — reveals the core), MC Exploring Starts (every-visit + backward computation + episode-by-episode improvement — sample efficiency), MC ε-Greedy (soft policies remove the exploring-starts condition).

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 用什么信息：DP 查模型表 p(s′|s,a)、p(r|s,a) 精确计算期望；MC 只看经历过的轨迹，用频率逼近期望。
en: Information used: DP consults the model tables p(s′|s,a) and p(r|s,a) to compute expectations exactly; MC sees only experienced trajectories and approximates expectations by frequencies.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 什么时机更新：DP 扫完全部状态才进下一轮；MC 逐回合更新（一条轨迹刷新一批 (s,a)），且必须等回合结束才算得出回报。
en: When to update: DP sweeps the whole state space per round; MC updates episode by episode (one trajectory refreshes many pairs) and must wait for the episode to end before any return exists.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 偏差与方差：DP 的评估精确——零偏差零方差（只要模型对）；固定策略下，独立回合回报的均值无偏，其方差为单次方差除以 n。同一回合多次访问产生的回报可能相关。
en: Bias and variance: DP’s evaluation is exact — zero bias, zero variance (provided the model is right); MC’s estimate is unbiased but high-variance — variance of the mean scales as 1/n for independent episode returns, accuracy bought with samples.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 探索需求：DP 知道一切，无需探索；MC 必须保证每个 (s,a) 被访问到（exploring starts 或 soft 策略），盲区永远估不准。
en: Exploration needs: DP knows everything and explores nothing; MC must guarantee visits to every (s,a) (exploring starts or soft policies) — blind spots stay mis-estimated forever.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 共同骨架：两边都是「评估 + 贪心改进」的广义策略迭代——MC 只换了评估步的引擎，底盘原封未动。
en: Shared skeleton: both run the generalised policy iteration loop of "evaluation + greedy improvement" — MC swaps the evaluation engine and leaves the chassis untouched.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 三个算法的演化逻辑：每次只换一个零件。MC Basic 把策略迭代的评估步换成「采样平均」——解决能不能（无模型可行吗）；MC Exploring Starts 把样本利用从 initial-visit 升级为 every-visit + 反向扫描 + 逐回合改进——解决省不省（样本效率）；MC ε-Greedy 把贪心换成 ε-贪心、用 soft 策略解除 exploring starts——解决行不行（现实里做得到吗）。正确性 → 效率 → 可行性，一条清晰的升级链。以后读论文遇到新算法，也建议这样拆：它换了哪个零件、又付出什么新代价。
en: The evolution of the three algorithms: one part swapped at a time. MC Basic replaces policy iteration’s evaluation step with "sample averaging" — answering whether it is possible (does model-free work). MC Exploring Starts upgrades sample usage from initial-visit to every-visit + backward sweeps + episode-wise improvement — answering whether it is efficient (sample economy). MC ε-Greedy swaps greedy for ε-greedy and dissolves exploring starts with soft policies — answering whether it is practical (feasible in the real world). Correctness → efficiency → feasibility: a clean upgrade chain. When you meet a new algorithm in a paper, take it apart the same way: which part was swapped, and at what new price.

title.zh: 本章总结：从模型到数据
title.en: Chapter Summary: From Models to Data

zh: 下一课预告：MC 必须等一条轨迹走完才能算回报（g 要从末端倒推）。如果走一步就想更新一次呢？这需要把「未来回报」换成「当前奖励 + 下一状态价值的估计」——自举的回归，时序差分学习。它背后还有一个 170 年的老算法撑腰：随机近似。
en: Next lecture teaser: MC must wait for a trajectory to finish before computing a return (g works backwards from the end). What if we want to update every single step? Replace "future returns" by "current reward + an estimate of the next state's value" — the return of bootstrapping, temporal-difference learning. Behind it stands a 170-year-old algorithm: stochastic approximation.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：模型消失的那一天
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: The Day the Model Vanished

zh: 本章推理链：期望 = 均值 → 样本平均估均值（大数定律）→ 策略迭代的评估步只用到 q → q 可以用轨迹平均来估 → MC Basic → 一条轨迹处处是样本（every-visit/反向 g）→ 但要求每个 (s,a) 都能当起点 → soft 策略化条件于无形 → 探索与利用的永恒权衡。
en: This chapter's spine: expectation = mean → estimate means by sample averages (LLN) → policy iteration's evaluation step only needs q → q can be estimated by trajectory averages → MC Basic → one trajectory is samples everywhere (every-visit, backward g) → but every (s,a) must be a possible start → soft policies dissolve the condition → the eternal exploration–exploitation trade-off.

title.zh: 代码精讲：无模型，从采样开始
title.en: Code Walkthrough: Model-Free Starts with Sampling

zh: 无模型代码的第一件工具不是算法，是采样器：generate_episode。有了它，MC Basic 就是「采样 → 平均 → 贪心」三行主循环。注意这次我们不再需要 build_model——这是与 L2–L4 代码的划时代差别。
en: The first tool of model-free code is not an algorithm but a sampler: generate_episode. With it, MC Basic is a three-line main loop: sample → average → improve greedily. Note what is missing: no build_model — that is the epochal difference from the L2–L4 code.

title.zh: 问答：蒙特卡洛九连问（精选）
title.en: Q&A: Nine Questions on Monte Carlo (Selected)

zh: 三个算法的关系、exploring starts 的来龙去脉、ε-greedy 的「是又不是」，全在问答里。
en: The relationship among the three algorithms, the full story of exploring starts, and the "yes and no" of ε-greedy all live in the Q&A.

title.zh: 问答：蒙特卡洛九连问（精选）
title.en: Q&A: Nine Questions on Monte Carlo (Selected)

zh: 翻卡前先在心里过三题：① MC 到底需不需要模型（不需要——env.step 就是全部接口）；② first-visit 与 every-visit 差在哪、为什么渐近一致（相关性不同，都收敛到 E[G|s,a]）；③ ε-greedy 策略「是不是最优」为什么是二义回答（在 ε-greedy 家族内最优，但不等于全局最优）。
en: Before flipping, settle three questions in your mind: ① does MC need a model (no — env.step is the entire interface); ② how do first-visit and every-visit differ, and why are they asymptotically consistent (different correlation, both converging to E[G|s,a]); ③ why is "is an ε-greedy policy optimal" a two-sided answer (optimal within the ε-greedy family, but not the global optimum).

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 上一课的均值估计是非增量的：攒够 n 个样本再一次性求平均——样本大了要等很久。增量的做法：新样本来了，旧估计往新样本方向挪一小步。把 x̄ₖ₊₁ 按旧均值 x̄ₖ 展开，整理出一颗闪烁的种子：
en: Last lecture's mean estimation was non-incremental: wait for all n samples, then average — a long wait for big n. The incremental way: as each new sample arrives, nudge the old estimate a small step toward it. Expanding x̄ₖ₊₁ around the old mean x̄ₖ crystallises a glittering seed:

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 增量均值 → 一般形式 · Incremental mean → general form

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 用同一串观测比较步长。分别选 1/k 和 0.5，各推进 20 次，读出两个估计。前者给前 20 个样本等权，后者把一半权重留给最后一个样本。再试 α=2，观察误差怎样越过零点。
en: Replay the same observations with 1/k and 0.5. Advance 20 steps in each mode. The first estimate weights all 20 samples equally; the second puts half its weight on the last sample. Try 2 and watch the estimate overshoot.

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 读法是全书通用的句式：新估计 = 旧估计 − 步长 × (旧估计 − 目标)。$\alpha_{k}$ = 1/k 时它精确等于批量平均；$\alpha_{k}$ 换成别的正数序列，它就是各种「边来边学」的算法。记住这个句式——第 7 章的 TD 更新式和它长得一模一样，只是「目标」换成了「奖励 + γ×下一状态价值」。
en: Read it as the book-wide sentence: new estimate = old estimate − step × (old estimate − target). With $\alpha_{k}$ = 1/k it is exactly the batch average; swap in other positive sequences and it becomes a family of learn-as-you-go algorithms. Memorise the pattern — Chapter 7's TD update looks identical, with the "target" replaced by "reward + γ × next-state value".

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: $\alpha_{k}$ = 1/k 不是拍脑袋——它精确卡在两条级数条件的中线上。调和级数 Σ 1/k = ∞（发散：加得够远）；平方级数 Σ 1/k² = π²/6 < ∞（收敛：抖得够停）。一个步长序列要同时做到「总和无穷、平方和有限」，1/k 是最自然的候选。此刻这只是两条有趣的数学事实；到 §6.2 它们会升格为收敛定理的步长条件——届时你会认出：增量均值会收敛，正是 Robbins–Monro 条件在 1/t 情形下的特例。
en: $\alpha_{k}$ = 1/k is not a guess — it sits precisely on the midline of two series conditions. The harmonic series Σ 1/k = ∞ (diverges: travels far enough); the squared series Σ 1/k² = π²/6 < ∞ (converges: settles down enough). For a step sequence to achieve "infinite total, finite squared sum" at once, 1/k is the most natural candidate. For now these are two pleasant facts of mathematics; in §6.2 they are promoted to the step-size conditions of a convergence theorem — and you will recognise that the incremental mean converges exactly as the Robbins–Monro conditions specialise to 1/t.

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: $\alpha_{k}$ 不是随便取的：试验台里的三个档位对应三种命运——1/k 收敛；0.5 恒定步长在真值附近永久抖动（步长太大，噪声擦不掉）；2 直接发散（一步跨过真值到对面更远处）。这些命运由下一节的三条件严格刻画。
en: $\alpha_{k}$ is not a free choice: the three presets in the lab correspond to three fates — 1/k converges; a constant 0.5 jitters around the truth forever (the step is too big to wash out noise); 2 diverges outright (each step overshoots farther across). These fates are exactly what the next section's three conditions formalise.

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: （旧样本的权重几何递减——指数遗忘）

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 两种步长 = 两种记忆。把更新式展开成「样本的加权和」立刻看清：α = 1/t 给每个样本等权重——真正的平均，适合平稳世界；常数 α 给旧样本指数遗忘的权重——新样本占 α、全部历史挤在 1−α 里。遗忘是好是坏取决于世界：目标在漂移（机器人磨损、用户口味变化、对手在适应），你需要遗忘旧数据，小常数步长反而是正确选择；目标固定不动，遗忘只会让估计永远在真值附近抖（幅度 ∝ √α）。收敛与跟踪是一对此生不可兼得的目标——第 7 章 TD 实践中用小常数学习率，正是押注「世界可能非平稳」。
en: Two step sizes = two kinds of memory. Unrolling the update into a weighted sum of samples makes it obvious: α = 1/t grants every sample equal weight — a true average, fit for a stationary world; a constant α weights old samples with exponential forgetting — the new sample takes α, all of history squeezes into 1−α. Whether forgetting is a bug depends on the world: if the target drifts (a robot wearing out, user tastes shifting, an opponent adapting), you need to forget, and a small constant step is the right choice; if the target is fixed, forgetting only keeps the estimate jittering around the truth forever (amplitude ∝ √α). Convergence and tracking are a pair you cannot have at once — Chapter 7’s TD uses a small constant learning rate in practice, precisely betting that "the world may be nonstationary".

title.zh: 从批量到增量：一条更新式走天下
title.en: From Batch to Incremental: One Update Rule to Rule Them All

zh: 两个误区。① 步长设成常数还指望收敛：常数 α 违反 Σα² < ∞（α²·∞ = ∞），噪声的方差贡献永远不消失，估计在真值附近永久抖动——这不是数值不稳，是理论判了刑。② 把 α = 1/k 与小常数 α 的效果混为一谈：前者渐近收敛到真值，但前期步子大、后期几乎不再更新，对新信息反应迟钝；后者永远跟得上新信息，但永不精确。选哪个不是精度问题，是「你认为世界平不平稳」的立场问题。
en: Two misconceptions. ① Setting a constant step and still expecting convergence: a constant α violates Σα² < ∞ (α²·∞ = ∞), the noise variance contribution never dies, and the estimate jitters around the truth forever — not numerical instability but a theoretical sentence. ② Confusing the effects of α = 1/k and a small constant α: the former converges asymptotically to the truth but takes huge early steps and barely updates late — sluggish to new information; the latter always tracks new information but is never exact. The choice is not about accuracy — it is a stance on whether you believe the world is stationary.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 想解 g(w) = 0，但 g 是黑盒：表达式未知（比如藏在神经网络里），连导数都没有，只能输入 w、收到一个带噪声的输出 g̃(w,η) = g(w) + η。RM 算法只有一行：$w_{k+1} = w_{k} - a_{k}$ g̃($w_{k} , \eta_{k}$)。书上的例子 g(w) = w³ − 5（真根 ≈ 1.71），观测噪声是标准正态，$a_{k}$ = 1/k——尽管每一步的「梯度读数」都被噪声污染，$w_{k}$ 照样滑向真根。
en: You want to solve g(w) = 0, but g is a black box: its expression is unknown (say, buried in a neural network), not even its derivative — you feed in w and receive a noisy reading g̃(w,η) = g(w) + η. The RM algorithm is one line: $w_{k+1} = w_{k} - a_{k}$ g̃($w_{k} , \eta_{k}$). The book's example g(w) = w³ − 5 (true root ≈ 1.71) with standard-normal noise and $a_{k}$ = 1/k — even though every gradient reading is polluted, $w_{k}$ still slides to the true root.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 为什么有效？书上先用 g(w) = tanh(w−1)（无噪声）画图讲直觉：$w_{k}$ 在真根右边时 g > 0，更新往左挪；在左边时 g 定理 6.1（Robbins-Monro 定理）给出严格条件：
en: Why does it work? The book first draws the intuition on g(w) = tanh(w−1) with zero noise: right of the root g > 0, so the update moves left; left of it g Theorem 6.1 (the Robbins-Monro theorem) makes it strict with three conditions:

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 单调条件：0 存在且唯一（若 g 是目标函数的梯度，这相当于要求凸性）。
en: Monotonicity: 0 exists and is unique (if g is an objective's gradient, this is convexity).

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 步长条件：Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞（步子加起来要走得足够远——否则到不了根）且 Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞（步子平方和要有限——否则噪声永远抖不平）。1/k 两条件全满足；常数步长违反第二条。
en: Step-size conditions: Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞ (the total distance must suffice to reach the root) yet Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞ (otherwise noise never settles). 1/k satisfies both; a constant step violates the second.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 噪声条件：E[$\eta_{k}$|$H_{k}$] = 0 且方差有界——噪声零均值即可，不必是高斯。三条全占，$w_{k}$ 几乎必然收敛到真根。
en: Noise conditions: E[$\eta_{k}$|$H_{k}$] = 0 with bounded variance — zero mean suffices; Gaussian is not required. With all three, $w_{k}$ converges almost surely to the true root.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 两个步长条件各自挡住哪种死法？Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞ 挡的是「走不到」：若步长总和有限（比如 $a_{k}$ = 1/k²），总位移有硬上限——初始点离根足够远时，再多的迭代也够不着。Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞ 挡的是「停不下」：每步噪声贡献 $a_{k}$$\eta_{k}$，独立噪声的方差直接相加，累计方差 ∝ σ²Σ$a_{k} ^2$——平方和发散，抖动永不平息。1/k 恰好两头都占：调和级数发散（走得够远），平方和收敛（抖得够停）。合起来的直觉只有一句话：步长要大到能走遍任何距离，又要小到能抹平任何噪声——走钢丝般的平衡。
en: Which failure does each step-size condition prevent? Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞ prevents "never arriving": if the total step is finite (say $a_{k}$ = 1/k²), the total displacement has a hard cap — start far enough from the root and no number of iterations suffices. Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞ prevents "never settling": each step’s noise contributes $a_{k}$$\eta_{k}$, independent noises add variances directly, and the accumulated variance ∝ σ²Σ$a_{k} ^2$ — with a divergent squared sum, the wobble never calms. 1/k threads both needles: the harmonic series diverges (far enough) while its square sums (still enough). The joint intuition fits in one sentence: steps must be large enough to cover any distance, yet small enough to erase any noise — a tightrope balance.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: Σ < ∞ ⟹ 抖动消失 · Σ = ∞ ⟹ 任何初始距离都走得完

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 欧拉-马歇罗尼常数说明调和级数以 $\ln n$ 速率发散（能走遍任何初始距离）；Basel 级数收敛于 $\pi^2/6$（噪声累计方差被封顶）

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 收敛率：随机噪声让收敛慢一阶。把确定性迭代和随机迭代放在同一把尺上：求根/梯度类的确定性迭代，误差通常以 O(1/t) 衰减；RM、SGD 这类随机迭代，误差典型只有 O(1/√t)。直觉可以数出来：取 $a_{k}$ = 1/k，信号部分（初始偏差）每轮按步长折减，累计约 O(1/t)；噪声部分按「平方和的平方根」累积——√(Σ1/k²) ≈ 1/√t——噪声项反而成了瓶颈。所以带噪声的更新不是免费的：同样预算下，精度差一个 √t 的因子。它也解释了神经网络训练里常见的「精度墙」：那是方差砌的墙，多算一步只便宜 1/√t。
en: Convergence rate: noise costs an order. Put deterministic and stochastic iterations on the same ruler: deterministic root-finding or gradient iterations typically decay at O(1/t); RM- and SGD-style stochastic iterations typically achieve only O(1/√t). The intuition is countable: with $a_{k}$ = 1/k, the signal part (the initial bias) is scaled down by the step each round, accumulating to roughly O(1/t); the noise part accumulates as the square root of the squared sum — √(Σ1/k²) ≈ 1/√t — and the noise term becomes the bottleneck. Noisy updates are not free: at equal budget, accuracy is worse by a factor of √t. It also explains the familiar "accuracy wall" in neural-network training: a wall built of variance, where each extra step buys only 1/√t.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 速率对比 · The rate comparison

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 定理 6.2（Dvoretzky 定理）是它的升级版：允许步长 $a_{k}$ 和噪声偏置 $\beta_{k}$ 是随机的（依赖历史 $H_{k}$），条件改为 $\Sigma \alpha_{k}$ = ∞、$\Sigma \alpha_{k} ^2$ k² < ∞（一致几乎 surely）加噪声零均值有界方差。它是最优值收敛证明（第 7 章 Q-learning）实际引用的工具。
en: Theorem 6.2 (Dvoretzky's theorem) is the upgrade: the step sizes $a_{k}$ and a noise term $\beta_{k}$ may be random (history-dependent), with conditions $\Sigma \alpha_{k}$ = ∞, $\Sigma \alpha_{k} ^2$ k² < ∞ (uniformly almost surely) plus zero-mean bounded-variance noise. It is the tool actually cited in the optimal-value convergence proofs (Q-learning, Chapter 7).

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: RM 是全书下半场的通用底座。回头看会发现：本章之后出现的每一个核心算法，骨架都是 w ← w + α(目标 − w)，区别只在「估计什么、目标是什么、步长怎么排」。趁热把这张族谱记牢——第 7 章每次抛出新算法时，先在心里对号入座，学习负担会小一半。
en: RM is the universal chassis of the book’s second half. In hindsight, every core algorithm from here on shares the skeleton w ← w + α(target − w), differing only in "what is estimated, what the target is, how the step is scheduled". Memorise this family tree while it is warm — each time Chapter 7 unveils a new algorithm, seat it here first and the learning burden halves.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 公共骨架：w ← w + α(目标 − w)。改的永远是「目标」和「步长」，骨架一个字不动。
en: The shared skeleton: w ← w + α(target − w). What changes is always the "target" and the "step"; the skeleton never moves.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: 增量均值（§6.1）：估计 = 均值，目标 = 样本 $x_{k}$，步长 = 1/k。
en: Incremental mean (§6.1): estimate = the mean, target = the sample $x_{k}$, step = 1/k.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: SGD（§6.4）：估计 = 参数，目标 = 单样本梯度 ∇f(w, x)，步长 = $\alpha_{k}$。
en: SGD (§6.4): estimate = parameters, target = the one-sample gradient ∇f(w, x), step = $\alpha_{k}$.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: TD(0)（L7）：估计 = v(s)，目标 = r + γv(s′)——目标从「样本」换成了「自举量」。
en: TD(0) (L7): estimate = v(s), target = r + γv(s′) — the target becomes a bootstrapped quantity.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: Sarsa（L7）：估计 = q(s,a)，目标 = r + γq(s′,a′)——on-policy 版本。
en: Sarsa (L7): estimate = q(s,a), target = r + γq(s′,a′) — the on-policy version.

title.zh: Robbins-Monro 算法：解黑盒方程
title.en: The Robbins-Monro Algorithm: Solving Black-Box Equations

zh: Q-learning（L7）：估计 = q(s,a)，目标 = r + γ $\max_{a}$ q(s′,a)——off-policy 版本，收敛证明直接引用 Dvoretzky 定理。
en: Q-learning (L7): estimate = q(s,a), target = r + γ $\max_{a}$ q(s′,a) — the off-policy version, whose convergence proof cites Dvoretzky’s theorem directly.

title.zh: SGD：RM 的成名弟子
title.en: SGD: The Famous Disciple of RM

zh: 优化问题 min J(w) = E[f(w, X)]：目标含期望，分布未知，批量采样又太贵。随机梯度下降只拿一个样本就更新：$w_{k+1} = w_{k} - \alpha_{k}$$\nabla_{w}$f($w_{k} , x_{k}$)——把真梯度 E[∇f] 换成单样本的随机梯度。书上证明它是 RM 的特例：取 g(w) = ∇J(w)，则随机梯度 = 真梯度 + 零均值噪声 $\eta_{k}$，这解释了平均更新方向；收敛还依赖目标的性质、噪声控制和步长条件。而增量均值又是 SGD 的特例（f = ½(w − x)² 时随机梯度恰为 w − x）。三代同堂：RM → SGD → 增量均值。
en: Optimise min J(w) = E[f(w, X)]: the objective contains an expectation, the distribution is unknown, batch sampling is dear. Stochastic gradient descent updates on a single sample: $w_{k+1} = w_{k} - \alpha_{k}$$\nabla_{w}$f($w_{k} , x_{k}$) — the true gradient E[∇f] replaced by a one-sample stochastic gradient. The book proves it is a special RM: set g(w) = ∇J(w) and the stochastic gradient equals the true gradient plus zero-mean noise $\eta_{k}$ — convergence additionally depends on the objective, step sizes and noise bounds. And the incremental mean is a special SGD (with f = ½(w − x)² the stochastic gradient is exactly w − x). Three generations: RM → SGD → incremental mean.

title.zh: SGD：RM 的成名弟子
title.en: SGD: The Famous Disciple of RM

zh: 为什么单个样本就敢当梯度用？因为它是无偏的：E[$\nabla_{w}$f(w, X)] = ∇J(w)——随机梯度噪声很大，但期望恰好是真梯度，「平均意义上方向是对的」。剩下的全是方差问题：单样本的方差是 var[X] 级别；mini-batch 把 m 个独立同分布的梯度样本平均，方差除以 m。m 因此是一笔明码标价的「稳定预算」：m 越大越稳（Figure 6.5 的曲线越平滑），每步算力也线性变贵。SGD（m = 1）与 BGD（m = 全部）是同一根价格轴的两端，MBGD 在中间挑性价比。
en: Why does a single sample dare to stand in for the gradient? Because it is unbiased: E[$\nabla_{w}$f(w, X)] = ∇J(w) — the stochastic gradient is noisy, but its expectation is exactly the true gradient; "correct in direction, on average". All that remains is variance: a single sample carries var[X]-level variance; a mini-batch averages m samples and divides the variance by m. So m is a stability budget with a price tag: larger m is steadier (smoother curves in Figure 6.5) and linearly pricier per step. SGD (m = 1) and BGD (m = all) sit at the two ends of one price axis; MBGD shops in the middle for value.

title.zh: SGD：RM 的成名弟子
title.en: SGD: The Famous Disciple of RM

zh: 无偏性与方差的明码标价 · Unbiasedness, and variance with a price tag

title.zh: SGD：RM 的成名弟子
title.en: SGD: The Famous Disciple of RM

zh: 书上 Figure 6.5 的现象值得单独记住：SGD 的收敛曲线是「远快近晃」——离最优远时随机性相对可忽略、下降飞快；靠近后随机性主导，曲线在解附近永久小幅晃动。批量版 MBGD（每次 m 个样本）在中间：比 SGD 稳、比 GD 灵活。神经网络训练里「学习率衰减」的本质，就是把 $a_{k}$ 从常数缓慢调成 1/k 的形状。
en: A phenomenon from the book's Figure 6.5 worth memorising: SGD converges “fast when far, wobbly when near” — far from the optimum the randomness is relatively negligible and descent is rapid; close to it, randomness dominates and the curve jitters around the solution forever. Mini-batch MBGD (m samples per update) sits between: steadier than SGD, nimbler than GD. The essence of “learning-rate decay” in neural-network training is morphing $a_{k}$ from a constant toward the 1/k shape.

title.zh: SGD：RM 的成名弟子
title.en: SGD: The Famous Disciple of RM

zh: 讲义补遗（L6 Slides 37–46）· 两个常见错觉：① 有放回抽 $m=n$ 的 MBGD 并「不等于」BGD：从 $n$ 个样本中独立有放回抽 $n$ 次，平均只覆盖约 $(1-e^{-1})n \approx 63.2\%$ 个不重复样本（部分样本重复抽取，梯度仍有方差），只有无放回全集遍历才是确定性 BGD；② 相对误差 $\delta_k = \frac{|w_k - w^*|}{|w^*|}$ 视角：远离真解时真实漂移远大于随机梯度噪声，因此前期下降直逼 BGD；接近 $w^*$ 后信号变弱而常数步长决定噪声半径，于是停在邻域内震荡（说明后期学习率衰减的必要）。
en: Slide Addendum (L6 Slides 37–46) · Two Subtle Points: ① MBGD with replacement at $m=n$ is NOT BGD: drawing $n$ i.i.d. samples with replacement touches only $\approx (1-e^{-1})n \approx 63.2\%$ distinct items per batch—gradient variance remains unless every sample is swept deterministically without replacement; ② Relative-error view $\delta_k = |w_k - w^*|/|w^*|$: far from $w^*$, deterministic drift dominates stochastic noise, tracking BGD; near $w^*$, constant step-size noise sets an irreducible neighborhood oscillation floor.

title.zh: 本章总结：给 TD 交的基础学费
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Foundation Fee for TD

zh: 本章没讲任何新的强化学习算法，却交齐了后面所有学费：增量均值（第一条随机迭代式）、RM 算法（黑盒求根 + 三条件收敛）、Dvoretzky 定理（随机步长版，Q-learning 收敛证明引用的工具）、SGD/MBGD（机器学习的日常主食，RM 的特例）。一句话：随机近似 = 用带噪声的增量更新逼近目标，γ< 1 之外的第二台「收敛发动机」在这里点火。
en: No new RL algorithms this chapter — but every future fee is paid: the incremental mean (our first stochastic iteration), the RM algorithm (black-box root-finding + three-condition convergence), Dvoretzky's theorem (the random-step-size version cited by Q-learning's proof), and SGD/MBGD (machine learning's daily bread, special cases of RM). In one line: stochastic approximation = noisy incremental updates approaching a target — the second “convergence engine”, ignited here beside γ < 1.

title.zh: 本章总结：给 TD 交的基础学费
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Foundation Fee for TD

zh: 离场自检。① 能从 $\bar{x}_{k+1}$ 的代数展开推出增量更新式；② 能说出 RM 三条件各挡住哪种失败（单调挡多根、Σa = ∞ 挡走不到、Σa² < ∞ 挡停不下）；③ 能解释 1/k 为何两条件全中、常数步长为何必失其一；④ 能把 TD 更新式拆成「估计 / 目标 / 步长」三件套并指出它是 RM 的特例；⑤ 能说出随机方法的收敛率为什么慢一阶（噪声按 √(Σa²) 累积）。五题全过，第 7 章的门就开了。
en: Exit self-check. ① Derive the incremental update from the algebra of $\bar{x}_{k+1}$; ② name the failure each RM condition prevents (monotonicity prevents multiple roots; Σa = ∞ prevents never-arriving; Σa² < ∞ prevents never-settling); ③ explain why 1/k satisfies both conditions while a constant step must fail one; ④ decompose the TD update into estimate / target / step-size and identify it as special RM; ⑤ say why stochastic methods converge one order slower (noise accumulates as √(Σa²)). Pass all five, and Chapter 7’s door is open.

title.zh: 本章总结：给 TD 交的基础学费
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Foundation Fee for TD

zh: 两台收敛发动机，即将同时点火。第一台在 L3–L4 点燃：γ < 1 的压缩性，保证 Bellman 算子的迭代收敛——那是「确定性世界」的发动机。第二台在本章点燃：随机近似的步长条件，保证带噪声的更新收敛——这是「随机世界」的发动机。第 7 章的 TD 更新同时踩着两台：更新目标里嵌着 Bellman 算子（γ < 1），更新过程却是随机采样（RM 条件），收敛证明是两台发动机的合奏——这也解释了为什么 TD 的学习率不能随便取，它得同时伺候好两个主人。
en: Two convergence engines, about to fire together. The first ignited in L3–L4: the contraction property of γ < 1, guaranteeing convergence of Bellman-operator iterations — the engine of the deterministic world. The second ignites in this chapter: the stochastic-approximation step-size conditions, guaranteeing convergence of noisy updates — the engine of the stochastic world. Chapter 7’s TD update steps on both at once: its target embeds the Bellman operator (γ < 1) while its updates are driven by random samples (RM conditions), and the convergence proof is a duet of the two engines — which is also why TD’s learning rate cannot be chosen casually: it must serve two masters at once.

title.zh: 本章总结：给 TD 交的基础学费
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Foundation Fee for TD

zh: 下一课预告：把增量均值更新式 $w_{k+1} = w_{k} - \alpha_{k} ( w_{k} - x_{k}$) 里的 $x_{k}$ 换成"r + γv(s′)"——这就是TD(0)。名字换了，骨子里是 RM。第 7 章还打包赠送 Sarsa 和 Q-learning 两位大人物。
en: Next lecture teaser: in the incremental-mean update $w_{k+1} = w_{k} - \alpha_{k} ( w_{k} - x_{k}$), replace $x_{k}$ by “r + γv(s′)” — that is TD(0). New name, RM bones. Chapter 7 also introduces two celebrities: Sarsa and Q-learning.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：一条更新式的家族史
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: The Family Tree of One Update Rule

zh: 本章推理链：批量均值慢 → 展开成增量式 → 步长抽象成 $\alpha_{k}$ → 解黑盒方程的 RM → 收敛三条件 → Dvoretzky 放宽到随机步长 → SGD 是 RM 特例、增量均值是 SGD 特例 → 下一课 TD 坐享其成。
en: This chapter's spine: batch means are slow → unfold into the incremental form → abstract the step to $\alpha_{k}$ → RM for black-box equations → three convergence conditions → Dvoretzky relaxes to random steps → SGD is special RM and incremental mean is special SGD → TD will cash it all in next lecture.

title.zh: 代码精讲：RM 与增量均值，各十行
title.en: Code Walkthrough: RM and the Incremental Mean, Ten Lines Each

zh: 这节课的代码短到不像话，但每一行都对应定理的一个条件。特别注意步长 schedules 的写法——Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞ 而 Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞ 的族谱（1/k、1/kᵖ (p∈(0.5,1])）与常数步长的本质区别全在这里。
en: This lecture's code is absurdly short, yet every line maps to a theorem condition. Watch how the step-size schedules are written — the family satisfying Σ$a_{k}$ = ∞ while Σ$a_{k} ^2$ < ∞ (1/k, 1/kᵖ with p ∈ (0.5,1]) versus constant steps is the whole story.

title.zh: 问答：随机近似六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Stochastic Approximation

zh: 书上的问答直击「为什么要学这一章」——答案都指向第 7 章。
en: The book's Q&As hit “why study this chapter” — every answer points to Chapter 7.

title.zh: 问答：随机近似六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Stochastic Approximation

zh: 翻卡前先过三题：① 「为什么学一个没有 RL 算法的章节」（因为第 7 章的 TD 在数学上就是 RM——目标换成 r + γv(s′)）；② 「步长到底怎么设」（平稳目标用衰减步长、非平稳用小常数；理论上要满足 Σα = ∞ 且 Σα² < ∞）；③ 「SGD 每次只用一个样本会不会走错方向」（无偏——方向平均正确，代价是方差和 1/√t 的收敛率）。
en: Before flipping, run through three: ① "why study a chapter with no RL algorithms" (because Chapter 7’s TD mathematically is RM — with the target replaced by r + γv(s′)); ② "how should the step size be set" (decaying for stationary targets, small constants for nonstationary ones; theory demands Σα = ∞ with Σα² < ∞); ③ "does one sample per step lead SGD astray" (unbiased — correct on average, at the price of variance and the 1/√t rate).

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: MC 的痛点：必须等轨迹走完才能算回报。TD 的解法：把 L6 增量均值式里的「目标」换成 TD 目标 r + γv(s′)——即时奖励到手了，「未来回报」用当前估计 v(s′) 自举顶上，不用等未来真的发生：
en: MC's pain: returns wait for the episode to end. TD's cure: in L6's incremental-mean rule, replace the "target" by the TD target r + γv(s′) — the immediate reward is already here, and the "future return" is stood in for by the current estimate v(s′) via bootstrapping, no waiting for the future to actually happen:

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 它从哪来？书上 Box 7.1 一步一步推：状态值定义变形为 $v_{\pi}(s)$ = E[R + γ$v_{\pi}(S ' )$]（Bellman 期望方程），这是关于 $v_{\pi}(s)$ 的方程 g(v) = 0；把期望 E[R + γ$v_{\pi}(S ' )$] 换成单次采样 r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$，观测噪声 η = E[·] − 采样值——TD 就是套在 Bellman 期望方程上的 RM 算法。三条件检查通过（TD 目标是零均值噪声），收敛性定理 7.1 到手。
en: Where does it come from? The book's Box 7.1 walks it out: reshape the state-value definition into $v_{\pi}(s)$ = E[R + γ$v_{\pi}(S ' )$] (the Bellman expectation equation) — an equation g(v) = 0 in $v_{\pi}(s)$; replace the expectation E[R + γ$v_{\pi}(S ' )$] by a single sample r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$, with observation noise η = E[·] − sample — TD is the RM algorithm applied to the Bellman expectation equation. The three conditions check out (the TD target is zero-mean noise), and convergence arrives as Theorem 7.1.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: TD 目标的推导链 · Where r + γv(s′) comes from — Box 7.1

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 视角一：方程变形——为什么「只看一步」是合法的。G = R + γG′ 只是回报定义；关键一步是重期望公式（tower property）把 E[G′|s] 折叠成 E[$v_{\pi}(S ' )$|s]：「未来整段的期望」换成「下一状态价值的期望」，一步就够。这一折叠不丢信息靠的是马尔可夫性：知道 S′ 之后，历史不再改变 G′ 的条件分布。
en: View 1: reshaping the equation — why "one step ahead" is legal. G = R + γG′ is just the definition of return; the pivotal move is the law of total expectation (tower property) folding E[G′|s] into E[$v_{\pi}(S ' )$|s]: the expectation of the whole future is replaced by the value of the next state — one step suffices. The fold loses nothing precisely because of the Markov property: given S′, history no longer changes the conditional distribution of G′.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 视角二：自举——为什么现在就能更新。方程右边还含未知的 $v_{\pi}(S ' )$；拿当前估计 $v_{t}(s ' )$ 顶上，未知变已知，更新立刻可执行。代价也随之而来：目标从「真值」变成「真值 + 估计误差」——偏差的来源。
en: View 2: bootstrapping — why the update can run right now. The right-hand side still contains the unknown $v_{\pi}(S ' )$; stand the current estimate $v_{t}(s ' )$ in its place, and the unknown becomes known — the update executes immediately. The price follows at once: the target is no longer the truth but "truth + estimation error" — the origin of bias.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 视角三：一步采样——为什么它就是 RM。期望 E[R + γ$v_{t}(S ' )$] 依然算不动（转移概率未知），换成单次转移的采样 r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$。采样对期望的偏离恰是零均值噪声——L6 的 RM 三条件逐条对号入座，收敛性由定理 7.1 兜底。三个视角合起来一句话：Bellman 方程给出骨架，自举给出可行性，采样给出算法。
en: View 3: one-step sampling — why it is exactly RM. The expectation E[R + γ$v_{t}(S ' )$] is still uncomputable (transition probabilities unknown), so swap in the single-transition sample r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$. The deviation of a sample from its expectation is precisely zero-mean noise — L6’s RM conditions line up one by one, and Theorem 7.1 underwrites convergence. Three views in one sentence: the Bellman equation gives the skeleton, bootstrapping gives feasibility, sampling gives the algorithm.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 当前估计 · current | TD 目标 ¯ · TD target（金）＝二者的差 驱动一切 · their gap drives everything

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 全章灵魂：偏差-方差权衡。MC 的目标是真实回报 G：无偏（E[G|s] 恰是 $v_{\pi}(s)$）——但 G 把整条轨迹的随机性（转移、奖励、策略的抽样）全部累乘到同一个数上，方差巨大。TD 的目标 r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$：方差小（只吃一步奖励与一次转移的噪声）——但 $v_{t}(s ' )$ 本身不准，目标被估计误差污染，有偏。拿书 3×3 世界（γ=0.9）感受量级：沿最优路 s₁→s₂→s₅→s₈→s₉ 的真实回报 G₀ = 0.9³×1 = 0.729，恰好等于 v*(s₁)=0.73；而 TD 在全零初始化下的第一个目标是 r + γv(s₂) = 0 + 0.9×0 = 0——MC 开局就看到「完整的 0.729」，但换个运气可能完全是另一个数（高方差）；TD 开局只看到「诚实的 0」（有偏），却几乎每次都一样（低方差）。
en: The soul of the chapter: the bias–variance trade-off. MC’s target is the real return G: unbiased (E[G|s] is exactly $v_{\pi}(s)$) — but G piles the randomness of the whole trajectory (transitions, rewards, policy draws) onto one number: enormous variance. TD’s target r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$: small variance (only one reward and one transition of noise) — but $v_{t}(s ' )$ is itself inaccurate, the target is polluted by estimation error: biased. Feel the magnitudes in the book’s 3×3 world (γ=0.9): along the optimal path s₁→s₂→s₅→s₈→s₉ the real return G₀ = 0.9³×1 = 0.729, exactly v*(s₁)=0.73; TD’s very first target from an all-zero initialisation is r + γv(s₂) = 0 + 0.9×0 = 0 — MC’s opening move sees the “complete 0.729”, though under different luck it could be a totally different number (high variance); TD’s opening sees an “honest 0” (biased) that is nearly the same every time (low variance).

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: MC vs TD · 一张对照卡 · A comparison card

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: bootstrapping：更新里用了 $v_{t}(s ' )$ 这个估计值当目标的一部分——拿估计估估计。MC 不自举（用真实回报），所以无偏但高方差；TD 自举，有偏但方差小、还快得多。
en: Bootstrapping: the update uses the estimate $v_{t}(s ' )$ as part of the target — estimating from estimates. MC does not bootstrap (real returns), hence unbiased but high-variance; TD bootstraps — biased but low-variance and much faster.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: sweep-free：TD 每步只更新当前访问的那个状态，其余不动。MC Basic 要等整条轨迹、MC Exploring Starts 要倒扫一遍，TD 走一步更新一步——在线、增量、持续学习的雏形。
en: Sweep-free: each step updates only the currently visited state; the rest stay put. MC Basic waits for whole trajectories, MC Exploring Starts back-sweeps them — TD updates as it walks: online, incremental, the embryo of continual learning.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 在线即时性（Online vs Offline）：TD(0) 每走一步即可更新 $v(s_t)$，原生支持持续任务；MC 必须等到回合结束才有 $G_t$。
en: Timeliness (Online vs Offline): TD(0) updates $v(s_t)$ on every step and supports continuing tasks; MC waits until episode termination for $G_t$.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 自举与无模型：两者皆免模型（model-free）；TD 用当前估值 $v(s_{t+1})$ 自举（bootstrapping），MC 完全依靠真实轨迹回报、不自举。
en: Bootstrapping & Model: both are model-free; TD bootstraps from current $v(s_{t+1})$, while MC relies strictly on sampled trajectory returns.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 偏差-方差与初值影响：TD 初值会引入偏差（随后按 $(\gamma P_\pi)^t$ 衰减）但单步方差低；MC 无偏却把整条路径的随机性浓缩为一数，方差较高。
en: Bias, Variance & Init: TD carries transient initialization bias yet enjoys low single-step variance; MC is unbiased in expectation with higher return variance.

title.zh: TD 学习：走一步就更新
title.en: TD Learning: Update Every Single Step

zh: 两个高频误区。① 把 TD 误差 δ 当损失函数：$\delta_{t} = v_{t}(s)$ − (r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$) 只是 RM 更新式里那个「带噪声的读数」，不是任何目标函数的导数——「最小化 Σδ²」在数学上站不住（把所有 v 一路推向 0 也能让某些 δ 变小，但那不是学习）。δ 的角色是驱动力：它说「当前估计与目标差多少」，用完即弃。② α 永不衰减还指望收敛：常数 α 违反 Σα² < ∞（L6 已判过刑），价值在真值附近永久振荡、振幅 ∝ α；非平稳目标下这是有意为之的取舍（跟踪），平稳目标下就是 bug。
en: Two frequent misconceptions. ① Treating the TD error δ as a loss function: $\delta_{t} = v_{t}(s)$ − (r + γ$v_{t}(s ' )$) is merely the “noisy reading” inside the RM update — it is not the derivative of any objective. “Minimising Σδ²” does not stand mathematically (pushing every v toward 0 also shrinks some δ, but that is not learning). δ’s role is a driving force: it reports “how far the estimate sits from the target”, is consumed, and discarded. ② Never decaying α yet still expecting convergence: a constant α violates Σα² < ∞ (already sentenced in L6); values oscillate around the truth forever with amplitude ∝ α — a deliberate trade-off for nonstationary targets (tracking), but a bug for stationary ones.

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: TD(0) 只能估状态值，而改进策略需要 q。Sarsa 把 TD 的「状态版」照抄成「动作版」——更新对象换成 q(s,a)，目标里的 v(s′) 换成 q(s′,a′)：
en: TD(0) estimates only state values, but improving policies needs q. Sarsa transcribes TD from "state edition" to "action edition" — the updated object becomes q(s,a) and the target's v(s′) becomes q(s′,a′):

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: Sarsa — Eq. (7.12)

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: 名字来源：每次更新需要五元组 ($s_{t} , a_{t} , r_{t+1} , s_{t+1} , a_{t+1}$)——state-action-reward-state-action。数学身份：解动作价值版 Bellman 方程 $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ = E[R + γ$q_{\pi}(S ' ,A ' )$|s,a] 的 RM 算法（定理 7.2 保证收敛）。Sarsa = TD(0) + 策略改进的组合拳：按 ε-greedy 采轨迹（探索），每步更新 q，每步顺便贪心改策略——评估与改进逐事件交替，这正是广义策略迭代最细的粒度。
en: The name: each update needs the quintuple ($s_{t} , a_{t} , r_{t+1} , s_{t+1} , a_{t+1}$) — state-action-reward-state-action. Its mathematical identity: the RM algorithm solving the action-value Bellman equation $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ = E[R + γ$q_{\pi}(S ' ,A ' )$|s,a] (convergence: Theorem 7.2). Sarsa = TD(0) plus policy improvement as one combo: roll ε-greedy trajectories (exploration), update q each step, and greedily touch up the policy each step — evaluation and improvement alternating at the finest possible grain, the finest granularity of generalised policy iteration.

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: ε-greedy 下 Sarsa 学到的表，和 Q-learning 的表不是同一张。Sarsa 的目标里 q(s′,a′) 的 a′ 是自己（ε-greedy）实际采出的下一步——更新式在评估「我带着探索噪声走路时这条路值多少」。用书 3×3 世界（γ=0.9）把两张表算出来对比（下方实验室同款世界，可直接验证）：
en: Under ε-greedy, Sarsa’s table is not the same table Q-learning learns. The a′ inside Sarsa’s target q(s′,a′) is the next action actually drawn by its own ε-greedy policy — the update evaluates “what this route is worth while I walk with exploration noise on”. Compute both tables on the book’s 3×3 world (γ=0.9; the lab below runs the very same world, verify it yourself):

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: Sarsa 的数值整体被压低：每一步都有 20% 的概率乱走（撞边界 −1、绕远路）——它诚实地给探索风险记了账；Q-learning 的 max 只认最优，不管行为策略多吵

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: 为什么 Sarsa 的策略要用 ε-greedy？书上答：因为这条策略还要负责产生样本——它必须具有探索性才能把每个 (s,a) 都走到。这就是 on-policy 的含义：被评估的策略 = 产生数据的策略。代价：收敛到的是 ε-greedy 家族内的最优（L5 的「是又不是」再现）。
en: Why is Sarsa's policy ε-greedy? The book answers: that same policy must also generate the samples — it has to explore so that every (s,a) gets visited. This is what on-policy means: the evaluated policy = the data-generating policy. The price: convergence to the best within the ε-greedy family (L5's "yes and no" returns).

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: 【书外延伸，助理解】悬崖边的 Sarsa 更谨慎。把书 3×3 世界的禁区奖励加深成 −10（当成「陷阱」），ε=0.1 跑数值实验：直接执行 ε-greedy(Q* 表) 的平均折扣回报 ≈ 0.269，执行 ε-greedy(Sarsa 表) ≈ 0.282——Sarsa 反而更高。原因：Q* 表只认最优价值，执行时一旦探索失足掉进陷阱就要自己扛；Sarsa 的表在学的时候就把「探索可能掉坑」定价进去了，离陷阱近的状态被压低，恢复动作更保守。经典悬崖行走（cliff walking）实验展示的就是这一幕：Q-learning 学最短的危险路线，Sarsa 学安全的绕行路线——没有谁「错」，它们优化的对象本来就不是同一个。
en: [Beyond the book, for intuition] Sarsa is more careful at the cliff edge. Deepen the forbidden-cell reward of the book’s 3×3 world to −10 (treat it as a “pit”) and run the numbers with ε=0.1: executing ε-greedy on the Q* table earns an average discounted return of ≈ 0.269, while ε-greedy on the Sarsa table earns ≈ 0.282 — Sarsa wins. Why: the Q* table only acknowledges optimal values, and when exploration stumbles into the pit during execution, it pays the bill alone; Sarsa’s table priced “exploration may fall in” while learning — states near the pit get pushed down, and its recovery actions are more conservative. The classic cliff-walking experiment shows exactly this scene: Q-learning takes the short dangerous route, Sarsa the safe detour — neither is “wrong”; they were never optimising the same object.

title.zh: Sarsa：直接学动作价值
title.en: Sarsa: Learning Action Values Directly

zh: 收敛条件（定理 7.2 的前提不能省）：① 每个状态-动作对 (s,a) 被无限多次访问——ε-greedy 保证这件事（纯贪心策略会把没试过的动作永远锁在初始值上）；② 步长满足 Robbins–Monro 条件（Σα=∞ 且 Σα²<∞，实践中常用小常数的理由见 L6）。探索不足的后果是局部的错误固化：没被访问的 (s,a) 保持初值，策略改进又恰好挑中被高估的动作——错上加错。
en: Convergence conditions (the premises of Theorem 7.2 are not optional): ① every state–action pair (s,a) is visited infinitely often — ε-greedy guarantees this (a purely greedy policy would lock untried actions at their initial values forever); ② step sizes satisfy the Robbins–Monro conditions (Σα=∞ with Σα²<∞; the practical case for small constants was made in L6). Insufficient exploration means local errors fossilise: unvisited (s,a) keep their initial values, and policy improvement then picks precisely the overestimated actions — error compounding on error.

title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling

zh: Sarsa 的目标只用一步真实奖励（其余自举）；MC 的目标全是真实奖励（一步都不自举）。n-step Sarsa 把两者接成连续谱——目标取 n 步真实奖励再加 $\gamma^{n}$·q($s_{t+n} , a_{t+n}$)：
en: Sarsa's target uses one step of real reward (bootstrapping the rest); MC's target is all real rewards (no bootstrapping at all). n-step Sarsa bridges them — the target takes n real rewards plus $\gamma^{n}$·q($s_{t+n} , a_{t+n}$):

title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling

zh: n-step Sarsa — Eq. (7.17)

title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling
