title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling

zh: n = 1 退化为 Sarsa；n = ∞（且 α = 1）退化为 MC。统计学的两难在中间震荡：n 大 → 偏差小、方差大（真实信息多，但长尾抖动厉害）；n 小 → 偏差大、方差小（自举误差，但很稳）。实现上要用「延迟更新」：q($s_{t} , a_{t}$) 要等到 t+n 时刻凑齐 n 步奖励才能更新。
en: n = 1 degenerates to Sarsa; n = ∞ (with α = 1) to MC. The statistical dilemma oscillates in between: large n → low bias, high variance (more real information, but the long tail wobbles); small n → high bias, low variance (bootstrapping error, but steady). Implementation requires "delayed updates": q($s_{t} , a_{t}$) must wait until time t+n for the n rewards to accrue.

title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling

The true return from s₁ is G₀ = 0 + 0.9·0 + 0.9²·0 + 0.9³·1 = 0.729. For the same (s₁,→), the four targets read:

title.zh: n-step Sarsa：自举与采样的连续谱
title.en: n-step Sarsa: A Spectrum between Bootstrapping and Sampling

zh: 偏差-方差谱的定量读法。n-step 目标 =（前 n 个真实奖励）+（$\gamma^{n}$ 加权的自举尾巴）。偏差随 n 收缩：自举尾巴的权重 $\gamma^{n}$ 指数式变小，到 n 覆盖整条轨迹时偏差归零（MC）；方差随 n 膨胀：每多采一步真实奖励，就多吞一步转移与奖励的随机性。挑 n 就是在「误差会被 $\gamma^{n}$ 打折」与「噪声会随 n 累积」之间找谷底——实践中 n = 3~5 常常是甜点位（经验之谈，非定理）。
en: Reading the bias–variance spectrum quantitatively. The n-step target = (n real rewards) + (a bootstrapped tail weighted by $\gamma^{n}$). Bias shrinks with n: the tail’s weight $\gamma^{n}$ decays exponentially, hitting zero when n covers the whole trajectory (MC). Variance inflates with n: each extra real reward swallows one more step of transition-and-reward randomness. Choosing n means finding the valley between “error discounted by $\gamma^{n}$” and “noise accumulating with n” — in practice n = 3~5 is often the sweet spot (folk wisdom, not a theorem).

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: Sarsa 估的是「给定策略」的 q，还要配上改进步才能找最优。Q-learning 一步到位——TD 目标里的 q(s′,a′) 换成 $\max_{a}$ q(s′,a)：
en: Sarsa estimates the q of a given policy and still needs an improvement step to seek optimality. Q-learning finishes in one stroke — the target's q(s′,a′) becomes $\max_{a}$ q(s′,a):

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: Q-learning — Eq. (7.18)

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: 身份大不同：Q-learning 是解动作价值版 Bellman 最优方程 q(s,a) = E[R + γ$\max_{a}$q(S′,a)] 的 RM 算法（书上 Box 7.5）——还记得 L3 吗？max 进方程，最优性进解。所以 Q-learning 直接估计最优动作价值 q*，收敛到 v* 对应的 q 表。
en: A very different identity: Q-learning is the RM algorithm solving the action-value Bellman optimality equation q(s,a) = E[R + γ$\max_{a}$q(S′,a)] (book Box 7.5) — recall L3: the max enters the equation, optimality enters the solution. Q-learning thus directly estimates the optimal action values q*, converging to the q-table behind v*.

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: off-policy 的含义：产生数据的策略（behavior policy，ε-greedy 负责探索）和被评估/改进的策略（target policy，贪心）可以是两个。因为 max 只对着 q 表算，不需要「下一个动作」真的被采到——数据采集方式与评估对象解耦。
en: What off-policy means: the behavior policy generating data (ε-greedy, in charge of exploration) and the target policy being evaluated/improved (greedy) can be two different things — the max reads the q-table directly and does not care whether the next action was actually taken: data collection is decoupled from evaluation.

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: 样本还更省：Sarsa 每步要 (r, s′, a′) 三件套，Q-learning 只要 (r, s′)——a′ 不需要。 书上 Figure 7.4 展示了 off-policy 学习：即使 behavior 策略是完全随机的，Q-learning 依然收敛到最优价值。
en: And it saves samples: Sarsa needs the triple (r, s′, a′) each step; Q-learning only (r, s′) — no a′ required. The book's Figure 7.4 shows off-policy learning: even with a fully random behavior policy, Q-learning converges to the optimal values.

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: 两个极端撞车：Q-learning 的目标也用了 max（像值迭代），也用了自举（像 Sarsa）——它是「值迭代的无模型版」。行为策略保证探索（大数定律的原料），目标策略保证最优性（BOE 的要求），两全其美。
en: Two extremes collide: Q-learning's target uses the max (like value iteration) and bootstraps (like Sarsa) — it is "value iteration made model-free". The behavior policy secures exploration (raw material for the law of large numbers); the target policy secures optimality (the BOE's demand). Best of both.

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: a′ = 行为策略实际采出的下一步——评估"我自己会怎么走"max = 表上的最优——评估"假如下一步走最好会怎样"，与 a′ 无关

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: Q-learning 的收敛条件同样两条，缺一不可。① 充分探索：行为策略必须把每个 (s,a) 都无限次送到（ε-greedy 或随机策略都行——书上 Figure 7.4 干脆用完全随机的行为策略照样收敛到最优，把 off-policy 的解耦展示到极致）。道理在 L6：RM 的收敛靠噪声在期望中相消，样本没送到的 (s,a)，大数定律没有原料。② 步长条件：衰减步长（Σα=∞、Σα²<∞）保证收敛到真值；收敛证明正是引用 L6 的 Dvoretzky 定理——因为 Q-learning 的目标 max $q_{t}(s ' , \cdot )$ 随 t 变化，一般的 RM 定理不够用，需要允许「目标会动」的版本。
en: Q-learning’s convergence conditions are likewise two, both mandatory. ① Sufficient exploration: the behavior policy must deliver every (s,a) infinitely often (ε-greedy or even a purely random policy — the book’s Figure 7.4 uses a fully random behavior policy and still converges to the optimum, showcasing the off-policy decoupling at its extreme). The reason traces to L6: RM convergence relies on noise cancelling in expectation, and for (s,a) pairs never sampled the law of large numbers has no raw material. ② Step-size conditions: decaying steps (Σα=∞, Σα²<∞) secure convergence to the truth; the proof cites L6’s Dvoretzky theorem — because Q-learning’s target max $q_{t}(s ' , \cdot )$ changes with t, the plain RM theorem does not suffice, and the version that allows a “moving target” is needed.

title.zh: Q-learning：直接解最优方程的无模型王者
title.en: Q-learning: Directly Solving the Optimality Equation, Model-Free

zh: 误区：拿旧策略的样本去更新新策略。策略每改一步，数据的「产地」就换一次。Sarsa 的目标里 a′ 必须是当前策略采出的动作——用昨天策略采的 (s,a,r,s′,a′) 去更新今天的 q，等于给错了方程：你解的是旧策略的 Bellman 期望方程，策略改进却已往前走。这就是 on-policy 方法「数据必须新鲜」的宿命，也解释了它样本效率的天花板。Q-learning 天生豁免：目标 r + γmax q(s′,a) 不含 a′、不依赖行为策略——只要探索到位，谁产的样本都能用。L8 的经验回放（拿旧样本反复训练）之所以配得上 Q-learning 而配不上 Sarsa，门票就在这一行更新式里。
en: Misconception: updating a new policy with an old policy’s samples. Every improvement step changes the “origin” of the data. Sarsa’s target demands that a′ be drawn by the current policy — updating today’s q with (s,a,r,s′,a′) sampled under yesterday’s policy solves the wrong equation: you are solving the previous policy’s Bellman expectation equation while policy improvement has moved on. This is the on-policy fate of “data must be fresh”, and it explains the sample-efficiency ceiling. Q-learning is exempt by birth: the target r + γmax q(s′,a) contains no a′ and does not depend on the behavior policy — given sufficient exploration, samples from anyone are usable. Why experience replay in L8 pairs with Q-learning and not with Sarsa: the admission ticket is written in this very update line.

title.zh: 统一视角：一张表看穿所有算法
title.en: A Unified View: One Table Fits All Algorithms

zh: 书用一个模板装下本章全部算法（外加 MC）：$q_{t+1} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) = $q_{t} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) − $\alpha_{t}$[$q_{t} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) − ¯$q_{t}$]。全部区别只在 TD 目标 ¯$q_{t}$ 怎么取：
en: The book fits every algorithm of this chapter (plus MC) into one template: $q_{t+1} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) = $q_{t} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) − $\alpha_{t}$[$q_{t} ( s_{t} , a_{t}$) − ¯$q_{t}$]. All the differences live in how the TD target ¯$q_{t}$ is taken:

title.zh: 统一视角：一张表看穿所有算法
title.en: A Unified View: One Table Fits All Algorithms

zh: 旋钮一（绿色）：采样长度 n —— 控制偏差-方差谱（n=1 自举最多，n=∞ 无偏） · 旋钮二（金色）：末端是否加 max —— 控制解"给定策略的方程"还是"最优方程"

title.zh: 统一视角：一张表看穿所有算法
title.en: A Unified View: One Table Fits All Algorithms

zh: 两个旋钮生成全家福：n=1、不加 max → Sarsa（评估当前策略）；n=1、加 max → Q-learning（直接解最优方程）；n<∞、不加 max → n-step Sarsa（谱上任意点）；n=∞ → MC（不自举的极端）。看任何新算法，先问两句话：「目标里有多少真实奖励？末端有没有 max？」——答案一报，它在家族里的位置就定了。
en: Two knobs generate the family portrait: n=1, no max → Sarsa (evaluates the current policy); n=1, with max → Q-learning (solves the optimality equation directly); n<∞, no max → n-step Sarsa (any point on the spectrum); n=∞ → MC (the no-bootstrapping extreme). When you meet any new algorithm, ask two questions first: “How many real rewards sit in the target? Is there a max at the end?” — the answers fix its seat in the family.

title.zh: 统一视角：一张表看穿所有算法
title.en: A Unified View: One Table Fits All Algorithms

zh: 取步长 并以整幕实际回报 作目标，统一更新式直接退化为直代式蒙特卡洛（配 则是增量平均）

title.zh: 统一视角：一张表看穿所有算法
title.en: A Unified View: One Table Fits All Algorithms

zh: 这张表是全书的「算法家谱」：目标越靠「真实回报」端，偏差越小方差越大；越靠「自举+max」端，方差越小、越偏但直奔最优。下一课的函数近似会把这个模板里的 q 表换成神经网络——模板本身终生有效。
en: This table is the book's algorithm family tree: targets nearer the "real return" end have less bias and more variance; nearer the "bootstrap + max" end, less variance, some bias, and a straight road to optimality. Next lecture swaps the q-table for a neural network — the template itself serves for life.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: TD(0) 估 v、Sarsa 估 $q_{\pi}$、Q-learning 估 q*——三个算法是同一个 RM 骨架配三种目标。加上 n-step 和 MC 的极端情形，本章完成了「无模型强化学习」的主干搭建：评估与改进交替的广义策略迭代 + 自举的样本效率 + off-policy 的解耦能力。书末点出一个工程真相：实践中学习率常取小常数而非衰减到零——因为被评估的策略一直在变（非平稳），衰减太早会「学不动」；小常数带来的小幅波动是可以接受的代价。
en: TD(0) estimates v, Sarsa estimates $q_{\pi}$, Q-learning estimates q* — one RM skeleton wearing three targets. With n-step and the MC extreme, this chapter erects the backbone of model-free RL: alternating evaluation–improvement (generalised policy iteration), bootstrapping for sample efficiency, and off-policy decoupling. The book closes with an engineering truth: in practice the learning rate is a small constant rather than decaying to zero — because the policy being evaluated keeps changing (nonstationarity), and a decayed rate soon cannot learn; small fluctuations are the acceptable price.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: TD(0)：估 $v_{\pi}$，目标 r + γv(s′)，纯评估（不含改进步）；三视角推导 = Bellman 变形 + 自举 + 一步采样。
en: TD(0): estimates $v_{\pi}$ with target r + γv(s′), pure evaluation (no improvement step); the three-view derivation = Bellman reshaping + bootstrapping + one-step sampling.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: Sarsa：估 $q_{\pi}$（on-policy），目标 r + γq(s′,a′)，五元组缺一不可；收敛到 ε-greedy 家族内的最优，数据必须新鲜。
en: Sarsa: estimates $q_{\pi}$ (on-policy) with target r + γq(s′,a′), the quintuple is non-negotiable; converges to the best within the ε-greedy family, and its data must be fresh.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: Q-learning：估 q*（off-policy），目标 r + γmax q(s′,a)，不需要 a′；行为策略管探索、目标策略管最优，收敛证明引用 Dvoretzky。
en: Q-learning: estimates q* (off-policy) with target r + γmax q(s′,a), no a′ needed; the behavior policy explores while the target policy optimises, and the convergence proof cites Dvoretzky.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: n-step：目标 = n 个真实奖励 + $\gamma^{n}$ 自举尾巴，一个 n 把偏差-方差谱连续接通 MC 与 Sarsa 两端。
en: n-step: target = n real rewards + a bootstrapped tail weighted by $\gamma^{n}$; one dial n connects MC and Sarsa continuously along the bias–variance spectrum.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: 离场自检。① 能用三视角（方程变形/自举/一步采样）说清 TD 目标 r + γv(s′) 的来历；② 能说出 TD 有偏的根源与「偏差会呼吸」的含义，以及 MC 方差不缩小的对比；③ 能逐项指出 Sarsa 与 Q-learning 更新式的差异并说出各自的收敛条件；④ 能解释为什么 Q-learning 可以用任意探索性策略的样本而 Sarsa 不行；⑤ 能用「两个旋钮」（采样长度 n、末端是否 max）定位 MC/Sarsa/n-step/Q-learning。五题全过，第 8 章的门票到手。
en: Exit self-check. ① Explain the origin of the TD target r + γv(s′) via the three views (equation reshaping / bootstrapping / one-step sampling); ② name the root of TD’s bias and what “the bias breathes” means, contrasted with MC’s never-shrinking variance; ③ point out term-by-term differences between the Sarsa and Q-learning updates and state each one’s convergence conditions; ④ explain why Q-learning can consume samples from any exploratory policy while Sarsa cannot; ⑤ locate MC/Sarsa/n-step/Q-learning with the two knobs (sampling length n, max at the end). Pass all five, and the ticket to Chapter 8 is yours.

title.zh: 本章总结：时序差分三兄弟
title.en: Chapter Summary: The Three TD Siblings

zh: 下一课预告：到目前为止 q 都是「一张表」——每个 (s,a) 一格。状态太多（围棋 $10^{170}$）表格就爆了。第 8 章：用函数近似 q(s,a)——参数化、可泛化、可用梯度下降训练。L6 的 SGD 将再挑大梁。
en: Next lecture teaser: so far q has been a table — one cell per (s,a). With huge state spaces (Go has ~$10^{170}$ states) tables explode. Chapter 8: approximate q(s,a) with a function — parameterised, generalising, trainable by gradient descent. L6's SGD returns to centre stage.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：自举的胜利
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: The Triumph of Bootstrapping

zh: 本章推理链：MC 要等轨迹结束 → 用 v(s′) 自举顶替未来 → TD = 解 Bellman 期望方程的 RM → 换成 q 就是 Sarsa → 目标取 n 步得连续谱 → 目标加 max 直接解 BOE 就是 Q-learning → 一个模板统一全部 → 学习率之争（衰减 vs 常数）。
en: This chapter's spine: MC waits for the episode’s end → bootstrap the future with v(s′) → TD = RM on the Bellman expectation equation → swap in q to get Sarsa → n real rewards make the spectrum → add max to the target and the BOE is solved directly: Q-learning → one template unifies all → the learning-rate dispute (decay vs constant).

title.zh: 代码精讲：Sarsa 与 Q-learning 对肩跑
title.en: Code Walkthrough: Sarsa and Q-learning Shoulder to Shoulder

zh: 两个算法只差一行——TD 目标里「下一个动作的 q」还是「下一状态的最大 q」。并排写出来，on-policy 与 off-policy 的工程差别一目了然：Sarsa 采样时必须先算 a′，Q-learning 不用。
en: The two algorithms differ by a single line — whether the TD target reads "the next action's q" or "the max q of the next state". Written side by side, the engineering difference between on- and off-policy pops out: Sarsa must compute a′ while sampling; Q-learning does not.

title.zh: 问答：时序差分九连问（精选）
title.en: Q&A: Nine Questions on TD (Selected)

zh: on/off-policy 之辨、学习率之争、要不要学全部状态——本章最容易被面试官追问的点都在这里。
en: The on/off-policy distinction, the learning-rate dispute, and "do we need all states optimal" — the points interviewers love, all here.

title.zh: 问答：时序差分九连问（精选）
title.en: Q&A: Nine Questions on TD (Selected)

zh: 翻卡前先过三题：① 「TD 的目标为什么是 r + γv(s′) 而不是别的形状」（Bellman 期望方程 + 自举 + 一步采样，三视角缺一不可）；② 「Sarsa 和 Q-learning 到底差在哪」（目标里的 a′ 换成 max——一个评估自己、一个瞄准最优，on/off-policy 之分全由此起）；③ 「学习率到底该衰减还是常数」（平稳目标衰减、非平稳目标小常数——被评估的策略一直在变，这正是 L6 两种记忆的现场应用）。
en: Before flipping, run through three: ① “Why is the TD target r + γv(s′) and not some other shape” (Bellman expectation equation + bootstrapping + one-step sampling — no view may be missing); ② “Where exactly do Sarsa and Q-learning differ” (a′ in the target replaced by max — one evaluates itself, the other aims at the optimum; the on/off-policy split starts exactly there); ③ “Should the learning rate decay or stay constant” (decay for stationary targets, small constants for nonstationary ones — the policy being evaluated keeps changing, L6’s two kinds of memory applied on the spot).

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 表格法的死穴是泛化：更新 s₁ 的价值，s₂、s₃ 的价值纹丝不动——格子之间互相不认识。状态空间一大（围棋 ~$10^{170}$、连续控制任务无穷多），表既存不下也学不快。函数近似的解法：用参数化函数 v̂(s, w) ≈ $v_{\pi}(s)$ 代替查表——最简单的线性形式 v̂(s,w) = $\phi^{T}(s)$w，其中 φ(s) 是特征向量（把状态编码成几个数），w 是待学参数。
en: The table method's fatal flaw is generalisation: updating s₁'s value leaves s₂ and s₃ untouched — cells do not know each other. With huge state spaces (Go ~$10^{170}$, continuous control infinitely many), tables can neither be stored nor learned quickly. Function approximation answers: a parameterised function v̂(s, w) ≈ $v_{\pi}(s)$ replaces the lookup — the simplest linear form v̂(s,w) = $\phi^{T}(s)$w, where φ(s) is a feature vector (encoding the state into a few numbers) and w is the parameter to learn.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 检索方式变了：表格查一次 O(1)；函数要输入 s 算前向（神经网络的 forward）。
en: Retrieval changes: a table is O(1); a function computes a forward pass on s.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 更新方式变了：表格改一个格子；函数更新参数 w——间接地改变许多状态的价值。这既是泛化的来源，也是不稳定性的来源。
en: Updating changes: a table rewrites one cell; a function updates w — indirectly changing many states' values at once. This is both the source of generalisation and of instability.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 拟合问题：给定各状态真值 {(sᵢ, $v_{\pi}$(sᵢ))}，最小化 Σ(v̂(sᵢ,w) − $v_{\pi}$(sᵢ))² 就是标准最小二乘，线性情形闭式解 w* = ($\Phi^{T}$Φ)⁻¹Φ$v_{\pi}$。
en: The fitting problem: given true pairs {(sᵢ, $v_{\pi}$(sᵢ))}, minimising Σ(v̂(sᵢ,w) − $v_{\pi}$(sᵢ))² is plain least squares; the linear case has the closed form w* = ($\Phi^{T}$Φ)⁻¹Φ$v_{\pi}$.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 状态空间爆炸记的三笔账。① 存储账：围棋 ~$10^{170}$ 个状态，比可观测宇宙的原子数（~$10^{80}$）还多 90 个数量级——一格一个数，宇宙里没有硬盘装得下；连续状态（机器人关节角度）更是直接无穷。② 样本账：更隐蔽的一笔。L7 的收敛条件要求每个 (s,a) 被访问无穷多次——表格时代这靠 ε-greedy 慢慢磨；状态一多，绝大多数格子终身饿肚子，估出来的价值全是初始值。③ 迁移账：两个像素只差一点的局面，在表里是毫无关系的两格——从 (s=1000) 学到的东西帮不到 (s=1001)。函数近似一笔清三账：参数个数与 |S| 脱钩（存储）、改一次参数全体状态跟着动（样本被复用）、相似输入相似输出（迁移=泛化）。
en: Three bills in the ledger of the state-space explosion. ① Storage: Go has ~$10^{170}$ states — ninety orders of magnitude more than the atoms in the observable universe (~$10^{80}$); one number per cell and no disk in the universe suffices; continuous states (robot joint angles) are outright infinite. ② Samples: the subtler bill. L7’s convergence conditions demand every (s,a) be visited infinitely often — tabular times grind this out slowly with ε-greedy; once states multiply, most cells starve forever and their “values” remain initial values. ③ Transfer: two pixel-wise nearly identical screens are total strangers in a table — what is learned at s=1000 does nothing for s=1001. Function approximation clears all three at once: parameter count decouples from |S| (storage), one parameter update moves every state (samples are reused), similar inputs yield similar outputs (transfer = generalisation).

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 表格法 = 线性近似的特例 · Tables are a special case

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 特征构造的直觉：把「相似」编码进向量。泛化不是函数近似白送的——它来自特征：两个状态的向量靠得近，学其中一个时另一个就顺带被修正。所以特征设计的本质是回答「什么算相似」。多项式特征按「坐标幂次」相似（s 和 s+1 的低次幂几乎相同）；Fourier 特征按「频率成分」相似（低频波覆盖大片相邻状态，高频波管局部细节）；Tile coding 干脆把状态空间铺上瓷砖，落进同一块瓷砖的状态共享激活。特征是先验知识的注入点：你对问题结构懂多少，就能把相似性设计得多准——这比调网络结构更本质。
en: The intuition of feature construction: encode “similarity” into vectors. Generalisation is not a free gift of approximation — it comes from features: when two states have nearby vectors, learning one incidentally corrects the other. Feature design is therefore the answer to “what counts as similar”. Polynomial features are similar by coordinate powers (low powers of s and s+1 nearly coincide); Fourier features by frequency content (low frequencies cover swathes of neighbouring states, high frequencies handle local detail); tile coding literally tiles the state space, states in the same tile sharing activation. Features are the injection point of prior knowledge: the better you understand the problem’s structure, the more precisely you can encode similarity — more fundamental than tweaking network architectures.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 泛化是函数近似的超能力（书 Figure 8.4）：s₃ 的经验样本不仅能更新 s₃ 自己，还会通过共享参数 w 顺带修正相邻状态的价值——因为它们共享特征。这正是神经网络能玩游戏的根本原因：没见过的局面，靠相似特征举一反三。
en: Generalisation is the superpower (book Figure 8.4): an experience sample at s₃ updates not only s₃ but, through the shared parameters w, also the values of neighbouring states — they share features. This is exactly why neural networks can play games: unseen situations generalise from similar features.

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 长期访问频率为加权矩阵 提供自然权重——目标附近停留占比高达 72.4%

title.zh: 从表格到函数：为什么必须换表示？
title.en: From Table to Function: Why the Representation Must Change

zh: 换表示不是抛弃前七章，而是推广它们。one-hot 特征下函数近似精确退回表格法——TD、Sarsa、Q-learning 的所有结论原封不动。函数近似是「更一般的语言」，表格是这门语言里最奢侈的方言（每个状态一个专属参数）。学第 8 章的正确姿势：每学一个结论，都问一句「表格情形它退化成什么」——答案应该恰好是你已经会的东西。
en: Changing representation does not abandon the first seven chapters — it generalises them. With one-hot features, function approximation degenerates exactly back to tables, and every conclusion about TD, Sarsa, and Q-learning carries over untouched. Function approximation is “a more general language”, and tables are its most extravagant dialect (one dedicated parameter per state). The right posture for Chapter 8: with each new result, ask “what does this degenerate to in the tabular case” — the answer should be precisely what you already know.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 把近似写成优化问题：目标函数 J(w) = E[($v_{\pi}(S)$ − v̂(S,w))²]——让估计值和真值的平方误差期望最小（S 的分布决定「更在乎哪些状态」，平稳分布是最常用的选择）。对 J 做梯度下降，再按 SGD 精神把期望换成单样本：
en: Pose approximation as optimisation: J(w) = E[($v_{\pi}(S)$ − v̂(S,w))²] — minimise the expected squared error (the distribution of S decides "which states matter"; the stationary distribution is the usual choice). Gradient descent on J, then swap the expectation for a single sample in SGD spirit:

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: TD + 函数近似的骨架 · The skeleton — Eq. (8.12)

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 麻烦来了：真值 $v_{\pi} ( s_{t}$) 未知（不然还学什么）。两种替换：MC 替换——用轨迹回报 $g_{t}$；TD 替换——用自举目标 r + γv̂(s′,w)。后者代入得到 TD-Linear：
en: The catch: the true $v_{\pi} ( s_{t}$) is unknown (or there would be nothing to learn). Two substitutions: MC — use the episode return $g_{t}$; TD — use the bootstrap target r + γv̂(s′,w). The latter gives TD-Linear:

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: （线性时 v̂ = φ(s)）

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 保持策略和训练步数相同。用二阶多项式走 200 步，再换成 one-hot 走 200 步。比较估计曲线与真值曲线，注意共享参数怎样把一个状态的更新传给别的状态。
en: Keep the policy and training budget fixed. Run 200 steps with quadratic features, then 200 with one-hot features. Compare both fitted curves against the reference and look for the effect of shared parameters across states.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 半梯度（semi-gradient）的精髓：目标里也有 w，但求导时装作没有。看仔细：TD 替换后的目标 r + γv̂(s′,$w_{t}$) 本身就是 w 的函数——按微积分的规矩，对 J 求真梯度应该把这一项也链式展开。TD-Linear 偏不：把目标整体当作常数（当作「真值 $v_{\pi}(s)$ 的临时替身」），只对预测侧 v̂(s,w) 求导。为什么叫「半」：只做了一半的求导。为什么敢：若把目标看成真值的样本，更新式恰好保持 SGD 的形状，L6 的整套机器直接复用；而且自举目标只含一步噪声，方差小。代价是什么？更新方向不再是任何固定目标函数的梯度——你优化的靶子自己会随 w 移动，「梯度下降保证下山」的直觉就此失效。
en: The essence of the semi-gradient: the target contains w too, but we differentiate as if it did not. Look closely: the TD-substituted target r + γv̂(s′,$w_{t}$) is itself a function of w — by the rules of calculus, a true gradient of J should chain-rule through it as well. TD-Linear refuses: treat the whole target as a constant (a stand-in for the true value $v_{\pi}(s)$) and differentiate only the prediction side v̂(s,w). Why “semi”: only half the differentiation is done. Why dare: if the target is viewed as a sample of the truth, the update keeps the SGD shape and all of L6’s machinery carries over; and the bootstrap target carries only one step of noise — small variance. And the price? The update direction is no longer the gradient of any fixed objective — the bullseye you optimise moves with w, and the “gradient descent goes downhill” intuition dies there.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 金色项被整体丢弃——便宜一步，代价是"不再是真梯度"

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: MC 替换（真梯度）：目标 $g_{t}$ 是已实现的真实回报，不含 w——对 J(w)=E[(g−v̂)²] 是货真价实的 SGD。线性情形凸，收敛到全局最优；一般非凸目标无法保证达到局部最优。代价：高方差 + 必须等回合结束。
en: MC substitution (true gradient): the target $g_{t}$ is a realised return that contains no w — this is honest SGD on J(w)=E[(g−v̂)²]. The linear case is convex and converges globally; a general nonconvex objective has no local-optimum guarantee. The price: high variance plus waiting for episode ends.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: TD 替换（半梯度）：目标 r + γv̂(s′,w) 含 w 却被当作常数——更新不是任何固定 J 的梯度。换来的是：单步更新、低方差、在线可学。即便收敛，收敛点一般也不是 J 的极小值，而是投影 Bellman 误差（PBE）的不动点。
en: TD substitution (semi-gradient): the target r + γv̂(s′,w) contains w yet is treated as constant — the update is not the gradient of any fixed J. What it buys: per-step updates, low variance, online learning. Even when it converges, the limit is generally not a minimiser of J but a fixed point of the projected Bellman error (PBE).

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 一句话记牢：MC+FA 是「无偏但吵的 SGD」；TD+FA 是「安静但路子不正的伪 SGD」。两者优化的目标函数压根不同——这不是精度差别，是去向差别。
en: One line to remember: MC+FA is an “unbiased but noisy SGD”; TD+FA is a “quiet but improperly licensed pseudo-SGD”. The two optimise different objectives altogether — not a difference in accuracy but in destination.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 【书外延伸，助理解】半梯度的代价可能不止「学不准」，还能「学崩」。 Baird 的著名反例（1995）：一个仅 7 个状态的小 MDP + 线性 v̂ + TD 半梯度 + off-policy 训练，参数 ‖w‖ 每一步都增大，直冲无穷——不是收敛慢，是发散。这正警告了后面的「致命三角」：自举 + 函数近似 + off-policy 同开时，半梯度没有任何收敛保证。顺带一个好消息：纯 on-policy 的线性半梯度 TD(0) 有收敛保证（收敛到 PBE 不动点，不是真值）——书上的理论结论限定的都是这类温和情形。
en: [Beyond the book, for intuition] The semi-gradient’s price may exceed “learning imperfectly” — it can “learn to explosion”. Baird’s famous counterexample (1995): a mere 7-state MDP + linear v̂ + TD semi-gradient + off-policy training, and ‖w‖ grows at every step, racing to infinity — not slow convergence but divergence. It is precisely the early warning of the later “deadly triad”: with bootstrapping + function approximation + off-policy all switched on, the semi-gradient carries no convergence guarantee whatsoever. One piece of good news alongside: purely on-policy linear semi-gradient TD(0) does converge (to the PBE fixed point, not the truth) — the book’s theoretical results are all stated for such tame settings.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 误区：把 MC 目标与自举目标混着用、混着比。常见三种翻车：① 目标函数写的是 E[($v_{\pi}$ − v̂)²]（真值版 J），更新式里却代入自举目标还自称在「最小化这个 J」——半梯度的去向是 PBE 不动点，不是 J 的极小值；② 半个 batch 用 $g_{t}$、半个 batch 用 r + γv̂ 混着训——两套目标函数的梯度方向相互拉扯，收敛点没有解释；③ 拿「MC 无偏」去要求 TD、拿「TD 低方差」去要求 MC——两个算法优化的对象不同，「谁更准」的问法本身就不成立。正确姿势：先想清楚要优化哪个目标函数，再选与它一致的替换。
en: Misconception: mixing MC targets with bootstrap targets. Three common crashes: ① the objective is written as E[($v_{\pi}$ − v̂)²] (the true-value J) while the update silently substitutes the bootstrap target, still claiming to “minimise this J” — the semi-gradient heads to the PBE fixed point, not a minimiser of J; ② half a batch uses $g_{t}$ and the other half r + γv̂ — gradients of two different objectives tug against each other, and the limit point admits no interpretation; ③ demanding “MC is unbiased” of TD and “TD is low-variance” of MC — the two optimise different objects, so asking “which is more accurate” is malformed. The right posture: decide which objective you are optimising, then choose the substitution consistent with it.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 线性 TD(0) 半梯度收敛至投影 Bellman 误差零点 ：，而非最小化真值误差

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 特征选择决定能学成什么样：多项式特征（阶数越高越弯）、Fourier 特征（正交性好、书上的例子用它）、Tile Coding（把状态空间铺瓷砖，激活少数几块）。特征太少欠拟合，太多过拟合。
en: Feature choice decides what can be learned: polynomial features (higher order, curvier), Fourier features (nice orthogonality — the book's example), tile coding (tile the state space, activate a few tiles). Too few features underfit; too many overfit.

title.zh: TD + 函数近似 = 一个优化问题
title.en: TD + Function Approximation = An Optimisation Problem

zh: 理论身份：TD-Linear 收敛到的不是真值 $v_{\pi}$ 本身，而是它在特征空间上的投影——最小化投影 Bellman 误差（PBE）。表格特征（one-hot）时特征完备，投影退化为真值——表格法是函数近似的特例。
en: Theoretical identity: TD-Linear converges not to the true $v_{\pi}$ but to its projection onto the feature space — minimising the projected Bellman error (PBE). With table-lookup (one-hot) features the projection degenerates to the truth — tabular methods are a special case of function approximation.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 把 7 章的表格换近似函数，机械得不能再机械：Sarsa 版把 v̂ 换成 q̂(s,a,w)：$w_{t+1} = w_{t}$ + α[r + γq̂(s′,a′,w) − q̂(s,a,w)]∇q̂；Q-learning 版把目标再换成 r + γ·$\max_{a}$q̂(s′,a,w)（Algorithm 8.3）。配上 ε-greedy 改进步，就能学出通往目标的策略——书上用 Fourier 特征（阶数 5）在 5×5 世界跑通，总奖励和回合长度逐步收敛。
en: Swapping the tabular values of Chapter 7 for approximations is mechanical: the Sarsa version replaces v̂ with q̂(s,a,w): $w_{t+1} = w_{t}$ + α[r + γq̂(s′,a′,w) − q̂(s,a,w)]∇q̂; the Q-learning version further swaps the target for r + γ·$\max_{a}$q̂(s′,a,w) (Algorithm 8.3). With an ε-greedy improvement step this learns a policy to the target — the book runs it on a 5×5 world with order-5 Fourier features, total reward and episode length converging step by step.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 致命三角（deadly triad）预告：自举（bootstrapping）+ 函数近似（近似目标）+ 异策略学习（off-policy）：行为策略和目标策略不同，数据也可在线采集。三者同用，收敛性不再有保证——值可能震荡甚至爆炸。表格时代三者共处无恙；函数时代要靠技巧驯服。DQN 的两大技术就是为此而生。
en: Preview of the deadly triad: bootstrapping + function approximation + off-policy training together void the convergence guarantees — values may oscillate or explode. In the tabular era the three coexisted peacefully; the function era needs tricks to tame them. DQN’s two techniques were born exactly for this.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 与 L7 逐字对应，仅 q 表换成 q̂(·,·,w)、"改一格"换成"沿 q̂ 推参数"——注意两个目标里的 w 都被半梯度当成了常数

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 三角之一：自举。目标 r + γv̂(s′,w) 追着正在更新的 w 跑——预测改一分，目标跟着改一分，误差可以在「自己喂自己」的循环里被放大而不是被消掉。
en: Corner one: bootstrapping. The target r + γv̂(s′,w) chases the very w being updated — the prediction shifts a little and the target shifts with it; in the “feeding oneself” loop, error can be amplified rather than cancelled.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 三角之二：函数近似。更新一个 (s,a) 会牵动所有共享特征的状态——表格时代「错也只错一格」，函数时代「一处更新、处处移动」，误差有了传播的公路网。
en: Corner two: function approximation. Updating one (s,a) drags every state sharing its features — in tabular times “an error stays in its cell”; in function times “one update moves everything”, and error gains a highway network to travel.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 三角之三：off-policy。样本来自行为策略，目标函数里的分布却应是目标策略的——分布错位让 SGD 的大数定律失准（L8 §8.2 里「平稳分布加权」的那个分布对不上了）。Q-learning 的 max 恰好三样全占，所以它既是利器又是危险品。
en: Corner three: off-policy. Samples come from the behavior policy while the objective’s distribution should be the target policy’s — the distributional mismatch throws SGD’s law of large numbers off balance (the very stationary-distribution weighting of §8.2 no longer lines up). Q-learning’s max takes all three at once, which makes it both the sharpest tool and the most dangerous one.

title.zh: Sarsa/Q-learning 换上函数引擎
title.en: Sarsa and Q-learning with a Function Engine

zh: 【书外延伸】max 还有一层「放大镜效应」。max 不但占着 off-policy 的角，还会挑中估计里的高估噪声：max 对每个动作的估计误差只取正向的一侧——哪个动作被高估得最离谱，哪个就被 max 选中并写进目标，误差经自举一代代往下传。这就是「最大化偏差」（maximization bias）。Double Q-learning 的解法是把「选动作」和「算价值」拆给两套独立估计，让高估无处藏身。它与致命三角一起，构成了「为什么函数版 Q-learning 特别难驯」的完整答案。
en: [Beyond the book] The max also acts as an amplifier. Beyond occupying the off-policy corner, max selects the upward noise among estimates: max keeps only the positive side of each action’s estimation error — whichever action is most grossly overestimated gets picked, written into the target, and passed down through bootstrapping generation after generation. This is the “maximisation bias”. Double Q-learning’s remedy splits “choosing the action” and “evaluating it” between two independent estimates, leaving overestimation nowhere to hide. Together with the deadly triad, it completes the answer to “why functional Q-learning is especially hard to tame”.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 把 Q-learning 的 q 表换成深度神经网络 q̂(s,a,w)，目标函数 J = E[(R + γ$\max_{a}$q̂(S′,a,w) − q̂(S,A,w))²]——可以看作「平方 Bellman 最优误差」。麻烦：梯度里 w 同时出现在目标和目标网络两侧——自己追自己，必抖。DQN 的两大稳定化技术：
en: Replace Q-learning’s q-table with a deep network q̂(s,a,w) and the objective becomes J = E[(R + γ$\max_{a}$q̂(S′,a,w) − q̂(S,A,w))²] — readable as the “squared Bellman optimality error”. The trouble: w appears on BOTH sides of the target — chasing oneself, guaranteed wobble. DQN’s two stabilising techniques:

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 目标网络（target network）：复制一份参数 $w_{T}$ 专门算目标，冻结一段时间再同步——把「追自己」变成「追一个暂时不动的影子」。
en: Target network: clone the parameters $w_{T}$ solely to compute targets, frozen for a while then synced — turning “chasing oneself” into “chasing a briefly frozen shadow”.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 经验回放（experience replay）：把经验 (s,a,r,s′) 存进大池子，训练时随机抽小批量——打破样本间的时间相关性（i.i.d. 的近似），还能反复利用稀有经验。
en: Experience replay: store transitions (s,a,r,s′) in a big pool and sample random mini-batches — breaking temporal correlation in the data (approximating i.i.d.) and reusing rare experiences.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 奖励截断：DQN 原论文还把奖励夹到 [−1,1]，使单个网络能同时适配几十种 Atari 游戏——奖励尺度统一是跨任务泛化的隐形前提。
en: Reward clipping: the original DQN paper also clamps rewards to [−1,1] so one network can play dozens of Atari games at once — a unified reward scale is the hidden prerequisite of cross-task generalisation.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 历史地位：DQN 是最早、最成功的深度强化学习算法之一——2015 年 Nature 论文里它用同一套网络从像素级别打通了 49 款 Atari 游戏，多个游戏超过人类水平。它证明了「深度网络 + RL」不是凑热闹，而是通向通用学习的路。
en: Historic standing: DQN is among the earliest and most successful deep RL algorithms — the 2015 Nature paper played 49 Atari games from raw pixels with one architecture, surpassing humans on several. It proved that “deep nets + RL” is a road to general learning, not a gimmick.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 【书外延伸，助理解】两大技巧恰好对着半梯度的两个病灶。病灶一：目标里的 w 会跟着更新跑（半梯度的「移动靶」）。目标网络把靶子冻结一段——在一个同步周期内，目标 r + γmax q̂(s′,a,$w_{T}$) 里的 $w_{T}$ 真的是常数，更新在这一周期内货真价实地变回了 SGD（至少对预测侧而言靶子不动了）。病灶二：连续交互的样本高度相关 + 分布随策略漂移（SGD 大数定律失准）。经验回放把时序打散、把新旧样本混匀——随机小批量近似独立同分布，大数定律重新上岗。两招都不改算法的「骨架」，只改「训练的节奏」——这正是工程驯服理论的典范。
en: [Beyond the book, for intuition] The two tricks aim at exactly the two lesions of the semi-gradient. Lesion one: the w inside the target runs along with the update (the semi-gradient’s “moving target”). The target network freezes the target for a while — within one sync period, the $w_{T}$ in r + γmax q̂(s′,a,$w_{T}$) is genuinely constant, and for that period the update honestly becomes SGD again (the target at least stands still for the prediction side). Lesion two: consecutive samples are strongly correlated and the distribution drifts with the policy (SGD’s law of large numbers loses footing). Experience replay shuffles the timeline and mixes old with new — random mini-batches approximate i.i.d., and the law of large numbers returns to duty. Neither trick alters the algorithm’s skeleton; both only retune “the rhythm of training” — engineering taming theory at its finest.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 讲义核心（L8 Slides 53–58）· 为何必须均匀经验回放？100 步与 1000 步差在哪？① 数学原因：DQN 的目标函数 $J(w) = \mathbb{E}_{(S,A)\sim d}[(R + \gamma\max_a \hat{q}(S',a,w_T) - \hat{q}(S,A,w))^2]$ 假定了关于 $(S,A)$ 的平稳分布 $d$（工程常取均匀回放），而单条在线轨迹相邻样本高度相关且极度偏态，必须存入池中均匀随机抽样（uniform sampling）以同时打破相关性与维持稳定分布；② 100 步 vs 1000 步错觉：只采集 $100$ 步单回合数据回放时，因仅覆盖极少数状态，TD Loss 会迅速跌近 $0$ 制造「已收敛」假象，真实全图状态价值 RMSE 却仍高企；扩展到 $1000$ 步充分覆盖后再配合目标网络冻结更新，TD Loss 与真值误差才双双落底。
en: Slide Core (L8 Slides 53–58) · Why Uniform Experience Replay? 100 vs 1000 Steps: ① Mathematical necessity: DQN’s objective $J(w) = \mathbb{E}_{(S,A)\sim d}[(R + \gamma\max_a \hat{q}(S',a,w_T) - \hat{q}(S,A,w))^2]$ is defined with respect to a stationary distribution $d$ over $(S,A)$. Online correlated trajectories violate this assumption; uniform random replay approximates i.i.d. draws from a stable coverage distribution; ② 100-step vs 1000-step illusion: with a short 100-step rollout covering few cells, TD loss rapidly hits $0$ while full-grid state-value RMSE stays stubbornly high; only 1000-step coverage drives both TD loss and true value error down together.

title.zh: Deep Q-Learning：深度学习与 RL 会师
title.en: Deep Q-Learning: Where Deep Learning Meets RL

zh: 别误会：DQN 没有摘掉三角的任何一角。目标网络只是「分期冻结」（自举还在，只是每 C 步才换一次靶子）；经验回放只是「逼近 i.i.d.」（样本仍然来自会过期的旧策略，只是被搅匀了）。致命三角在 DQN 里三样全占——收敛保证依然缺席，实验里也确实常见价值高估与训练崩溃。所以工程实践还有一整套「没有定理、只有纪律」的配方：小步长、梯度裁剪、奖励截断、定期同步、随时盯住 q 值的量级。理论缺席的地方，纪律补位——这也是读深度 RL 论文时方法节越写越长的原因。
en: Do not misread: DQN removes none of the triad’s corners. The target network only “freezes in instalments” (bootstrapping remains; the target just switches every C steps); experience replay only “approaches i.i.d.” (samples still come from an aging policy, merely stirred). DQN holds all three corners at once — convergence guarantees remain absent, and value overestimation and training collapse are indeed common in experiments. Hence a whole recipe of “no theorems, only discipline” in practice: small step sizes, gradient clipping, reward clipping, periodic syncing, and a constant eye on q-value magnitudes. Where theory is absent, discipline stands in — one reason the method sections of deep RL papers keep growing longer.

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 本章把 TD 学习从表格搬到函数，关键是换一副眼镜：价值估计不再是一组数，而是一个优化问题——目标函数（平方误差/Bellman 误差/投影 Bellman 误差）+ 优化器（SGD 家族）。特征决定上限，优化器决定下限；线性情形理解透了，非线性（神经网络）只是换更强的 v̂。值函数近似的终极意义：让神经网络得以与强化学习合体。
en: This chapter moved TD learning from tables to functions, and the key is a new pair of glasses: value estimation is no longer a collection of numbers but an optimisation problem — an objective (squared error / Bellman error / projected Bellman error) plus an optimiser (the SGD family). Features set the ceiling; the optimiser sets the floor; once the linear case is fully understood, the nonlinear (neural network) case is just a stronger v̂. The ultimate meaning of value function approximation: it marries neural networks to reinforcement learning.

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 下一课预告：一直以来我们近似的是价值，策略只是「从价值里 argmax」。第 9 章调转枪口：直接用函数近似策略本身 π(a|s,θ)，用梯度上升直接优化策略——策略梯度方法，深度 RL 的另一根支柱。
en: Next lecture teaser: so far we approximated values and treated the policy as an argmax over them. Chapter 9 turns the gun around: approximate the policy itself with a function π(a|s,θ) and ascend its gradient directly — policy gradient methods, the other pillar of deep RL.

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 有收敛保证的地带：表格法全部结论（L7 定理）；on-policy + 线性 + 半梯度 TD → 收敛到 PBE 不动点；MC 替换 + 任意可微 v̂ → 真 SGD（线性全局最优、非凸情形需另证收敛条件）。
en: Where guarantees hold: all tabular conclusions (L7 theorems); on-policy + linear + semi-gradient TD → convergence to the PBE fixed point; MC substitution + any differentiable v̂ → true SGD (global optimum if linear, no general local-optimum guarantee otherwise).

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 没有保证的地带：致命三角全占（自举 + 函数近似 + off-policy）——Baird 反例证明可以发散；DQN 带着两大纪律闯入此地并活了下来，但那是工程的胜利，不是定理的胜利。
en: Where guarantees vanish: the full deadly triad (bootstrapping + approximation + off-policy) — Baird’s counterexample proves divergence is possible; DQN survived this territory with its two disciplines, an engineering victory, not a theorem’s.

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 读论文的姿势：看到新算法先做三连问——「自举吗？近似吗？off-policy 吗？」——占两角基本稳妥，三角全占就看它带什么纪律（冻结？回放？裁剪？信任域？）。
en: How to read papers: upon meeting a new algorithm, ask three questions — “Does it bootstrap? Approximate? Go off-policy?” — two corners is usually safe; with all three, check what discipline it carries (freezing? replay? clipping? trust regions?).

title.zh: 本章总结：近似即优化
title.en: Chapter Summary: Approximation Is Optimisation

zh: 离场自检。① 能列出状态空间爆炸的三笔账并说出函数近似如何逐笔清掉；② 能解释 one-hot 特征下函数近似为何精确退回表格法；③ 能说出「半梯度」的「半」指什么、扔掉的链式项是哪一项、代价是什么；④ 能分辨 MC 替换（真 SGD）与 TD 替换（半梯度、PBE 不动点）在去向上的差别；⑤ 能逐角说出致命三角各自贡献哪种不稳定，以及 DQN 两招分别治哪个病灶。五题全过，第 9 章见。
en: Exit self-check. ① List the three bills of the state-space explosion and how function approximation pays each; ② explain why one-hot features make approximation degenerate exactly back to tables; ③ say what the “semi” in semi-gradient refers to, which chain-rule term is discarded, and at what cost; ④ distinguish the destinations of MC substitution (true SGD) versus TD substitution (semi-gradient, PBE fixed point); ⑤ name the instability each corner of the deadly triad contributes, and which lesion each DQN technique treats. Pass all five, and see you in Chapter 9.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：表格的黄昏
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: The Twilight of Tables

zh: 本章推理链：表格无泛化、存不下 → 参数化函数 + 特征 → 近似即最小二乘 → 真值未知，MC/TD 目标顶替 → 线性 on-policy TD 的期望更新对应投影 Bellman 不动点 → 收敛到投影 → Sarsa/Q-learning 换引擎 → 致命三角现形 → 目标网络 + 经验回放驯服之 → DQN 会师深度学习。
en: This chapter’s spine: tables neither generalise nor scale → parameterise with features → approximation as least squares → truth unknown, substitute MC/TD targets → TD-Linear = a projected Bellman fixed-point update → converges to a projection → Sarsa/Q-learning swap engines → the deadly triad appears → target network + experience replay tame it → DQN marries deep learning.

title.zh: 代码精讲：TD-Linear 与 DQN 骨架
title.en: Code Walkthrough: TD-Linear and the DQN Skeleton

zh: TD-Linear 十行可见全貌；DQN 骨架用伪代码点出目标网络与回放池的落点——参数 $w_{T}$ 出现在目标里但梯度只流向 w，这就是「冻结」的代码含义。
en: TD-Linear shows its whole face in ten lines; the DQN skeleton uses pseudocode to mark exactly where the target network and the replay pool sit — the parameter $w_{T}$ appears in the target while gradients flow only into w: that is what “freezing” means in code.

title.zh: 问答：表格 vs 函数
title.en: Q&A: Tables vs Functions

zh: 检索方式、更新方式、泛化能力、平稳分布的角色——本章问答聚焦「两种表示的本质差异」。
en: Retrieval, update, generalisation, and the role of the stationary distribution — the Q&As focus on the essential differences between the two representations.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 之前所有算法都是价值驱动的：先估价值，再 argmax 出策略。argmax 有个天生的毛病——它是不可导的硬操作，而且吐出来的永远是确定性策略。策略梯度方法直接参数化策略本身：π(a|s,θ) = exp(h(s,a)ᵀθ) / $\Sigma_{a '}$ exp(h(s,a′)ᵀθ)（softmax，h 是特征）。θ 一动，所有动作的概率连续地变——可以求导、可以试探、天生随机。
en: Every algorithm so far was value-driven: estimate values, then argmax out a policy. argmax has a birth defect — it is a hard, non-differentiable operation, and it always spits out deterministic policies. Policy gradient methods parameterise the policy itself: π(a|s,θ) = exp(h(s,a)ᵀθ) / $\Sigma_{a '}$ exp(h(s,a′)ᵀθ) (softmax, with features h). Move θ and every action’s probability shifts continuously — differentiable, searchable, naturally stochastic.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 范式转移：之前是「学价值 → 间接得到策略」（价值是主角、策略是副产品）；现在是「直接学策略」（策略是主角、价值退居辅助——只用来指导梯度）。第 10 章的 Actor-Critic 名字就来自这个分工的进化版。
en: A paradigm shift: before, “learn values → obtain a policy indirectly” (values star, policy by-product); now, “learn the policy directly” (policy stars, values demoted to helpers — only guiding the gradient). The Actor-Critic split in Chapter 10 is this division of labour, evolved.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 动机链：从「两步走」到「一步到位」。值方法的路线是两步：先估 q*，再 argmax 出策略。三处硬伤：① argmax 不可导——深度学习的一切武器（反向传播）在硬选择面前失效，q 估得再好，选择这一步把梯度切断了；② 吐不出随机策略——argmax 永远是确定性的，可有些问题的最优解天生是混合的（石头剪刀布：任何固定招式都会被针对，均匀随机才不可剥削）；③ 连续动作无能为力——动作是一段实数时，argmax 本身就是一个优化问题（在无穷集合上找最大），每个决策步都嵌套一层求极值，算不起。直接参数化 π(a|s,θ) 三伤全治：θ 一动概率连续变化（可导）、天然输出分布（随机）、对连续动作输出分布的参数（如高斯的均值方差）而不是单个动作。
en: The motivation chain: from “two steps” to “one step”. The value route is two steps: estimate q*, then argmax out a policy. Three hard wounds: ① argmax is non-differentiable — every deep-learning weapon (backpropagation) fails before a hard choice; however well q is estimated, the selection step severs the gradient. ② It cannot emit stochastic policies — argmax is always deterministic, yet some problems have inherently mixed optima (rock-paper-scissors: any fixed move gets exploited; only uniform randomisation is unexploitable). ③ Continuous actions are helpless — when actions form a continuum, argmax is itself an optimisation problem (maximising over an infinite set), nesting a full optimisation inside every decision step, which nobody can afford. Parameterising π(a|s,θ) directly heals all three: probabilities shift continuously as θ moves (differentiable), it naturally outputs a distribution (stochastic), and for continuous actions it outputs the parameters of a distribution (e.g. a Gaussian’s mean and spread) rather than a single action.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 策略为什么可以被微分？softmax 把「分数」光滑地映成「概率」：exp 处处可导、求和归一化不破坏光滑性。θ 的任何微小移动，都会引起每个动作概率的微小移动——变化率就是 $\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ)，有闭式可算。
en: Why can the policy be differentiated? Softmax maps “scores” to “probabilities” smoothly: exp is differentiable everywhere, and sum-normalisation preserves smoothness. Any infinitesimal move of θ induces infinitesimal moves of every action probability — the rates of change are exactly $\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ), available in closed form.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 数值手感：两个动作、分数 h = (0, 0)，策略是 (0.5, 0.5)。把第二个动作的分数抬 0.5：π 变成 (0.378, 0.622)——没有跳变，从 0.5 平滑滑向 0.622。θ 再抬 10 分，π ≈ (0.00003, 0.99997)：softmax 会自动逼近「硬选择」，但全程保持可导。这就是「软」的含金量：软的地方能过梯度，硬的地方不能。
en: A numerical feel: two actions with scores h = (0, 0) give the policy (0.5, 0.5). Raise the second action’s score by 0.5: π becomes (0.378, 0.622) — no jump, a smooth glide from 0.5 toward 0.622. Raise it by another 10 points: π ≈ (0.00003, 0.99997) — softmax approaches a “hard choice” automatically yet stays differentiable throughout. Such is the value of “soft”: gradients pass where it is soft, and die where it is hard.

title.zh: 调转枪口：直接把策略做成函数
title.en: Turning the Gun Around: The Policy Itself Becomes a Function

zh: 概率守恒：$\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s,θ) ≡ 1 两边对 θ 求导得 $\Sigma_{a}$$\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ) = 0——抬高一个动作的概率必然压低其他动作的总概率。这个「零和」性质是第 10 章基线不变性的数学根基，先在这里记下。
en: Probability conservation: differentiating $\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s,θ) ≡ 1 with respect to θ yields $\Sigma_{a}$$\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ) = 0 — raising one action’s probability must lower the total probability of the others. This zero-sum property is the mathematical root of baseline invariance in Chapter 10; note it here first.

title.zh: 优化什么？给「好策略」定三个度量
title.en: Optimise What? Three Metrics for a Good Policy

zh: 梯度上升需要一个标量目标。书上给了三个候选度量（大同小异）：① 平均状态值 $\bar{v}_{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ $d_{\pi}(s)$$v_{\pi}(s)$——按折扣访问分布加权；② 初始状态值 $\bar{v} ^0 _{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ d₀(s)$v_{\pi}(s)$——只看起点；③ 平均单步奖励 $\bar{r}_{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ $d_{\pi}(s)$$\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)$q_{\pi}(s,a)$——无折扣情形的续式任务度量。
en: Gradient ascent needs a scalar objective. The book offers three near-equivalent metrics: ① the average state value $\bar{v}_{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ $d_{\pi}(s)$$v_{\pi}(s)$ — weighted by the discounted visitation distribution; ② the initial-state value $\bar{v} ^0 _{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ d₀(s)$v_{\pi}(s)$ — only where you start; ③ the average per-step reward $\bar{r}_{\pi} = \Sigma_{s}$ $d_{\pi}(s)$$\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)$q_{\pi}(s,a)$ — the continuing-task, undiscounted measure.

title.zh: 优化什么？给「好策略」定三个度量
title.en: Optimise What? Three Metrics for a Good Policy

zh: 别高兴太早：这三个度量的梯度推导是全书最硬的数学之一。坑在于 $d_{\pi}(s)$、$q_{\pi}(s,a)$ 都依赖 θ——对 θ 求导时「求导的链」会沿着整条轨迹无限延伸。下一节的策略梯度定理用一记巧劲把这个死结剪开。
en: Hold the applause: deriving the gradients of these metrics is among the hardest mathematics in the book. The trap: both $d_{\pi}(s) and q_{\pi}(s,a)$ depend on θ — differentiating sends the chain endlessly along the trajectory. The policy gradient theorem in the next section cuts this knot with one clever stroke.

title.zh: 优化什么？给「好策略」定三个度量
title.en: Optimise What? Three Metrics for a Good Policy

zh: 三个度量共用一个骨架：$\Sigma_{s}$ d(s)·「这个状态过得好不好」。权重 d(s) 是访问分布——「这个策略长期会在哪些状态逗留」。选哪个度量，本质是选「用哪种方式统计长期表现」：回合制任务有天然起点，看 $\bar{v} ^0 _{\pi}$（起点价值）最直接；持续型任务没有回合边界、折扣再小也压不住无限累积，就换 $\bar{r}_{\pi}$（平均单步奖励）；$\bar{v}_{\pi}$ 用折扣访问分布加权，介于两者之间。共同点更重要：三个度量都只依赖 π（通过 θ），不依赖任何价值表——「优化策略」第一次有了自成一体的目标，不必再绕道价值。
en: All three metrics share one skeleton: $\Sigma_{s}$ d(s)·“how well this state goes”. The weight d(s) is a visitation distribution — “where this policy lingers in the long run”. Choosing a metric is really choosing “how to tally long-run performance”: episodic tasks have a natural start, so $\bar{v} ^0 _{\pi}$ (start-state value) is the most direct; continuing tasks have no episode boundaries and no discount small enough to tame infinite accumulation, so $\bar{r}_{\pi}$ (average per-step reward) takes over; $\bar{v}_{\pi}$ weights by the discounted visitation distribution and sits in between. The commonality matters more: all three depend only on π (through θ), not on any value table — for the first time, “optimising the policy” has a self-contained objective with no detour through values.

title.zh: 优化什么？给「好策略」定三个度量
title.en: Optimise What? Three Metrics for a Good Policy

zh: 形态各异，结构同源：一个"分布 × 表现"的加权和；且都随 θ 连续可变——这正是梯度上升需要的地形

title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 在平稳访问分布下两目标严格差一个常数因子 ，因此梯度方向完全一致
