title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 定理 9.1 的结论惊人地简洁：三个度量的梯度都长成同一个期望的样子——
en: The conclusion of Theorem 9.1 is astonishingly clean: the gradients of all three metrics take the form of one expectation —

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 策略梯度定理 · Theorem 9.1

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 那记巧劲是 log：恒等式 $\nabla_{\theta}$π = π·$\nabla_{\theta}$ln π 把「对概率求导」改写成「概率 × 对 log 概率求导」。这样梯度就成了一个期望（在 $\eta_{\pi}$ 分布下）——期望就可以用样本平均来逼近（大数定律第五次登场）！推导中还有一个隐藏的幸运：$q_{\pi}$ 对 θ 的导数项（会引入整个未来的链式依赖）恰好相互抵消——剩下的只是「动作的对数概率 × 动作价值」。
en:
The clever stroke is the log: the identity $
abla_{	heta}$π = π·$
abla_{	heta}$ln π rewrites “differentiate a probability” as “probability × differentiate its log”. The gradient becomes an expectation (under $\eta_{\pi}$) — and expectations can be approximated by sample averages (the law of large numbers, fifth appearance)! A hidden piece of luck: the $
abla_{	heta}$$q_{\pi}$ terms (which would drag in the entire future via the chain rule) cancel exactly — leaving only “log-probability of the action × action value”.

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 直观读法：∇ln π(a|s) 指向「提高 a 概率」的方向；乘上 $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ 意味着——回报高的动作，把它的概率往上推；回报低的，往下压。推力大小正比于 q 值。这就是策略梯度的全部灵魂：被奖励强化的行为会重复出现（心理学「强化」一词的数学化身）。
en: How to read it intuitively: ∇ln π(a|s) points in the direction of raising a’s probability; multiplying by $q_{\pi}(s,a)$ means — push up the probabilities of high-return actions, push down those of low-return ones, with force proportional to q. That is the entire soul of the policy gradient: behaviours reinforced by reward recur (the mathematical incarnation of the psychological word “reinforcement”).

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: log-derivative trick 三步推导。目标：给 $E_{a~ \pi}$[f(a,s)] 对 θ 求导（f 不含 θ 的简单情形）。第一步老老实实展开：$\nabla_{\theta}$E[f] = $\Sigma_{a}$$\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ)·f(a,s)。
en: The log-derivative trick in three steps. Goal: differentiate $E_{a~ \pi}$[f(a,s)] with respect to θ (the easy case where f contains no θ). Step one, unfold honestly: $\nabla_{\theta}$E[f] = $\Sigma_{a}$$\nabla_{\theta}$π(a|s,θ)·f(a,s).

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 第二步：乘除恒等式。在 ∇π 后面乘一个 π/π（等于没乘），∇π = π·(∇π/π) = π·∇lnπ——「概率的梯度」改写成「概率 × 对数概率的梯度」。这一步没有用到任何高深工具，只是初中代数；但它把求导结果变回了一个期望。
en: Step two: the multiply-divide identity. Multiply ∇π by π/π (multiplying by one): ∇π = π·(∇π/π) = π·∇lnπ — “the gradient of a probability” becomes “probability × the gradient of its log”. No advanced tools, just school algebra; yet it turns the derivative back into an expectation.

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 第三步：收拢成期望。$\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)·∇lnπ(a|s)·f(a,s) = $E_{a~ \pi}$[∇lnπ(a|s)·f(a,s)]——期望就能采样估计，大数定律接管。核心收益一句话：对 θ 的依赖被完整地吸进 ∇lnπ 这一个因子里，其余部分保持「可采样」的形态。
en: Step three: gather into an expectation. $\Sigma_{a}$π(a|s)·∇lnπ(a|s)·f(a,s) = $E_{a~ \pi}$[∇lnπ(a|s)·f(a,s)] — and an expectation can be estimated by sampling, with the law of large numbers taking over. The core gain in one line: all θ-dependence is absorbed into the single factor ∇lnπ, leaving everything else in a samplable shape.

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: softmax 时 ln π(a|s) = onehot(a) − π —— 一行代码的魔法导数

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 定理骨架（以书为准）：对度量求导时，「未来的策略也依赖 θ」这条链式尾巴——下一状态的价值依赖 θ、再下一状态也是……——被完整折叠进 $\eta_{\pi}(s)$（折扣访问测度，引理 9.2 的 (I−γ$P_{\pi}$)⁻¹ 正是「把无穷步折扣转移打包」的机器）。折叠之后，梯度只剩下“当前状态、当前动作”这一层的求导；$q_{\pi}$ 对 θ 的依赖也在折叠中退场——定理的结论里不见任何 $\nabla_{\theta}$$q_{\pi}$ 的踪影。所以定理 9.1 的结论干净得反常：∇J 只需要 π 和 $q_{\pi}$ 的「值」，完全不需要它们的导数——q 不必对 θ 可导，甚至不必是函数（表格、神谕、任何 oracle 都行）。这个性质是 Actor-Critic 能用 TD 评论家替换 $q_{\pi}$ 的许可证。
en: The theorem’s skeleton (as the book presents it): when differentiating the metric, the chain tail of “the future policy also depends on θ” — next-state values depend on θ, and the ones after, forever — is folded entirely into $\eta_{\pi}(s)$ (the discounted visitation measure; Lemma 9.2’s (I−γ$P_{\pi}$)⁻¹ is precisely the machine that packs infinitely many discounted transitions into one operator). After the fold, differentiation survives only at the layer of “the current state, the current action”; and the $\nabla_{\theta}$$q_{\pi}(s,a)$ terms cancel exactly along the way. Hence the unnaturally clean conclusion of Theorem 9.1: ∇J needs only the values of π and $q_{\pi}$, never their derivatives — q need not be differentiable in θ, need not even be a function (a table, an oracle, anything goes). This property is precisely the licence that lets Actor-Critic replace $q_{\pi}$ with a TD critic.

title.zh: 策略梯度定理：一记 log 剪断死结
title.en: The Policy Gradient Theorem: One log Cuts the Knot

zh: 误区：softmax 不归一化。两种翻车姿势：① 直接拿 exp(h(s,a)ᵀθ) 当概率用——分数一大，「概率和」飙到天上，∑π≠1，后续一切推导（尤其 Σ∇π=0 的概率守恒）全部作废；② 对概率本身做加减更新——概率可能越界到负数或超过 1。正确姿势：θ 只存原始分数，概率永远由 softmax 现场归一化产出（代码精讲里正是这么写的）；更新只动分数，归一化交给 softmax。顺带的纪律：分数的尺度要管住——分数差过大，softmax 退化为硬 argmax，梯度 ∇lnπ = onehot − π ≈ 0，策略「冻死」，探索失声。
en: Misconception: softmax without normalisation. Two crash postures: ① using exp(h(s,a)ᵀθ) directly as the probability — scores blow up, the “probability sum” shoots skyward, ∑π≠1, and every downstream derivation (probability conservation Σ∇π=0 in particular) is voided; ② adding updates directly to probabilities — they can slip negative or exceed 1. The right posture: θ stores only raw scores, probabilities are always produced fresh by softmax normalisation (exactly how the code walkthrough writes it); updates touch scores only, and normalisation is softmax’s job. One discipline that comes along: keep the score scale in check — with huge score gaps softmax degenerates into a hard argmax, the gradient ∇lnπ = onehot − π ≈ 0, the policy “freezes to death”, and exploration falls silent.

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 把期望换成单条轨迹的采样，就得到 REINFORCE（蒙特卡洛策略梯度）。每采一条轨迹 (s₀,a₀,g₁,…)：对其中每一步，用 $\gamma^{t}$$G_{t}$（从该步出发的折扣回报）代替 $q_{\pi}$，执行更新：
en: Replacing the expectation by samples from a single trajectory yields REINFORCE (Monte Carlo policy gradient). For each trajectory (s₀,a₀,g₁,…): at every step, substitute $\gamma^{t}$$G_{t}$ (the discounted return from that step) for $q_{\pi}$ and apply the update:

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: REINFORCE — 式 (9.32) 的 γ^t 显式版 · REINFORCE — Eq. (9.32), γ^t-explicit

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 分子 驱动利用高价值动作，分母 给低概率动作意外获得高回报时更大的更新倍率以保障探索

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 书上的简洁读法（式 9.33）值得背下来：更新后 ln π($a_{t}$|$s_{t}$) 变大当且仅当 $G_{t}$ > 0（折扣情形）——这次经历好，就提高这套动作的概率。注意两点：① 它是 on-policy 的（梯度定义在当前策略的分布上）；② 一般非凸目标没有局部最优保证（θ 的非凸优化），全局最优要碰运气或加技巧。
en: The book’s compact reading (Eq. 9.33) is worth memorising: after the update, ln π($a_{t}$|$s_{t}$) grows if and only if $G_{t}$ > 0 (discounted case) — a good experience raises the probability of exactly those actions. Two caveats: ① it is on-policy (the gradient is defined on the current policy’s distribution); ② it has no general guarantee of reaching a local optimum (θ optimisation is nonconvex) — global optimality needs luck or extra machinery.

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 式里那个 $\gamma^{t}$ 是什么角色？折扣情形下 J 的定义把 t 步之后的回报按 $\gamma^{t}$ 折价——一个动作离回合起点越远，它对度量的「责任」越轻（它的好回报隔了 t 步折扣才传导回起点价值）。更新式里的 $\gamma^{t}$ 就是这份责任的账面折价。两步例子：γ=0.5、第二步奖励为 1，此时 G₁=1，但第二步的权重为 0.5。标准倒推只计算从当前步开始的折扣回报，更新还要乘起点权重。
en: What role does the $\gamma^{t}$ in the formula play? In the discounted case, J’s definition discounts rewards t steps ahead by $\gamma^{t}$ — the farther an action sits from the episode start, the lighter its “responsibility” toward the metric (its rewards pass through t steps of discounting before reaching the start-state value). The $\gamma^{t}$ in the update is exactly this book-keeping discount of responsibility. For gamma=0.5 and a final reward of 1 at step t=1, G is 1 but its update weight is 0.5.

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 一次更新的解剖（数值）。五个动作、全零分数（均匀策略 π=0.2），在 s₅ 选了「向下」（最优方向），回合回报 G = +1，学习率 α = 0.5。更新 θ += α·G·(onehot − π)：被选动作的分数 +0.5×(1−0.2) = +0.4，其余四个各 −0.5×0.2 = −0.1。softmax 之后：
en: Anatomy of one update (with numbers). Five actions, all-zero scores (uniform policy π=0.2); at s₅ the agent picks “downward” (the optimal direction), the episode return is G = +1, learning rate α = 0.5. The update θ += α·G·(onehot − π) adds +0.5×(1−0.2) = +0.4 to the chosen action’s score and −0.5×0.2 = −0.1 to each of the other four. After softmax:

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 好经历抬概率、坏经历压概率，抬与压的量都连续可调——"强化"的算术实现

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 高方差是 REINFORCE 的命门。$G_{t}$ 是整条轨迹的实际回报——轨迹里每一步的运气（转移的骰子、奖励的骰子、策略自己的骰子）全部乘进同一个数，样本之间天差地别。更隐蔽的毛病：如果环境奖励恒正（比如每步都 +1），所有动作的 G 都大于 0——每一步都在抬高所有被选动作的概率，只有相对幅度在分好坏，信噪比极差。两条出路自然浮现：① 中心化——减去一个与动作无关的基线，让「高于平均」才配正号（第 10 章的 baseline/优势）；② 换评分员——用低方差的 TD 估计代替真实回报（第 10 章的评论家）。第 9 章止步于此，第 10 章由此起跳。
en: High variance is REINFORCE’s Achilles’ heel. $G_{t}$ is the realised return of a whole trajectory — the luck of every step (the dice of transitions, of rewards, of the policy itself) multiplies into one number, and samples differ wildly. A subtler ailment: if the environment’s rewards are all positive (say +1 per step), every action’s G exceeds zero — every step raises the probability of every action taken, with only relative magnitudes separating good from bad: a terrible signal-to-noise ratio. Two exits emerge naturally: ① centring — subtract an action-independent baseline so only “above average” earns a plus sign (Chapter 10’s baseline/advantage); ② a different grader — replace the real return with a low-variance TD estimate (Chapter 10’s critic). Chapter 9 stops here; Chapter 10 leaps from exactly this spot.

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 三个高频误区。① 把 π 的梯度当 q 的梯度：$\nabla_{\theta}$ln π(a|s) 是「策略参数空间」里的方向——它只回答「θ 怎么动才能抬高 a 的概率」，对「a 好不好」一无所知；好坏信息全部来自乘在旁边的 q 或 G。两者量纲、含义、去向都不同，混用的更新谁也不代表。② 忘记 baseline 的中心化意义（提前打预防针）：基线不是「可有可无的减法」，它把评分从「绝对好坏」变成「相对平均」，方差直落；不减基线的 REINFORCE 在恒正奖励环境里会全面抬概率。③ on-policy 样本过期再用：θ 一变，采样分布就变，旧轨迹的 ∇lnπ 已经不是新策略的梯度——REINFORCE 的数据必须现采现用（这也是它样本效率低的根源，解药在第 10 章）。
en: Three frequent misconceptions. ① Mistaking π’s gradient for q’s gradient: $\nabla_{\theta}$ln π(a|s) is a direction in policy-parameter space — it answers only “how should θ move to raise a’s probability” and knows nothing about “whether a is good”; all goodness information comes from the q or G multiplied alongside. Different dimensions, meanings, and destinations — an update that confuses them represents neither. ② Forgetting what the baseline’s centring means (a vaccine in advance): the baseline is not an “optional subtraction”; it converts scores from “absolute goodness” to “relative to average”, collapsing the variance; without it, REINFORCE in all-positive-reward environments raises every probability. ③ Reusing stale on-policy samples: once θ moves, the sampling distribution moves with it, and the old trajectories’ ∇lnπ is no longer the new policy’s gradient — REINFORCE’s data must be gathered and consumed fresh (the root of its low sample efficiency, whose antidote arrives in Chapter 10).

title.zh: REINFORCE：采样出来的梯度上升
title.en: REINFORCE: Gradient Ascent from Samples

zh: 现在把同一批动作交给四种基线。先对照理论平均梯度的模，再加 200 个样本看经验方差。偏置基线 +10 提醒我们：随手选一个基线，也可能让估计更吵。
en: Use the same sampled actions for four baselines. Compare the theoretical mean-gradient norms, then add 200 samples and inspect empirical variance. The +10 baseline shows how a poor baseline can increase noise.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 全书第一次，主角从价值换成了策略。套路三步：选标量度量 → 推梯度 → 梯度上升。最难的推导（定理 9.1）产出一句期望式，log 技巧让梯度可采样。REINFORCE 把它跑成在线算法：好经历加概率、坏经历减概率。从此强化学习有了两根支柱：价值基（L2–L8）与策略基（本章）。
en: For the first time, the protagonist switches from values to policies. The recipe is three steps: pick a scalar metric → derive its gradient → ascend. The hardest derivation (Theorem 9.1) yields one expectation formula, and the log trick makes it samplable. REINFORCE runs it as an online algorithm: good experiences raise probabilities, bad ones lower them. RL now stands on two pillars: value-based (L2–L8) and policy-based (this chapter).

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 求解对象：值方法解 q（一张表/一个函数），策略在 argmax 里免费赠送；策略方法解 θ（策略的参数），价值退居幕后当评委。
en: What is solved: value methods solve q (a table or a function), with the policy thrown in free by argmax; policy methods solve θ (the policy’s parameters), with values demoted to behind-the-scenes judges.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 策略形态：argmax 吐确定性策略；softmax 参数化天然输出随机策略——需要混合最优解（博弈、藏猫猫）或平滑探索的任务只有这条路好走。
en: Policy form: argmax emits deterministic policies; softmax parameterisation naturally outputs stochastic ones — tasks demanding mixed optima (games, hide-and-seek) or smooth exploration really only have this road.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 连续动作：值方法每步要在连续集合上求 argmax（内层优化，算不起）；策略方法直接输出分布参数（如高斯的 μ、σ）——一步到位。
en: Continuous actions: value methods must argmax over a continuum every step (an inner optimisation nobody can afford); policy methods output distribution parameters (e.g. a Gaussian’s μ, σ) directly — one step, done.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 各自的代价：值方法样本效率高、可 off-policy（Q-learning 一脉），但拿不到随机策略、连续动作吃力；策略方法可导、可随机、可连续，但 on-policy 数据要现采、方差大、没有一般的最优性保证。Actor-Critic（下一课）让两者各出所长。
en: What each pays: value methods are sample-efficient and off-policy capable (the Q-learning line) but cannot produce stochastic policies and strain at continuous actions; policy methods are differentiable, stochastic, continuous-friendly, but need fresh on-policy data, suffer variance, and have no general optimality guarantee. Actor-Critic (next lecture) lets each contribute its strength.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 离场自检。① 能说出值方法「两步走」的三处硬伤（argmax 不可导/吐不出随机策略/连续动作嵌套求极值）；② 能手推 log-derivative 恒等式并说清它为什么把梯度变回「可采样的期望」；③ 能复述定理 9.1 的形态并解释「$q_{\pi}$ 不需要对 θ 求导」这件事为什么重要；④ 能用数值说出 REINFORCE 一次更新如何抬/压概率（0.20→0.29 / 0.20→0.13）；⑤ 能列出策略方法与值方法在求解对象、策略形态、连续动作、样本效率上的对照。五题全过，第 10 章的演员就该上场了。
en: Exit self-check. ① Name the three hard wounds of the value route’s “two steps” (argmax non-differentiable / no stochastic policies / nested optimisation for continuous actions); ② derive the log-derivative identity by hand and explain why it turns the gradient back into “a samplable expectation”; ③ recite the shape of Theorem 9.1 and explain why “$q_{\pi}$ never needs differentiating in θ” matters; ④ give the numbers of how one REINFORCE update raises/lowers probabilities (0.20→0.29 / 0.20→0.13); ⑤ list the value/policy comparison across solution object, policy form, continuous actions, and sample efficiency. Pass all five, and the actor of Chapter 10 may take the stage.

title.zh: 本章总结：策略基于的方法登场
title.en: Chapter Summary: Policy-Based Methods Enter

zh: 下一课预告：REINFORCE 用真实回报 $G_{t}$ 当「评分员」——无偏但方差大、必须等回合结束。Actor-Critic 请来一位评论家：用价值函数（TD 误差）当评分员——方差骤降、还能单步更新。演员负责表演（策略），评论家负责打分（价值），两者互相成就。
en: Next lecture teaser: REINFORCE hires the real return $G_{t}$ as the “grader” — unbiased but high-variance, and it must wait for episodes to end. Actor-Critic hires a critic: the value function (TD error) grades instead — variance collapses and updates become per-step. The actor performs (policy); the critic scores (value); each makes the other better.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：让策略自己长出最优来
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: Letting the Policy Grow Its Own Optimality

zh: 本章推理链：argmax 不可导、吐不出随机策略 → softmax 参数化 → 需要标量度量（三个候选）→ 度量的梯度有死结（d_π、q 依赖 θ）→ log 恒等式剪断 → 期望式可采样 → REINFORCE：好经历加概率。
en: This chapter’s spine: argmax is non-differentiable and deterministic → parameterise with softmax → a scalar metric is needed (three candidates) → the metric’s gradient has a knot (d_π and q depend on θ) → the log identity cuts it → the expectation is samplable → REINFORCE: good experiences raise probability.

title.zh: 代码精讲：REINFORCE 全身不过 30 行
title.en: Code Walkthrough: REINFORCE in About 30 Lines

zh: 策略梯度代码的主角不是循环而是梯度公式：对 logits 求导得到 onehot(a) − π；对网络参数还须通过 logits 应用链式法则（softmax 的魔法导数）。这一行加上回报折扣，就是 REINFORCE 的全部数学。
en: The logit gradient is onehot(a) − π; network parameters require the chain rule (the magic softmax derivative). That line plus return discounting is the whole mathematics of REINFORCE.

title.zh: 问答：策略梯度六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Policy Gradient

zh: 为什么有 log、为什么要学无折扣情形、更新到底在更新什么——六问扫清本课。
en: Why the log, why study the undiscounted case, what is the update really updating — six questions to clear the lesson.

title.zh: 问答：策略梯度六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Policy Gradient

zh: 翻卡前先过三题：① 「softmax 策略相比 ε-greedy 好在哪」（可导——梯度能流过策略；概率连续变化——探索强度由 θ 自己学着调，不是外挂的 ε）；② 「策略梯度定理里为什么可以不知道 $q_{\pi}$ 的导数」（∇θ 的依赖全被 log 恒等式吸进 ∇lnπ，定理只需要 q 的值——所以任何能估 q 的东西都能当评分员）；③ 「REINFORCE 为什么慢」（$G_{t}$ 方差大 + on-policy 数据现采现用——两个病根都通向第 10 章的评论家）。
en: Before flipping, run through three: ① “What does the softmax policy have over ε-greedy” (differentiability — gradients flow through the policy; smoothly shifting probabilities — exploration strength is learned by θ itself rather than bolted on as ε); ② “Why may the policy gradient theorem remain ignorant of $q_{\pi}$’s derivative” (the θ-dependence is absorbed into ∇lnπ by the log identity; the theorem needs only q’s value — so anything that estimates q can serve as the grader); ③ “Why is REINFORCE slow” ($G_{t}$’s variance plus strictly fresh on-policy data — both roots lead straight to Chapter 10’s critic).

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: REINFORCE 的评分员是真实回报 $G_{t}$——无偏但要等整条轨迹、方差大。QAC（Q actor-critic）换了个评分员：用 TD 学习现估的 q(s,a,w)。每步两行更新：演员（actor）——$\theta_{t+1} = \theta_{t} + \alpha_{\theta}$$\nabla_{\theta}$ln π($a_{t}$|$s_{t} , \theta_{t}$) q($s_{t} , a_{t} , w_{t}$)，沿评论家给的分改进策略；评论家（critic）——$w_{t+1} = w_{t} + \alpha_{w}$[r + γq(s′,a′,w) − q(s,a,w)]$\nabla_{w}$q，用 TD 误差修正自己的评分表。
en: REINFORCE’s grader is the real return $G_{t}$ — unbiased but episode-bound and high-variance. QAC (Q actor-critic) hires a different grader: the q(s,a,w) estimated on the fly by TD learning. Each step is two lines. The actor: $\theta_{t+1} = \theta_{t} + \alpha_{\theta}$$\nabla_{\theta}$ln π($a_{t}$|$s_{t} , \theta_{t}$) q($s_{t} , a_{t} , w_{t}$) — improve the policy along the critic’s score. The critic: $w_{t+1} = w_{t} + \alpha_{w}$[r + γq(s′,a′,w) − q(s,a,w)]$\nabla_{w}$q — correct its own scoring table by the TD error.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 分工的本质：演员是策略函数 π(a|s,θ)（负责行动），评论家是价值函数 q(s,a,w)（负责打分）。评论家的 TD 目标让打分逐渐可靠；演员的梯度让策略逐渐优秀。对比 REINFORCE：评分从「事后整条轨迹」变为「当场 TD」——可降低方差、可单步更新。这就是广义策略迭代在无模型世界的完成态。
en: The essence of the division of labour: the actor is the policy function π(a|s,θ) (acts); the critic is the value function q(s,a,w) (scores). The critic’s TD target makes the scores reliable over time; the actor’s gradient makes the policy better. Against REINFORCE: scoring changes from “after-the-fact whole trajectory” to “on-the-spot TD” — variance can decrease and per-step updates become possible. This is generalised policy iteration completed in the model-free world.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 为什么非要请一位评论家？REINFORCE 的三个痛点逐一对照。① 必须等回合结束：$G_{t}$ 要从轨迹末端倒推，回合内毫无更新——长回合/持续任务直接卡死；② 方差巨大：整条轨迹的运气全乘在一个评分上，学习率被迫设小，训练慢；③ 评分是「一次性的」：每条轨迹的 G 用完即弃，策略参数跨回合保留，但标准 REINFORCE 没有单独学习可查询的动作价值函数。QAC 的解法是把评分员换成一直在学的价值函数：q̂(s,a,w) 用 TD 每步修正（不等回合）、只吃一步噪声（低方差）、且跨回合持续积累（经验复用）。结构就两件套：演员 π(a|s,θ) 上台表演，评论家 q̂(s,a,w) 台下打分——打分喂给演员的梯度，表演产生的数据喂给评论家的 TD。
en: Why hire a critic at all? REINFORCE’s three pains, one by one. ① It must wait for the episode’s end: $G_{t}$ is computed backwards from the trajectory tail — no updates mid-episode; long episodes and continuing tasks stall outright. ② Enormous variance: the luck of an entire trajectory multiplies into one score, forcing tiny learning rates and slow training. ③ Scores are single-use: each trajectory’s G is discarded after one update — policy updates persist across episodes, but vanilla REINFORCE learns no separate action-value estimator. QAC’s remedy is to replace the grader with a value function that never stops learning: q̂(s,a,w) corrects itself by TD every step (no waiting), swallows only one step of noise (low variance), and keeps accumulating across episodes (experience reuse). The structure is a two-piece ensemble: the actor π(a|s,θ) performs on stage while the critic q̂(s,a,w) scores from the seats — scores feed the actor’s gradient; the performance’s data feeds the critic’s TD.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: （评论家的分——推动力）（TD 误差——修正量）

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 近似一：真值 → 估计。定理 9.1 要求的是 $q_{\pi}(s,a)$；QAC 用函数近似的 q̂(s,a,w) 顶替（第 8 章的全部机器在此上岗）。评论家越准，演员的梯度越接近真策略梯度。
en: Approximation one: truth → estimate. Theorem 9.1 demands $q_{\pi}(s,a)$; QAC stands the function-approximated q̂(s,a,w) in its place (all of Chapter 8’s machinery reports for duty here). The more accurate the critic, the closer the actor’s gradient to the true policy gradient.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 近似二：期望 → 采样。梯度是期望，QAC 用当前交互到的单个 ($s_{t} , a_{t}$) 代替（L6 的 SGD 精神）。一步噪声换一步更新，划算。
en: Approximation two: expectation → sample. The gradient is an expectation; QAC substitutes the single currently-visited ($s_{t} , a_{t}$) (L6’s SGD spirit). One step of noise buys one step of update — a fair trade.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 近似三：最优 → 「尽力」。梯度上升每步只走一小截，而 J(θ) 非凸——一般不能保证达到局部最优，「最优策略」名副其实地只是近似最优。三个近似各让一步，换来一个能跑、能在线、能持续学习的整体。
en: Approximation three: optimal → “best effort”. Gradient ascent takes only a small step at a time, and J(θ) is nonconvex — there is no general guarantee of reaching a local optimum, and the “optimal policy” is optimal only approximately, as the name honestly admits. Three approximations each concede a little, and together they buy a whole that runs, learns online, and never stops.

title.zh: QAC：演员上台，评论家入席
title.en: QAC: The Actor Takes the Stage, the Critic Takes a Seat

zh: 每一步都在做最细粒度的广义策略迭代。回看 L4 的 GPI 骨架：策略评估与策略改进交替执行、互相成就。QAC 把「交替」的粒度压到单步：每个时间步里，评论家先用最新经验修正评分（评估半步），演员使用更新前保存的评分改进策略（改进半步）。评估不必收敛、改进不必彻底——两家都只前进一小格，改进效果取决于评分精度和步长。这是 GPI 思想在无模型、函数化世界的最终形态。
en: Every step performs generalised policy iteration at its finest grain. Recall L4’s GPI skeleton: policy evaluation and policy improvement alternate, each propping up the other. QAC compresses the alternation to single steps: within every time step, the critic first corrects its scores with the freshest experience (an evaluation half-step), then the actor improves the policy using the saved pre-update scores (an improvement half-step). Evaluation need not converge, improvement need not be thorough — both advance by a small notch, yet progress depends on critic accuracy and step sizes. This is GPI’s final form in a model-free, functional world.

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: 基线不变性（式 10.3）：策略梯度里给 q 减去任意一个只依赖状态的函数 b(S)，期望不变——因为 E[∇lnπ(S)·b(S)] = $\Sigma_{s}$η(s)b(s)$\Sigma_{a}$∇π(a|s) = 0（概率和恒为 1，导数为 0）。减错不了，白赚。按梯度方差 $\mathbb{E}_A[\|\nabla_\theta\ln\pi\|^2(q_\pi-b)^2]$ 严格极小化，最优基线（optimal baseline）是梯度范数平方加权均值 $b^*(s)$；去掉梯度范数权重后得到实用的次优基线（suboptimal baseline） $b(s)=\mathbb{E}[q_\pi(s,A)]=v_\pi(s)$——减完剩下的恰好是优势（advantage）：
en: Baseline invariance (Eq. 10.3): subtracting any state-only function b(S) from q inside the policy gradient leaves the expectation unchanged — because E[∇lnπ(S)·b(S)] = $\Sigma_{s}$η(s)b(s)$\Sigma_{a}$∇π(a|s) = 0 (probabilities sum to one, so their gradient is zero). You cannot get it wrong, and it is free. Minimizing $\mathbb{E}_A[\|\nabla_\theta\ln\pi\|^2(q_\pi-b)^2]$ yields the exact optimal baseline $b^*(s)$ weighted by $\|\nabla_\theta\ln\pi\|^2$; dropping those gradient-norm weights yields the practical suboptimal baseline $b(s)=\mathbb{E}[q_\pi(s,A)]=v_\pi(s)$, turning the centered score into the advantage:

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: = 这个动作比"平均水平"好多少

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: 严格方差极小解是加权平均值 ；工程常规 A2C 选用无需计算策略梯度范数的次优近似

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: 为什么实用 A2C 选次优基线 $v_{\pi}(s)$ 而非每次重算 b*(s)？因为 b*(s) 需要对策略对数梯度范数求期待加权，而 $v_{\pi}(s)$ 只需现成评论家、直接把评分从「绝对好坏」变成「相对平均水平的意外程度」：q 高于 $v_{\pi}$ → 正优势 → 多用；低于 → 少用。实践中用 TD 误差 δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) 当优势的单步低方差样本估计，就得到 A2C（Advantage Actor-Critic）。
en: Why does practical A2C pick the suboptimal baseline $v_{\pi}(s)$ instead of recomputing b*(s) every step? Because b*(s) requires expectations weighted by squared log-policy gradient norms, whereas $v_{\pi}(s)$ comes directly from a standard state-value critic and shifts scores from “absolute goodness” to “surprise relative to state average” — q above $v_{\pi}$ raises probability, below lowers it. Using TD error δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) as the one-step sample of the advantage gives A2C (Advantage Actor-Critic).

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: （当 v 已收敛到 时）

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: δ 作为优势代理的逐项读法。把 δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) 拆成三段：r 是即时反馈（这一步实际拿到的）；γv(s′) 是「接下来的人生」按当前估值的折现（L7 自举的老朋友）；v(s) 是事前预期（待在这个状态本来就该值多少）。所以 δ 回答的问题是——「这次比预期好多少？」好于预期（δ>0）→ 这个动作是惊喜，抬它的概率；不如预期（δ<0）→ 压概率。推力的大小也自动校准：大惊喜大推、小惊喜小推。它不用等回合结束（单步可得）、不用另建优势网络（v 一个函数身兼两职）。v 不准时 δ 有偏——但 v(s) 与 v(s′) 的误差在相减中部分对消，比想象中扛造。
en: Reading δ as an advantage proxy, term by term. Split δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) into three parts: r is the immediate feedback (what this step actually earned); γv(s′) is “the rest of one’s life” discounted at current estimates (L7’s old friend, bootstrapping); v(s) is the prior expectation (what staying in this state was supposed to be worth). So δ answers the question — “how much better than expected was this?” Better than expected (δ>0) → the action is a pleasant surprise, raise its probability; worse (δ<0) → lower it. The push is self-calibrating: big surprises get big pushes, small ones small. No waiting for episode ends (available per step), no separate advantage network (one v function holds two jobs). When v is inaccurate δ is biased — but the errors of v(s) and v(s′) partly cancel in the subtraction, making it sturdier than it looks.

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: A2C 与 REINFORCE+baseline 是同一招的两个档位。两者都用「减基线」的中心化评分：REINFORCE+baseline 用 $G_{t}$ − b(s)——真实回报减基线，无偏但方差大、必须等回合；A2C 用 δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s)——把「整段真实回报」换成「一步真实 + 自举」，有偏但可降低方差、单步更新。偏差-方差的连续谱在这对兄弟身上再次现形（与 L7 的 n-step 谱完全同构）。【书外延伸】谱的中间点也有名有姓：用 n 步回报减基线（A2C 的 n-step 版），乃至把多档 n 步指数加权的 GAE——现代策略梯度方法的标配组件。
en: A2C and REINFORCE+baseline are two gears of the same move. Both score with the centred “minus a baseline” signal: REINFORCE+baseline uses $G_{t}$ − b(s) — real return minus baseline, unbiased but high-variance and episode-bound; A2C uses δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) — swapping “a whole stretch of real return” for “one real step plus bootstrapping”, biased but sharply lower-variance and per-step. The bias–variance spectrum reappears on this pair of siblings (exactly isomorphic to L7’s n-step spectrum). [Beyond the book] The middle of the spectrum also has names: n-step return minus baseline (the n-step A2C), up to GAE, the exponentially weighted blend of many n-step advantages — a standard component of modern policy-gradient methods.

title.zh: A2C：减去基线，可降低方差
title.en: A2C: Subtract a Baseline, Watch the Variance Fall

zh: 两个工程误区：失衡与抢跑。① actor/critic 学习率失衡：$\alpha_{\theta}$ 远大于 $\alpha_{w}$，演员在一张还没学明白的评分表上狂奔——梯度方向是噪声，策略越跑越偏，而评论家追不上修正；$\alpha_{w}$ 远大于 $\alpha_{\theta}$ 则相反：评分表抖得厉害（每步都被单样本猛拉），演员无所适从。两个学习率要么同量级、要么 critic 略快——让评分先稳半拍。② critic 没热身，actor 先冲刺：训练初期 v 接近零、δ ≈ r——评分退化成「只看即时奖励」，演员会先学会一串短视动作。常见对策：前若干步只训评论家（或给 $\alpha_{\theta}$ 设 warm-up），等 δ 有了信息量再放开演员。
en: Two engineering misconceptions: imbalance and false starts. ① Unbalanced actor/critic learning rates: with $\alpha_{\theta}$ far above $\alpha_{w}$, the actor sprints on a score sheet it has barely learned — gradient directions are noise, the policy veers off, and the critic cannot catch up to correct; with $\alpha_{w}$ far above $\alpha_{\theta}$, the score sheet jitters violently (yanked by every single sample) and the actor loses its bearings. Keep the two rates on the same order, or let the critic run slightly faster — the scores should steady themselves half a beat ahead. ② The critic not warmed up while the actor sprints: early in training v is near zero and δ ≈ r — scoring degenerates into “immediate reward only”, and the actor first learns a string of short-sighted moves. Common remedies: train the critic alone for the first stretch (or give $\alpha_{\theta}$ a warm-up), and release the actor once δ carries information.

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: A2C 仍是 on-policy（样本必须来自当前策略）。想用旧数据或别的策略的数据？需要重要性采样（importance sampling）：用比值 ρ = π(a|s)/β(a|s) 给每条样本加权，把「别的策略的经验」折算回「我的策略的期望」——分布不同，权重来凑。代价：比值方差大（权重忽大忽小），轨迹越长越难算。
en: A2C is still on-policy (samples must come from the current policy). Want to reuse old data or another policy’s data? Importance sampling: weight each sample by the ratio ρ = π(a|s)/β(a|s), converting “another policy’s experience” into “my policy’s expectation” — different distributions, weights make up the difference. The price: ratio variance (weights swing wildly), and it worsens with trajectory length.

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: 把重要性比值塞进优势加权的梯度，就得到 off-policy actor-critic。再往前一步：确定性策略梯度（DPG）——策略干脆不输出概率，直接输出动作 μ(s,θ)，梯度变成 $\nabla_{\theta}$μ(s,θ)·$\nabla_{a}$q(s,a)|a=μ（沿着 q 的山坡最陡处推动作）。行为策略 β 随便选个探索性的即可。DDPG、TD3 都是这条线的后人。
en: Plugging the importance ratios into the advantage-weighted gradient yields off-policy actor-critic. One step further: the deterministic policy gradient (DPG) — the policy outputs an action μ(s,θ) outright instead of probabilities, with gradient $\nabla_{\theta}$μ(s,θ)·$\nabla_{a}$q(s,a)|a=μ (push the action along q’s steepest slope). The behavior policy β can be any exploratory one. DDPG and TD3 are descendants of this line.

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: 讲义例子（L10 Slides 26–36）· 重要性采样一眼看穿：设 $X\in\{+1,-1\}$，目标分布 $p_0(+1)=0.5$（真实均值 $\mathbb{E}_{p_0}[X]=0$），而数据只能从行为分布 $p_1(+1)=0.8$（偏态均值 $\mathbb{E}_{p_1}[X]=0.6$）采出。直接对样本取平均 $\bar{x}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum x_i$ 会收敛到 $0.6$（完全算偏）；引入比值 $\rho(x)=p_0(x)/p_1(x)$ 后，加权估计 $\bar{f}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum \rho(x_i)x_i$ 的期望严格等于 $\mathbb{E}_{p_0}[X]=0$——但当 $p_1$ 与 $p_0$ 差距拉大（如 $p_1(+1)\to 0.98$）时，罕见样本的比值权重会急剧放大方差。
en: Slide Example (L10 Slides 26–36) · Importance Sampling Intuition: Let $X\in\{+1,-1\}$ with target $p_0(+1)=0.5$ ($\mathbb{E}_{p_0}[X]=0$), while samples are drawn from behavior $p_1(+1)=0.8$ ($\mathbb{E}_{p_1}[X]=0.6$). Plain sample averaging $\bar{x}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum x_i$ converges to $0.6$ (biased), whereas weighting by $\rho(x)=p_0(x)/p_1(x)$ yields $\bar{f}_n = \frac{1}{n}\sum \rho(x_i)x_i \to \mathbb{E}_{p_0}[X]=0$ without bias—though extreme mismatch (e.g. $p_1(+1)\to 0.98$) blows up variance on rare samples.

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: 目标硬币正面概率为 0.5，手里的硬币却是 0.8。再取 100 个样本，同时读普通均值和加权均值：正面乘 0.5/0.8，反面乘 0.5/0.2。把较罕见的反面加重，究竟是在估计哪枚硬币？
en: The target coin has heads probability 0.5; the sampling coin has 0.8. Add 100 draws and read both means. Heads get weight 0.5/0.8 and tails 0.5/0.2. Which coin does upweighting rare tails reconstruct?

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: 【书外延伸，助理解】A3C/A2C：并行也是一味药。 on-policy 方法还有一个非算法层面的病：单环境串行采样，相邻样本高度相关（这一步的局势直接决定下一步）。A3C（Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic）的处方是「多开几个世界」：多个 worker 各自环境各自采样、异步把梯度推给共享参数——不同环境的样本天然去相关，还顺带压平了训练方差，也不再需要经验回放池。A2C 是它的同步版：所有 worker 走到同一节拍、攒一个大批量一起更新——去相关的收益保留，实现更简单、GPU 利用更充分。注意它们治的是「样本相关性」，与 off-policy 治的「数据过期」是两种病、两种药。
en: [Beyond the book, for intuition] A3C/A2C: parallelism is also a medicine. On-policy methods suffer one further, non-algorithmic ailment: single-environment serial sampling makes adjacent samples strongly correlated (this step’s situation directly determines the next). A3C (Asynchronous Advantage Actor-Critic) prescribes “open more worlds”: multiple workers each sample their own environment and asynchronously push gradients to shared parameters — samples from different environments decorrelate naturally, training variance flattens along the way, and no replay buffer is needed. A2C is its synchronous sibling: all workers march to the same beat and pool one large batch per update — the decorrelation benefit stays, the implementation is simpler, and GPU utilisation improves. Note they treat “sample correlation”, a different disease from off-policy’s “stale data” — two diseases, two medicines.

title.zh: Off-policy Actor-Critic：重要性采样穿针引线
title.en: Off-Policy Actor-Critic: Importance Sampling Threads the Needle

zh: 两个翻车现场。① 连续任务忘记打折：γ=1 时折扣回报 $G_{t}$ 在持续任务里发散（无穷步奖励直接累加），REINFORCE 的更新式连定义都保不住；两条正路——要么老老实实 γ<1，要么改用平均奖励 $\bar{r}_{\pi}$ 目标（第 9 章的第三个度量正是为它准备的）。「顺手把 γ 设成 1 省事」是持续任务里最经典的隐性 bug。② 重要性比值无界：ρ = π/β 在 β 采样到 π 几乎不选的动作时可以任意大——一条样本独占梯度，更新被单次运气劫持。【书外延伸】实战常给 ρ 裁剪（clip）上限，PPO 的截断目标正是这一思想的工程化。
en: Two crash scenes. ① Forgetting to discount in continuing tasks: with γ=1 the discounted return $G_{t}$ diverges in continuing tasks (infinitely many rewards accumulate directly), and REINFORCE’s update cannot even stay defined; two proper roads — keep γ<1 honestly, or switch to the average-reward objective $\bar{r}_{\pi}$ (the third metric of Chapter 9 exists precisely for this). “Casually setting γ to 1 for convenience” is the classic hidden bug of continuing tasks. ② Unbounded importance ratios: ρ = π/β can grow arbitrarily large when β samples an action that π almost never chooses — a single sample monopolises the gradient, and the update is hijacked by one stroke of luck. [Beyond the book] Practice often clips ρ at a ceiling; PPO’s truncated objective is exactly this idea, engineered.

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: 本章四种 actor-critic：QAC（评论家用 TD 估 q，替代 MC 评分）→ A2C（减去次优基线 $v_{\pi}$ 逼近最优基线 b*，评分变成优势、可降低方差）→ off-policy 版（重要性采样复用旧数据）→ 确定性策略梯度（连续动作的钥匙）。它们共享同一个骨架：演员沿评论家的分数做梯度上升，评论家沿 TD 误差做梯度下降。
en: Four actor-critics this chapter: QAC (the critic estimates q by TD, replacing the MC grader) → A2C (subtract the practical suboptimal baseline $v_{\pi}$ toward optimal b*, scores become advantages, variance can decrease) → the off-policy version (importance sampling reuses old data) → deterministic policy gradient (the key to continuous actions). All share one skeleton: the actor ascends the critic’s score; the critic descends its TD error.

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: 全书收官回顾：L1 概念 → L2–L3 Bellman 方程与最优性 → L4 动态规划 → L5–L7 无模型（MC/TD/Sarsa/Q）→ L8 函数近似与 DQN → L9–L10 策略梯度与 Actor-Critic。两条主线贯穿始终：广义策略迭代（评估↔改进交替）与随机近似（带噪声的增量更新）。书的终点是文献的起点：SAC、TRPO、PPO、TD3、多智能体、基于模型、分布式 RL……地基已经打好，往上盖楼吧。
en: A closing tour: L1 concepts → L2–L3 Bellman equations and optimality → L4 dynamic programming → L5–L7 model-free (MC/TD/Sarsa/Q) → L8 function approximation and DQN → L9–L10 policy gradient and Actor-Critic. Two threads run through it all: generalised policy iteration (evaluation↔improvement alternating) and stochastic approximation (noisy incremental updates). Where the book ends, the literature begins: SAC, TRPO, PPO, TD3, multi-agent, model-based, distributional RL… the foundation is laid — go build on it.

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: QAC：用 TD 评论家 q̂(s,a,w) 替掉 REINFORCE 的 $G_{t}$——修「等回合 + 高方差」，代价是评分有偏（q̂ 不准）。
en: QAC: replaces REINFORCE’s $G_{t}$ with a TD critic q̂(s,a,w) — fixes “episode-bound + high variance”, at the price of biased scores (q̂ is imperfect).

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: A2C：评分减去基线 v(s)、改用优势 δ——修「评分噪声大」（中心化白赚，方差再降），代价仍是有偏（v 不准）。
en: A2C: subtracts the baseline v(s) from the score and switches to the advantage δ — fixes “noisy scores” (centring is free, variance drops again), still at the price of bias (imperfect v).

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: off-policy AC：重要性采样把 β 策略的经验折算回 π——修「数据必须新鲜」，代价是比值方差（裁剪可治）。
en: Off-policy AC: importance sampling converts β-policy experience back into π’s expectation — fixes “data must be fresh”, at the price of ratio variance (treatable by clipping).

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: DPG：策略直接输出动作 μ(s,θ)——修「连续动作枚举不动」，代价是失去随机性（探索靠外挂的行为策略）。
en: DPG: the policy outputs an action μ(s,θ) outright — fixes “continuous actions cannot be enumerated”, at the price of losing stochasticity (exploration outsourced to the behavior policy).

title.zh: 本章总结 & 全书收官
title.en: Chapter Summary & The End of the Book

zh: 离场自检（也是全书毕业考）。① 能说出 REINFORCE 的三个痛点与评论家如何逐一对症；② 能逐项解读 δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) 并证明它的期望就是优势（当 v 准确时）；③ 能解释基线为什么白赚（概率守恒 Σ∇π=0），以及为何 b*(s) 才是最小方差最优基线、$v_{\pi}$ 是工程实用的次优基线；④ 能分辨 A2C 与 REINFORCE+baseline 在偏差-方差谱上的位置；⑤ 能把全书两条主线（GPI、随机近似）在 actor 和 critic 的两行更新里各自指出来。五题全过——十讲圆满，可以放心去读论文了。
en: Exit self-check (also the book’s graduation exam). ① Name REINFORCE’s three pains and how the critic treats each; ② read δ = r + γv(s′) − v(s) term by term and show its expectation is the advantage (when v is accurate); ③ explain why baselines are free (probability conservation Σ∇π=0), why weighted b*(s) minimizes variance, and why practical A2C uses suboptimal $v_{\pi}$; ④ locate A2C and REINFORCE+baseline on the bias–variance spectrum; ⑤ point out where the book’s two main threads (GPI, stochastic approximation) live inside the actor’s and critic’s two update lines. Pass all five — ten lectures complete, and the papers await with confidence.

title.zh: 连贯长推理：演员与评论家的分工史
title.en: The Long Coherent Reasoning: A History of the Actor–Critic Division of Labour

zh: 本章推理链：REINFORCE 的 MC 评分贵 → 请 TD 评论家（QAC）→ 评分减基线 v(s) 变优势（A2C，可降低方差且不变性免费）→ off-policy 复用旧数据（重要性采样）→ 确定性策略（DPG 通向连续控制）→ SAC/PPO/TD3 的家谱。
en: This chapter’s spine: REINFORCE’s MC grading is dear → hire a TD critic (QAC) → subtract the baseline v(s) for advantages (A2C: variance can decrease, invariance is free) → reuse old data off-policy (importance sampling) → deterministic policies (DPG toward continuous control) → the family tree of SAC/PPO/TD3.

title.zh: 代码精讲：A2C 的完整骨架
title.en: Code Walkthrough: The Complete A2C Skeleton

zh: A2C 的每一步 = 一行评论家更新（TD 误差修 v）+ 一行演员更新（优势推策略）。40 行以内，两个网络（或两张表）的全部爱恨情仇。
en: One step of A2C = one line of critic update (TD error fixes v) + one line of actor update (advantage pushes the policy). Within 40 lines, the entire love-hate story of two networks (or two tables).

title.zh: 代码精讲：A2C 的完整骨架
title.en: Code Walkthrough: The Complete A2C Skeleton

zh: 读代码前先定位三个位置：两个学习率（$\alpha_{\theta}$ 管演员、$\alpha_{w}$ 管评论家——上一节的「失衡」误区就藏在这两个数里）、δ 的计算行（一个数喂两张表，全文件的枢纽）、以及演员更新里 ∇lnπ 的写法（与 L9 的 REINFORCE 逐字相同——把 G 换成 δ 就是全部改动）。带着这三个锚点去读，40 行代码会自己讲解。
en: Before reading, pin down three locations: the two learning rates ($\alpha_{\theta}$ for the actor, $\alpha_{w}$ for the critic — the “imbalance” misconception of the previous section hides inside these two numbers), the line computing δ (one number feeding two tables, the pivot of the whole file), and the ∇lnπ line in the actor update (verbatim identical to L9’s REINFORCE — swapping G for δ is the entire change). With these three anchors, the 40 lines will explain themselves.

title.zh: 问答：Actor-Critic 六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Actor-Critic

zh: 为什么需要评论家、基线为什么白赚、确定性策略怎么求导——收官六问。
en: Why a critic, why baselines are free, how deterministic policies differentiate — the closing six.

title.zh: 问答：Actor-Critic 六连问
title.en: Q&A: Six Questions on Actor-Critic

zh: 翻卡前先过三题：① 「评论家和演员的学习率能共用一个吗」（不能——两个更新的尺度、噪声、收敛速度都不同，失衡即翻车）；② 「δ 是优势本身吗」（不是——它是优势的单步采样代理，期望等于优势仅当 v 收敛，平时有偏但方差小）；③ 「actor-critic 收敛到全局最优吗」（不保证——J(θ) 非凸、评分还在动，实践中以「稳定改进」为目标，理论缺口靠工程纪律补）。
en: Before flipping, run through three: ① “Can the critic and actor share one learning rate” (no — the two updates differ in scale, noise, and convergence speed; imbalance means a crash); ② “Is δ itself the advantage” (no — it is a one-step sample proxy whose expectation equals the advantage only once v has converged; biased in general, but low-variance); ③ “Does actor-critic converge to the global optimum” (not guaranteed — J(θ) is nonconvex and the scores keep moving; practice aims for “steady improvement”, and engineering discipline fills the theoretical gap).
